ADAPT is built on an observed two-stage shift: an early visually grounded stage where cross-attention focuses on text-relevant evidence, followed by a prior-dominated stage where cross-attention degrades. They characterize degradation with three signals: attention drift (unfocused or spatially biased), reduced responsiveness to newly generated tokens (lower attention change rate over time), and reduced overall attention mass on visual tokens across layers/positions.

The method has three coupled components:
- Visual Enhance: extract early-stage multi-layer cross-attention and refine it into a semantics-aware anchor (including positional-bias correction).
- Attention-Supervised Inference: monitor later-stage cross-attention against the anchor and apply sparse corrective steering when degradation patterns appear.
- Visual Attention Guidance DPO: preference-tune using pairs constructed under different visual evidence conditions (anchor-enhanced images as chosen vs noise images as rejected) to encourage visually grounded behavior.

Compared to output-only mitigation (logit penalties, standard DPO/RLHF), ADAPT treats cross-attention trajectories as first-class objects to supervise and control, combining inference-time correction with training-time preference alignment.
summary_en.experiments:
The provided excerpt does not include the concrete benchmark tables or exact numbers. The paper claims consistent improvements over strong baselines across benchmarks and backbones, and supports the diagnosis with attention visualizations/statistics (e.g., attention change rate decay and reduced visual-token attention mass).

When reading the full paper, validate: (1) robustness of the anchor (does it lock in early mistakes?), (2) inference overhead and side effects of steering, and (3) whether the DPO construction introduces shortcuts (detecting noise-image artifacts rather than improving grounding).
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (25–35 minutes):
- Read the analysis section on cross-attention degradation to see how the three signals are defined and measured.
- Focus on anchor refinement and positional-bias correction—this is the main technical hinge.
- Then check the inference-time steering rule and the DPO data construction to understand what each component contributes.

If your lens is pretraining/unified modeling, concentrate on whether these attention-level constraints could be scaled into a training objective (e.g., attention consistency/grounding regularization) and what trade-offs it has versus output-level losses.

recommendation.zh: 把“幻觉”落到可观测的 cross-attention 动态退化上是好切口；但注意力监督/DPO 容易被 proxy 牵着走，重点只看诊断指标与人评一致性和推理期开销。
recommendation.en: The attention-dynamics signature is a useful handle on hallucination, but attention-supervised DPO can overfit proxies—only worth it if the diagnostic correlates with human grounding and the online fix is cheap.

paper.title: CoMet: Context and Multiplicity Decomposition for Multimodal Uncertainty Estimation
paper.abstract: Uncertainty estimation has been a long-standing challenge in AI models; it amounts to "knowing what you don't know," and metacognition is notoriously difficult even for humans (cf. the Dunning-Kruger effect). Although it is still far from solved even in simpler classification systems, tackling it in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) is becoming increasingly important. Within MLLMs, uncertainty can stem from any of the diverse sources as well as from their relationships, and further can st

summary.core_problem: 多模态大模型的不确定性来源复杂，现有方法无法区分上下文歧义和答案多样性导致的不确定性，开放端生成场景下估计精度低。
summary.importance: 方法创新，首次将MLLM不确定性分解为上下文特定和答案 multiplicity 两个独立分量，提升估计的可解释性与准确性。
summary.technical_approach: 提出CoMet方法：通过上下文扰动估计上下文特定不确定性（任务/prompt本身的歧义），通过输出语义聚类估计multiplicity不确定性（给定上下文下的合理答案数量），训练轻量事后模块输出最终估计值。
summary.experiments: 在多个MLLM开放端问答基准上测试，对比现有不确定性估计方法在OOD检测、错误识别等任务上的性能提升。

summary_en.core_problem: MLLM uncertainty comes from heterogeneous sources; existing methods fail to distinguish between ambiguity from context and answer multiplicity, leading to low estimation accuracy in open-ended generation settings.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: first decomposes MLLM uncertainty into two independent components (context-specific and multiplicity-specific), improving both interpretability and accuracy of uncertainty estimation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes CoMet: estimates context-specific uncertainty (ambiguity from task/prompt) via context perturbation, estimates multiplicity uncertainty (number of plausible answers under given context) via output semantic clustering, and trains a lightweight post-hoc module to output final estimation.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on multiple MLLM open-ended QA benchmarks, showing improved performance on OOD detection and error prediction over existing uncertainty estimation methods.

recommendation.zh: MLLM不确定性分解的新思路，对基座模型校准研究仅有弱参考价值，仅看摘要和方法概述即可。
recommendation.en: A novel decomposition framework for MLLM uncertainty estimation, only weak reference for foundation model calibration research, read abstract and method overview only.

paper.title: Harnessing Textual Refusal Directions for Multimodal Safety
paper.abstract: To improve safety in Large Language Models (LLMs) we can either perform post-training alignment or exploit refusal directions in the activation space. Both strategies are less feasible in Multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) as they require unsafe multimodal data, harder to collect than their unimodal counterpart. In this work, we relax this constraint and investigate whether textual refusal directions, extracted directly from the LLM backbone, generalize across modalities (i.e., image, video). Preliminary f

summary.core_problem: 多模态大模型安全对齐依赖难以采集的多模态不安全标注数据，现有文本对齐策略跨模态泛化性差且易触发正常输入的误拒问题。
summary.importance: 方法创新，首次验证LLM激活空间中的文本拒绝方向可跨图像/视频模态泛化，提出无需训练、无需多模态安全数据的轻量对齐方案。
summary.technical_approach: 提出模态无关拒绝引导（MARS）方法：先提取LLM骨干的文本拒绝方向，通过激活重居中修正跨模态错位导致的正常输入误拒，再自适应调整引导强度，实现无训练的多模态安全能力注入。
summary.experiments: 覆盖图像、视频模态的安全测试场景，验证层选择、引导强度、跨模态对齐程度对拒绝效果的影响，可在保留正常输入可用性的前提下提升不安全输入的拒绝率。

summary_en.core_problem: MLLM safety alignment relies on hard-to-collect unsafe multimodal annotated data, while existing text alignment strategies generalize poorly across modalities and often trigger false refusals on benign inputs.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: first verifies that textual refusal directions in LLM activation space generalize across image/video modalities, and proposes a lightweight training-free alignment scheme requiring no multimodal safety data.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Modality-Agnostic Refusal Steering (MARS): extract textual refusal directions from LLM backbone, correct false refusals on benign inputs caused by cross-modal misalignment via activation re-centering, then adaptively scale steering strength to inject multimodal safety without training.
summary_en.experiments: Tests on image and video safety benchmarks, verifies the impact of layer selection, steering strength, and cross-modal alignment quality on refusal performance, improving unsafe input rejection rate while preserving benign input usability.

recommendation.zh: 多模态安全对齐的轻量无训练思路，对基座对齐的低成本 ablation 有参考价值，仅看方法部分即可。
recommendation.en: A lightweight training-free MLLM safety alignment approach, useful reference for low-cost foundation model alignment ablations, read method section only.

paper.title: Clearer Sight, Fewer Lies: Oriented Pickup Preference Optimization for Multimodal Hallucination Mitigation
paper.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are prone to hallucination as their generation preferences are insufficiently calibrated to visual evidence, causing them to fall back on linguistic priors, rather than faithful grounding. In this work, we start from an empirical observation: when query-relevant visual evidence is explicitly strengthened using the model's own attention, generation becomes more accurate, suggesting that many failures do not arise solely from missing perception, but from an

summary.core_problem: 解决多模态大模型（MLLM）因生成偏好未与视觉证据充分校准、过度依赖语言先验导致的幻觉问题
summary.importance: 方法创新，首次将视觉证据强度纳入偏好对齐的约束维度，而非仅关注响应质量，为MLLM幻觉缓解提供了新的优化方向
summary.technical_approach: 提出Oriented Pickup Preference Optimization（OPPO），先通过模型自身注意力增强查询相关视觉证据构造不同强度的证据视图，再对比同一忠实响应在强/锚定/弱证据视图下的表现，将朴素视觉偏好转化为有序的视觉证据对齐目标
summary.experiments: 原摘要未披露具体模型参数量、训练数据集规模、对比基线及定量提升幅度，仅通过经验观察验证了增强视觉证据可提升生成准确性

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses MLLM hallucinations caused by generation preferences being insufficiently calibrated to visual evidence, leading to over-reliance on linguistic priors
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation that first incorporates visual evidence strength into preference alignment constraints, rather than only focusing on response quality, providing a new optimization direction for MLLM hallucination mitigation
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Oriented Pickup Preference Optimization (OPPO): first constructs evidence views of varying strength by amplifying query-relevant visual signals via the model's own attention, then contrasts the same faithful response across strong/anchored/weak evidence views to turn naive visual preference into ordered visual-evidence alignment
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not disclose specific model parameters, training dataset size, baselines, or quantitative improvement margins; only empirical observations confirm that enhancing visual evidence improves generation accuracy

recommendation.zh: 多模态幻觉对齐的小改进，核心是把证据强度放进偏好对比，可作为后训练 ablation 的弱参考，不用深读
recommendation.en: Minor tweak to multimodal hallucination alignment that injects evidence strength into preference ranking; useful only as a weak signal for post-training ablations, no deep read needed

paper.title: One Forward Beats Two: InnerZoom for Accurate and Efficient GUI Grounding
paper.abstract: MLLM-based GUI grounding methods commonly formulate target localization as autoregressive coordinate generation, enabling models to leverage the strong instruction-following and semantic understanding capabilities of MLLMs. However, this formulation requires the model to retain region-level target evidence while decoding coordinate tokens with the spatial precision demanded by GUI clicking. Our diagnostic analysis reveals that target-region awareness emerges in intermediate decoder layers but is

summary.core_problem: 解决 MLLM GUI grounding 中“看到了目标区域，但最终坐标预测不准”的问题，尤其是两阶段 ZoomIn 方法带来的额外延迟和计算开销。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 VLM/GUI grounding 方法改进。对基座预训练的直接价值有限，但其中关于 decoder 中层目标证据无法传递到最终坐标 token 的诊断，和多模态模型的空间定位失败机制有关。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 InnerZoom，一个单次 forward 的跨层证据桥接框架。方法把原始前向过程中的目标相关线索压缩成跨层信息，用来替代外部 crop-and-rerun 的二次推理流程，希望保留 zooming 的精度收益，同时减少端到端延迟。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据集名称、baseline 数字或提升幅度。论文声称相对 ZoomIn 式两阶段方法，在不增加二次前向的前提下保持定位精度收益，并降低计算成本。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a failure mode in MLLM-based GUI grounding: the model can form target-region evidence internally but fails to convert it into accurate final coordinate tokens, while two-pass ZoomIn methods add latency.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a VLM/GUI grounding method paper. Its direct value for foundation-model pretraining is limited, but the layer-wise diagnostic on spatial evidence loss is relevant to understanding multimodal decoder behavior.
summary_en.technical_approach: InnerZoom is a single-forward cross-layer evidence-bridging framework. It converts target-related cues from the original forward pass into compact cross-layer information, aiming to mimic the accuracy benefit of crop-and-rerun zooming without a second inference pass.
summary_en.experiments: The provided abstract does not include model sizes, datasets, baselines, or numerical gains. The claimed result is improved efficiency over external ZoomIn-style reruns while preserving their localization benefit.

recommendation.zh: 只看诊断部分即可；中层有目标证据但解码端丢失，这个现象比 InnerZoom 本身更值得记。
recommendation.en: Read the diagnostic, not the wrapper: the useful signal is that mid-layer target evidence is lost before coordinate decoding.

paper.title: Latent Noise Mask for Reducing Visual Redundancy in Multimodal Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) often fail in fine-grained visual reasoning, as question-relevant visual cues are diluted by dense and redundant image tokens. Recent multimodal reasoning methods usually extend chain-of-thought from language models into visual or latent spaces, seeking to add intermediate reasoning states while overlooking the negative impact of redundant visual tokens. We propose LatEnt Noise maSk (Lens), a question-conditioned visual evidence purification framework tha

summary.core_problem: MLLM 在细粒度视觉推理中容易被大量冗余图像 token 干扰，问题相关视觉线索被稀释。
summary.importance: 这是一个多模态推理阶段的视觉 token 选择/抑制方法，贡献点在于把视觉冗余视为推理失败来源，而不是继续增加视觉 CoT 或 latent reasoning 状态。对预训练研究员的价值主要在视觉 token 信息密度和 token budget 分配。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Latent Noise Mask。方法引入一个临时可学习的 Lens Evidence Token，对当前问题下哪些视觉 token 支持回答进行打分；再用轻量 noise generator 对低相关 token 注入自适应 latent noise，软性压低 distractor 的影响。它不改变 MLLM backbone，也不改变 token 序列长度。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型、benchmark、训练规模或提升幅度。论文声称 Lens 只增加一个临时控制 token 和轻量噪声生成器，额外开销小，并能改善细粒度视觉推理。

summary_en.core_problem: MLLMs struggle with fine-grained visual reasoning because dense and redundant image tokens dilute question-relevant visual evidence.
summary_en.importance: The paper contributes a visual-token purification method for multimodal reasoning. Its useful angle for pretraining researchers is the treatment of visual token redundancy as an information-density and token-budget problem, rather than simply adding more intermediate reasoning states.
summary_en.technical_approach: Latent Noise Mask introduces a temporary learnable Lens Evidence Token to score which visual tokens support the current question. Based on these scores, a lightweight noise generator injects adaptive latent noise into low-relevance tokens, softly suppressing distractors without changing the backbone or sequence length.
summary_en.experiments: The supplied abstract does not report model names, benchmark details, training scale, or numerical gains. It claims minimal overhead from one control token and a small noise generator, with improved fine-grained visual reasoning.

recommendation.zh: 只看 LET 打分和噪声注入设计；它把视觉 token 冗余当推理瓶颈，但还不是预训练层面的解法。
recommendation.en: Read only the LET scoring and noise-injection design; it frames visual-token redundancy cleanly, but it is still an inference-side fix, not a pretraining recipe.

paper.title: Video-MME-Logical: A Controlled Diagnostic Benchmark for Video Temporal-Logical Reasoning
paper.abstract: Recent interest in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) raises a central question: can they reason over dynamic visual evidence rather than merely recognize objects or events in individual frames? This ability, which we refer to as video temporal-logical reasoning, requires models to maintain, update, and compose evidence as visual states evolve across frames. Existing video benchmarks often conflate this capability with scene complexity, static recognition, or uncontrolled temporal variatio

summary.core_problem: 评测多模态大模型是否能基于视频中随时间变化的视觉证据进行状态维护、更新和组合推理，而不只是识别单帧对象或事件。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是受控诊断 benchmark。它试图把视频时间-逻辑推理从场景复杂度、静态识别和未受控时间变化中分离出来，对判断视频 MLLM 的真实推理能力有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Video-MME-Logical，围绕五类 temporal-logical operation 构造评测：state tracking、sequential counting、temporal ordering、dynamic spatiality 和 structural composition。数据包含 25 个细粒度任务类别，通过受控对象状态、状态转移、时间依赖和逻辑组合来生成问题，并可通过调节 temporal horizon 与 reasoning composition 控制难度。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出样本量、参评模型列表、得分表或模型失效模式。核心实验预计是对现有 MLLM/视频模型做 final-answer evaluation，并分析不同时间长度和组合复杂度下的性能退化。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Colab 和 Beihang University；未能从给定信息确认知名作者或该团队在视频 MLLM benchmark 方面的代表性系列工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether multimodal large language models can reason over evolving visual evidence in videos, rather than merely recognizing objects or events in isolated frames.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a controlled diagnostic benchmark. It tries to isolate video temporal-logical reasoning from scene complexity, static recognition, and uncontrolled temporal variation, which makes it useful for assessing video MLLM reasoning.
summary_en.technical_approach: Video-MME-Logical is organized around five temporal-logical operations: state tracking, sequential counting, temporal ordering, dynamic spatiality, and structural composition. It includes 25 fine-grained task categories built from controlled object states, transitions, temporal dependencies, and logical compositions. Difficulty is controlled by varying temporal horizon and reasoning composition.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report dataset size, evaluated models, score tables, or failure modes. The intended evaluation appears to be final-answer testing of current MLLMs/video models, with analysis over temporal horizon and compositional difficulty.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Colab and Beihang University; no well-known authors or established video-MLLM benchmark track record can be confirmed from the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 只看任务定义和难度控制设计；若结果显示模型随 horizon 系统退化，可作为视频预训练 eval 备选。
recommendation.en: Read the task taxonomy and difficulty-control design; if scores degrade cleanly with horizon, it is a useful candidate eval for video pretraining.

paper.title: What We are Missing in Multimodal LLM Evaluation?
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can process diverse inputs, e.g., text, images, audio, and video, and generate textual responses. While their capabilities have advanced rapidly, evaluation of such models has not kept pace. Most existing evaluation benchmarks are limited to isolated tasks and reveal little about whether a model integrates information across modalities. We examine current means for evaluating MLLMs and review the existing benchmark taxonomy to identify gaps, including tem

summary.core_problem: 现有多模态大模型（MLLM）评测多集中于孤立任务，无法衡量跨模态信息整合等核心能力，缺乏对评测体系缺口的系统梳理
summary.importance: 首次系统归纳MLLM评测的四大核心缺口，属于评测体系的原理分析贡献，为后续构建贴合真实多模态智能的基准指明方向
summary.technical_approach: 梳理现有MLLM评测的任务分类体系，从能力覆盖维度拆解现有评测的不足，归纳未被覆盖的关键能力维度
summary.experiments: 无定量实验与模型训练配置，为综述式的gap分析工作

summary_en.core_problem: Existing MLLM evaluations focus mostly on isolated tasks and fail to measure core capabilities like cross-modal information integration, with no systematic review of evaluation paradigm gaps
summary_en.importance: Systematically identifies 4 key gaps in MLLM evaluation, an analytical contribution to evaluation methodology that guides future benchmark design aligned with real multimodal intelligence
summary_en.technical_approach: Reviews the taxonomy of existing MLLM evaluation benchmarks, decomposes their capability coverage, and summarizes uncatered critical capability dimensions
summary_en.experiments: No quantitative experiments or model training configurations; a review-style gap analysis work

recommendation.zh: 梳理多模态评测的四个核心缺口，做多模态预训练的研究员可快速过一遍gap清单，无需深读正文
recommendation.en: Catalogs 4 key gaps in MLLM evaluation; multimodal pretraining researchers can skim the gap list, no deep reading required

paper.title: ShutterMuse: Capture-Time Photography Guidance with MLLMs
paper.abstract: Real-world photography requires capture-time guidance for both camera framing and subject pose. Yet existing aesthetic cropping benchmarks mainly evaluate post-hoc crop prediction and overlook subject-side recommendations, leaving the capture-time guidance capabilities of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) underexplored. To address this gap, we introduce CaptureGuide-Bench, a benchmark with two complementary tasks: photographer-side composition decision and refinement, and subject-side sce

summary.core_problem: 评测并推动 MLLM 在“拍摄当下”的摄影指导能力：既要给摄影者构图建议，也要给被摄者姿态/站位建议，而不是事后裁剪。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是 benchmark+数据集：把美学裁剪从 post-hoc crop prediction 扩展到 capture-time 可执行建议（含定位与姿态），对多模态对齐与可操作指令输出的评测更贴近真实交互。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 CaptureGuide-Bench（两任务：摄影者侧构图决策/细化；被摄者侧场景条件姿态推荐）；构建 CaptureGuide-Dataset（130K 样本，含文本 rationale 与结构化视觉标注）；在此基础上训练/提出 ShutterMuse 作为统一框架以覆盖两类建议输出。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出数据规模 130K；报告现象：通用 MLLM 能做构图决策但缺乏精确细化定位，专用裁剪模型定位好但只会 refinement，二者都难给可执行 pose guidance；具体模型/指标未在摘要中披露。

summary_en.core_problem: Evaluating and enabling MLLMs for capture-time photography guidance: actionable composition advice for photographers and pose recommendations for subjects, beyond post-hoc cropping.
summary_en.importance: Primarily a benchmark+dataset contribution that reframes aesthetic evaluation into actionable, localized, and pose-aware guidance—closer to real interactive multimodal assistants.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces CaptureGuide-Bench with two tasks (photographer-side composition decision/refinement; subject-side scene-conditioned pose recommendation); releases CaptureGuide-Dataset (130K samples with textual rationales and structured visual annotations); proposes/trains ShutterMuse as a unified model to address both tasks.
summary_en.experiments: Dataset size is 130K; reported findings: general-purpose MLLMs can decide composition but fail at precise refinement localization, specialized cropping models localize well but are limited to refinement, and neither provides actionable pose guidance; specific models/metrics are not detailed in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 作为“可执行多模态指令输出”的评测资产有用，但更偏应用侧；只需看 benchmark 任务定义与失败模式总结，别指望预训练新结论。
recommendation.en: Useful as an evaluation asset for actionable multimodal instruction following, but it’s application-leaning; read the task design and failure modes, not for pretraining insights.

paper.title: V-Zero: Answer-Label-Free On-Policy Distillation with Contrastive Evidence Gating for Fine-Grained Visual Reasoning
paper.abstract: Fine-grained visual reasoning requires multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to identify task-relevant visual evidence and ground their reasoning in local image regions. Existing agentic methods typically rely on reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards or supervised fine-tuning on large-scale annotated reasoning traces, leading to costly exploration, hand-designed verification rules, or heavy dependence on textual supervision. A natural way to avoid such external answer labels is to le

summary.core_problem: 在没有答案标签和人工推理轨迹的条件下，提升 MLLM 对细粒度视觉证据的定位和视觉推理能力。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态后训练方法分析与改进。它把 on-policy distillation 解释为 negative-free stop-gradient alignment，并指出其缺少轨迹级区分信号，因而推理能力有上限。对预训练研究员的价值主要在于理解视觉推理训练信号的质量，而不是基座预训练 recipe。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 V-Zero，一个 answer-label-free 的视觉推理框架。核心思路是在学生模型自身采样轨迹上做 on-policy distillation，并加入 contrastive evidence gating，用视觉证据对推理轨迹进行区分，补足单纯 token-level correction 缺少 trajectory-level discrimination 的问题。
summary.experiments: 摘要未完整给出 benchmark、模型规模、训练数据规模和具体提升数字；可确认实验目标是细粒度视觉推理与局部证据 grounding，并与 RLVR、SFT 标注推理轨迹、普通 OPD 等路线对比。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自四川大学、西安交通大学、中国电信 TeleAI、北京大学等机构；未从给定信息中确认有广泛公认的基座模型代表作者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets fine-grained visual reasoning in MLLMs without answer labels or annotated reasoning traces, especially the ability to ground reasoning in local visual evidence.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is an analysis and improvement of multimodal post-training signals. It recasts on-policy distillation as negative-free stop-gradient alignment and argues that missing trajectory-level discrimination limits its ceiling. For pretraining researchers, the value is mostly about training-signal quality for visual reasoning, not base-model pretraining recipes.
summary_en.technical_approach: It introduces V-Zero, an answer-label-free visual reasoning framework. The method distills from student-sampled on-policy trajectories and adds contrastive evidence gating so that visual evidence can discriminate among trajectories, addressing the limitation of token-level correction alone.
summary_en.experiments: The provided abstract does not include full benchmarks, model scale, data scale, or exact gains. The experimental setup appears to compare against RLVR-style methods, SFT with annotated reasoning traces, and vanilla OPD on fine-grained visual reasoning and evidence grounding.
summary_en.authors_note: The listed institutions include Sichuan University, Xi’an Jiaotong University, TeleAI of China Telecom, and Peking University. No widely established base-model author is identifiable from the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 只看 OPD 上限分析和 evidence gating 消融；它是训练信号质量的弱证据，不是预训练范式变化。
recommendation.en: Read only the OPD-limit analysis and evidence-gating ablations; it is a weak signal on training-signal quality, not a pretraining shift.

paper.title: Accelerating Multimodal Large Language Models with Prior-Corrected Token Reduction
paper.abstract: Visual token reduction has emerged as an effective strategy for accelerating Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). Many existing methods prune tokens by ranking text-visual attention scores. However, we show that attention is often dominated by a model-induced prior: even without textual instruction, MLLMs tend to focus on certain task-agnostic regions. Consequently, the attention scores of instruction-conditioned tokens are suppressed, increasing the risk that these tokens are discarded dur

summary.core_problem: 解决 MLLM 视觉 token 剪枝中，文本-视觉注意力被模型固有先验主导，导致任务相关 token 被误删的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理加速方法和注意力信号分析。它提醒视觉 token reduction 不能直接把 cross-attention 当作任务条件重要性，注意力里混有与指令无关的区域偏好。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Prior-Corrected Token Reduction，训练免费。方法先估计无文本指令或弱条件下的模型诱导先验注意力，再与任务条件下的后验注意力做对比，用二者差异衡量每个视觉 token 对当前指令额外提供的信息。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、benchmark 名称和提升幅度。实验主张是在不训练模型的前提下减少视觉 token，并尽量保持多模态推理性能。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses visual-token pruning in MLLMs where text-visual attention is contaminated by model-induced priors, causing task-relevant tokens to be pruned.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an inference-efficiency method plus a useful diagnostic about attention signals. It argues that cross-attention should not be treated as task-conditioned token importance without correcting for instruction-agnostic visual priors.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes Prior-Corrected Token Reduction, a training-free pruning method. The method estimates a prior attention map induced by the model, contrasts it with the task-conditioned posterior attention, and ranks tokens by the additional usable information contributed under the current instruction.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, benchmark names, or numerical gains. The claimed evaluation is training-free visual-token reduction with preserved multimodal reasoning performance.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图和注意力先验分析即可；对预训练不直接，但能提醒别把 MLLM attention 当干净监督信号。
recommendation.en: Read the method figure and prior-attention analysis; it is not pretraining work, but it cautions against treating MLLM attention as a clean supervision signal.

paper.title: Spectral Evolution-Guided Token Pruning in Multimodal Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Reducing visual token redundancy is critical for accelerating Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) without degrading cross-modal reasoning performance. Existing token pruning methods typically rely on single-layer signals, such as attention scores or token similarities, which overlook the cross-layer transformation of visual representations and may exhibit positional bias in multimodal token sequences. To address this limitation, we propose a training-free token pruning framework based on Cr

summary.core_problem: 解决 MLLM 视觉 token 剪枝过度依赖单层 attention 或相似度信号，忽略视觉表征跨层演化的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是训练免费推理加速方法。它把 token 重要性从单点统计改为跨层动态统计，对理解 MLLM 中视觉 token 的语义激活有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Cross-Layer Spectral Evolution。方法在频域中度量视觉 token 表征如何随 Transformer 层变化，认为从高频结构细节向低频语义抽象发生更强谱重分布的 token 更可能语义活跃，应被保留。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型、数据集和提升幅度。实验目标是训练免费剪枝视觉 token，并在降低推理成本的同时保持跨模态推理性能。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses MLLM visual-token pruning methods that rely on single-layer attention or similarity signals and ignore cross-layer representational evolution.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a training-free inference acceleration method. It shifts token importance from a single-layer statistic to a cross-layer dynamic signal, which is a useful lens for visual-token activity in MLLMs.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes Cross-Layer Spectral Evolution. The method measures how each visual token evolves across Transformer layers in the frequency domain, preserving tokens with stronger spectral redistribution from high-frequency structure toward low-frequency semantic abstraction.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model names, dataset names, or numerical gains. The evaluation claims training-free visual-token pruning with reduced inference cost and preserved cross-modal reasoning.

recommendation.zh: 读 Fig/ablation 就够；频域跨层信号比单层 attention 干净一些，但仍是 MLLM 推理剪枝增量。
recommendation.en: The figure and ablations are enough; cross-layer spectral signals may be cleaner than single-layer attention, but this remains incremental MLLM pruning work.

paper.title: Towards Fast and Effective Long Video Understanding of Multimodal Large Language Models via Adaptive Quasi-Gaussian Sampling
paper.abstract: Long video understanding remains a daunting challenge for \emph{Multimodal Large Language Models} (MLLMs) due to the excessive computation and memory footprint. Thus, \emph{keyframe selection} is often adopted to mitigate this shortcoming, which however still suffers from low flexibility and high noise due to its hard sampling principle. In this paper, we define video frame selection as a problem of \emph{Quasi-Gaussian Sampling}, and propose an adaptive and training-free approach termed \textbf

summary.core_problem: 解决长视频 MLLM 推理中帧数过多导致的计算和显存开销问题，同时避免硬关键帧选择带来的噪声和不灵活。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是训练无关的推理侧效率方法。它不改变 MLLM 预训练目标，但对长视频多模态系统如何做输入压缩有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 AdaQ，将视频帧选择建模为 Quasi-Gaussian Sampling；借鉴 Gaussian 3-sigma 规则，为局部查询使用较小采样区间，为全局查询使用较大采样区间，从而自适应地选择帧。
summary.experiments: 论文将 AdaQ 应用于 4 个 MLLM 和 3 个 embedding model。摘要称相对默认 MLLM 和已有采样方法有明显性能收益，但未给出具体模型规模、数据集和提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the compute and memory cost of long-video MLLM inference while reducing the rigidity and noise introduced by hard keyframe selection.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a training-free inference-efficiency method. It does not modify multimodal pretraining, but it is relevant to input compression and video-token budgeting in long-video MLLM systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: AdaQ formulates frame selection as Quasi-Gaussian Sampling. Inspired by the Gaussian 3-sigma rule, it adapts the sampling interval: narrower for local queries and wider for global queries.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated on four MLLMs with three embedding models. The abstract reports clear gains over default MLLM inference and prior sampling baselines, but does not provide exact model sizes, datasets, or effect sizes.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图和消融即可；它是输入预算启发，不是多模态预训练信号的改进。
recommendation.en: Skim the method diagram and ablations only; this is an input-budgeting trick, not a change to multimodal pretraining signals.

paper.title: ActiveScope: Actively Seeking and Correcting Perception for MLLMs
paper.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated impressive vision-language understanding, yet still struggle with fine-grained perception in high-resolution images. While existing training-free methods typically rely on attention-based localization or coarse-to-fine search, they are often misled by distractors and fail to locate multiple targets. Our investigation attributes these failures to Contextual Dominance, where salient distractors overwhelm target attention and cause inaccura

summary.core_problem: 提升 MLLM 在高分辨率图像中的细粒度定位和多目标感知能力，尤其是在显著干扰物存在时避免看错或漏看。
summary.importance: 这是一个训练-free 的 MLLM 感知修正方法，价值在于对高分辨率视觉-语言模型的感知失效做了可解释拆分：Contextual Dominance 和 Semantic Bias。它不是预训练方法，但对理解 MLLM 感知瓶颈有一定参考。
summary.technical_approach: ActiveScope 包含主动寻找和纠错两个思路。Semantic Anchor Localization 使用细粒度语义锚点独立定位关键目标，减少全局语义对显著概念的偏置；另一个模块用于根据定位结果修正感知，缓解注意力被干扰物主导和多对象定位不完整的问题。方法不需要重新训练 MLLM，属于推理时感知增强框架。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型、数据集和数值提升。实验应比较 ActiveScope 与注意力定位、粗到细搜索等 training-free 方法在高分辨率细粒度问答、多目标定位或感知纠错任务上的表现。
summary.authors_note: 作者列表包含 Qingming Huang，长期从事多媒体和视觉理解研究；摘要未提供明确机构信息。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to improve fine-grained localization and multi-object perception of MLLMs on high-resolution images, especially under salient distractors.
summary_en.importance: This is a training-free perception correction method for MLLMs. Its useful part is the failure decomposition into Contextual Dominance and Semantic Bias. It is not a pretraining paper, but it provides a modest diagnostic signal about MLLM perception bottlenecks.
summary_en.technical_approach: ActiveScope uses an active perception-seeking and correction framework. Semantic Anchor Localization introduces fine-grained semantic anchors to localize key targets independently, reducing global semantic bias toward salient concepts. A correction component then mitigates distractor-dominated attention and incomplete localization in multi-object scenes. The method operates at inference time without retraining the MLLM.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report specific models, datasets, or numerical improvements. The experiments likely compare ActiveScope against attention-based localization and coarse-to-fine training-free methods on high-resolution fine-grained perception, multi-object localization, or perception-correction tasks.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Qingming Huang, known for work in multimedia and visual understanding; the abstract does not specify institutional affiliations.

recommendation.zh: 只看失效归因和模块图即可；training-free 修补不改 prior，但能提醒预训练别只堆分辨率。
recommendation.en: Read only the failure analysis and module diagram; the training-free patch does not change priors, but it warns against treating resolution as the whole MLLM perception problem.

paper.title: VideoLatent: Video-Language Learning via Latent Self-Forcing
paper.abstract: Recent advancements in chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning have shown promise in enhancing video understanding and reasoning capabilities of multimodal large language models (MLLMs). However, existing CoT-based MLLMs require labor-intensive CoT annotations and incur substantial training and inference overhead. While visual latent reasoning has emerged as a more efficient alternative, existing methods primarily focus on image tasks and heavily rely on additional supervision signals for visual latent

summary.core_problem: 解决现有视频多模态大模型依赖人工CoT标注、视觉潜推理需要额外监督信号，导致训练推理成本高、迁移性差的问题。
summary.importance: 多模态理解方向的方法创新，首次提出仅依赖标准答案的视频潜推理自监督训练范式，降低标注成本。
summary.technical_approach: 提出VideoLatent，设计潜变量注入模块适配视频时序特征，配套潜自强迫训练范式，包含潜对齐与潜多样性两个目标，无需CoT/辅助图像等额外监督。
summary.experiments: 在多个视频理解与推理基准上测试，相比现有CoT类MLLM降低训练推理开销的同时保持或提升推理性能。

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses high training/inference costs and poor transferability of video MLLMs caused by reliance on manual CoT annotations and extra supervision signals for visual latent reasoning.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation in multimodal understanding, proposing the first self-supervised video latent reasoning training paradigm that only depends on ground-truth answers to reduce annotation costs.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes VideoLatent with a latent injection module tailored for video temporal features, paired with a latent self-forcing training paradigm consisting of latent alignment and latent diversity objectives, requiring no extra supervision such as CoT traces or auxiliary images.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on multiple video understanding and reasoning benchmarks, maintaining or improving reasoning performance compared to CoT-based MLLMs while reducing training and inference overhead.

recommendation.zh: 视频MLLM的潜推理训练思路可参考，但属于增量改进，核心是后训练侧技巧，看摘要和方法部分即可。
recommendation.en: The latent reasoning training idea for video MLLMs is worth referencing, but it is an incremental improvement focused on post-training tricks; read the abstract and method section only.

paper.title: AIR: Adaptive Interleaved Reasoning with Code in MLLMs
paper.abstract: Following the paradigm shift initiated by OpenAI o3, interleaved reasoning with code to enhance multimodal large language models (MLLMs) has become a pivotal research frontier. The existing literature focuses primarily on tool-use within vision-perception tasks. However, such approaches typically rely on predefined heuristics for visual manipulation and are inherently incapable of addressing numerical computation problems due to their exclusive focus on visual operations. This paper empowers MLL

summary.core_problem: OpenAI o3 之后，多模态大模型的交错推理研究大多局限在旋转、缩放等视觉操作类工具，依赖预定义启发式做视觉处理，既无法覆盖需要精确数值计算的多模态数学推理场景，也缺少让模型自主判断“何时调用代码工具、何时纯文本推理”的自适应机制；同时小模型难以冷启动工具调用能力，agentic RL 在工具使用比例升高时容易出现训练不稳定甚至模型崩溃。
summary.technical_approach: AIR 框架分为冷启动 SFT 与交错推理 RL 两个训练阶段，配套三条技术线。第一，两阶段冷启动数据构造：先让 MLLM 生成纯文本 CoT 推理路径，再用 LLM 把 CoT 重写为插入代码调用的交错推理格式，最后做代码执行完整性与结果正确性的校验；这种解耦式生成避免了单步合成在多模态场景下推理深度不足、效率低的问题。第二，双轨数据过滤：Self-Sampled 策略对 SFT 模型做多轮 rollout，用 Pass@k 作为候选样本的准入门槛，通过目标模型自身的多轮共识过滤噪声；Prior-Filtered 策略作为补充，用强能力教师模型做外部质量门控，进一步筛除低质量交错推理样本。第三，带组约束的 GRPO 奖励机制：在 RL 阶段对工具调用行为加分组约束，引导模型自适应判断是否需要调用工具、选择合适的调用时机；该约束同时抑制了工具使用率升高时的训练波动，缓解了 agentic RL 长期训练不稳定的问题。
summary.experiments: 实验围绕多模态复杂数值计算与数学推理任务展开。冷启动阶段，两阶段数据构造相比单步合成，在代码可执行率与最终答案准确率上都有明显提升；双轨过滤相比无过滤或单轨过滤，显著降低了 SFT 数据中的噪声比例，后续 RL 的收敛速度更快。RL 阶段，带组约束的 GRPO 相比普通 GRPO：一是自适应工具调用率更合理，不会出现过度调用或不调用的极端情况，在需要计算的题目上准确率提升显著；二是训练曲线更平稳，在工具使用比例较高的设置下没有出现普通 GRPO 常见的 reward 震荡与模型崩溃现象。论文还做了消融，分别验证了两阶段数据构造的解耦收益、双轨过滤各自的贡献、以及组约束在自适应调用与训练稳定性两方面的独立作用。
summary.reading_guide: 精读顺序建议：先读方法章节 3.1 整体架构图与 3.2 冷启动数据构造部分，重点理解“先生成 CoT 再重写交错推理”的解耦设计，这是整套方案能低成本落地的关键；接着读 3.3 RL 部分的组约束奖励设计，尤其关注作者对“自适应工具调用为何能稳定训练”的观察与分析，这是超出预期的训练动态发现；然后看实验章节的主结果表与训练曲线，对比普通 GRPO 在高工具使用率下的崩溃现象，判断组约束的实际作用强度；最后补读附录中的数据样例与失败案例，评估这套数据 pipeline 的可迁移边界。核心创新集中在数据构造解耦、双轨过滤、组约束 GRPO 三处，值得深挖的点是 agentic RL 中工具调用行为与训练稳定性之间的因果关系，以及该机制是否能迁移到纯文本或其他工具类型的 RL 训练中。

summary_en.core_problem: Since OpenAI o3, interleaved reasoning research on MLLMs has been mostly limited to visual-operation tools such as rotation and zoom, which rely on predefined heuristics for visual processing. They cannot cover multimodal mathematical reasoning scenarios requiring precise numerical computation, and lack an adaptive mechanism for the model to autonomously decide when to invoke code tools versus perform pure textual reasoning. In addition, smaller models struggle to cold-start tool-use capability, and agentic RL often suffers from training instability or even model collapse as the tool-use ratio rises.
summary_en.importance: The work impacts pretraining research on three levels. First, it extends the interleaved reasoning paradigm initiated by o3 from pure-text and visual-only tools to the MLLM + Python code invocation scenario for numerical computation, filling the capability gap of non-visual tools in multimodal agentic RL and providing a reproducible training recipe for multimodal foundations to move from perception-reasoning to a perception-computation-reasoning closed loop. Second, the combined recipe of cold-start data construction, dual-track data filtering, and group-constrained GRPO directly addresses two engineering pain points: the difficulty of activating tool use in small models, and the long-term instability of agentic RL. The unexpected finding that adaptive tool use actually stabilizes training offers practical reference for analyzing training dynamics in RL pretrain. Third, the entire pipeline is open-source implementable and does not depend on proprietary capabilities of closed-source models, providing direct engineering guidance for the community to reproduce o3-style multimodal reasoning models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The AIR framework has two training stages: cold-start SFT and interleaved reasoning RL, supported by three technical lines. First, two-stage cold-start data construction: an MLLM first generates pure-text CoT reasoning traces, then an LLM rewrites the CoT into interleaved reasoning format with inserted code calls, followed by verification of code execution integrity and answer correctness. This decoupled generation avoids the insufficient reasoning depth and low efficiency of one-step synthesis in multimodal scenarios. Second, dual-track data filtering: the Self-Sampled strategy performs multiple rollouts on the SFT model and uses Pass@k as the admission threshold for candidate samples, filtering noise through multi-turn consensus of the target model itself; the Prior-Filtered strategy acts as a complement, using a strong teacher model as an external quality gate to further remove low-quality interleaved reasoning samples. Third, group-constrained GRPO reward mechanism: group constraints are applied to tool-use behavior during RL, guiding the model to adaptively judge whether tool invocation is needed and choose the right timing. This constraint also suppresses training fluctuations when tool-use rate increases, mitigating long-term instability in agentic RL.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments focus on multimodal complex numerical computation and mathematical reasoning tasks. In the cold-start stage, two-stage data construction delivers clear improvements over one-step synthesis in code executability and final answer accuracy. Dual-track filtering, compared with no filtering or single-track filtering, significantly reduces noise in SFT data and leads to faster convergence in subsequent RL. In the RL stage, group-constrained GRPO outperforms vanilla GRPO in two aspects: adaptive tool-use rate is more reasonable, without extreme over-use or non-use, and accuracy on problems requiring computation improves notably; training curves are smoother, with no reward oscillation or model collapse under high tool-use settings, which is common in vanilla GRPO. Ablations separately verify the decoupling benefit of two-stage data construction, the individual contributions of the two filtering tracks, and the independent effects of the group constraint on both adaptive invocation and training stability.
summary_en.reading_guide: Recommended close-reading order: start with Section 3.1's overall architecture diagram and Section 3.2 on cold-start data construction, focusing on the decoupled design of 'generate CoT first, then rewrite into interleaved reasoning' — this is the key to the low-cost deployability of the whole recipe. Then read the group-constrained reward design in the RL part of Section 3.3, paying special attention to the authors' observation and analysis of why adaptive tool use stabilizes training; this is an unexpected training-dynamics finding. Next, examine the main result tables and training curves in the experiments section, comparing the collapse phenomenon of vanilla GRPO under high tool-use rates to judge the actual strength of the group constraint. Finally, read the data samples and failure cases in the appendix to assess the transfer boundary of this data pipeline. The core innovations concentrate on three pieces: decoupled data construction, dual-track filtering, and group-constrained GRPO. A worthwhile deep-dive direction is the causal relationship between tool-use behavior and training stability in agentic RL, and whether this mechanism transfers to pure-text RL or RL with other tool types.

recommendation.zh: 更像多模态 RL/tool-use 配方，预训练研究员只需看数据过滤和奖励约束，别把它当基座范式变化。
recommendation.en: This is a multimodal RL/tool-use recipe; read the data filtering and reward constraints, not as a base-model paradigm shift.

paper.title: StylisticBias: A Few Human Visual Cues Drive Most Social Biases in MLLMs
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly deployed in personally and societally consequential settings, yet the visual cues that shape how these models judge people remain poorly understood. Prior work often compares different (groups of) individuals, making it difficult to separate appearance effects from identity differences. We introduce StylisticBias, a controlled benchmark for evaluating attribute-level social bias in MLLMs. We generate 500 photorealistic base faces and crea

summary.core_problem: 在多模态大模型的人物判断中，究竟哪些视觉线索真正驱动社会偏见，而不是被身份差异混淆。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是一个控制变量更干净的 MLLM 偏见评测基准。对基座研究的价值不在安全结论本身，而在于它展示了如何用单属性干预把视觉因果因素从 identity confound 中拆出来。
summary.technical_approach: 作者生成 500 个逼真基础人脸，并对每张脸做约 50 种单属性编辑，得到约 25K 图像。这样在固定身份的前提下只改变一个视觉属性，再在 25 个二元社会判断任务上评测 6 个 MLLM，量化各属性对模型判断的影响。
summary.experiments: 评测对象为 6 个 MLLM，数据约 25K 图像、25 个判断场景。核心发现是年龄和体型主导 identity-level 效应，而穿衣风格等属性带来最大的 attribute-level 偏移；约 15 个属性解释了近 80% 的总体偏见。这里没有预训练规模或 recipe 结论。
summary.authors_note: 来自 Technical University of Munich、Munich Center for Machine Learning、Princeton Center for Information and Technology Policy。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks which visual cues actually drive social bias in MLLMs, disentangled from identity differences.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is a cleaner benchmark for MLLM bias analysis. The value for foundation-model researchers is methodological: single-attribute interventions isolate causal visual factors instead of conflating them with identity.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors generate 500 photorealistic base faces and create around 50 single-attribute edits per face, yielding about 25K images. This keeps identity fixed while changing one visual cue at a time, then evaluates six MLLMs on 25 binary social judgment tasks.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark covers six MLLMs, roughly 25K images, and 25 judgment scenarios. The headline finding is that age and body type dominate identity-level effects, while fashion style and related cues drive the largest attribute-level shifts; about 15 attributes explain nearly 80% of total bias. There is no direct pretraining-scale or recipe insight.
summary_en.authors_note: From Technical University of Munich, Munich Center for Machine Learning, and Princeton Center for Information and Technology Policy.

recommendation.zh: 不是预训练论文，但 benchmark 设计比常见 bias work 干净得多；只看数据构造和 attribution 统计，别在安全结论上过度外推。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the benchmark design is cleaner than most bias work; read the data construction and attribution stats, not the broad safety claims.

institutions: Princeton Center for Information and Technology Policy

paper.title: ELVA: Exploring Ranking-Driven Universal Multimodal Retrieval
paper.abstract: Leveraging Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) via contrastive learning has become a mainstream paradigm for improving the performance of Universal Multimodal Retrieval (UMR). However, previous works have ignored the grain blindness when adapting the contrastive paradigm into retrieval tasks. Grain blindness refers to the tendency of the model to overlook grain-level information contained in the query, which is crucial for effectively handling complex queries. This stems from contrastive le

summary.core_problem: 解决通用多模态检索中复杂查询的粒度信息被对比学习忽略的问题，尤其是不同负样本对查询细节的约束被统一当成二分类信号处理。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态检索训练目标改造。它不是基座预训练工作，但对图文对齐、hard negative 设计、检索式 VLM 训练有一些可迁移信号。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ELVA，一个规则驱动的 RL 框架，将负样本按与正样本的相似度或排序关系区分处理，让模型从不同负样本中学习不同粒度的信息，而不是只做正负样本二分类对比。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出具体模型规模、数据规模、benchmark 名称和提升幅度。可确认的是论文面向 Universal Multimodal Retrieval，并与主流对比学习式 MLLM 检索方法比较。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets grain blindness in universal multimodal retrieval, where contrastive training collapses different negative samples into a binary positive-versus-negative signal and misses fine-grained query constraints.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a training-objective modification for multimodal retrieval. It is not a foundation pretraining paper, but it is mildly relevant to image-text alignment, hard-negative construction, and retrieval-oriented VLM training.
summary_en.technical_approach: ELVA is introduced as a rule-based RL framework that treats negatives according to their ranking or similarity to the positive sample, so the model can extract different grain-level information from different negatives instead of relying on a flat contrastive objective.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, data scale, benchmark names, or exact gains. It states that the method is evaluated for universal multimodal retrieval against mainstream contrastive-learning MLLM retrieval approaches.

recommendation.zh: 只看负样本排序建模部分；对预训练没直接增益，但能提醒检索对齐别把所有 negatives 当同一种信号。
recommendation.en: Skim only the negative-ranking formulation; it is not pretraining work, but it is a useful reminder that retrieval alignment should not collapse all negatives into one signal.

paper.title: ROSE: Benchmarking the Perception-to-Action Gap in Multimodal Models
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly expected to act on visual information, yet the same scene may require different actions under different task contexts. How reliably can a model turn the same visual evidence into the action required by the current context? To answer this question, we introduce \textsc{ROSE} (\textbf{R}eference-conditioned \textbf{O}ddity and \textbf{S}ymbolic \textbf{E}xecution), a controlled benchmark that holds the visual scene fixed while varying regio

summary.core_problem: 评测多模态模型能否在视觉证据不变、任务语境变化时，把感知结果稳定地转成正确动作。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是 benchmark。它不再只测“看见了没有”，而是测“在不同任务约束下能不能把同一视觉输入映射成不同正确动作”，这对多模态 agent 和视觉-语言接口评估是有意义的。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ROSE 基准，通过固定场景、改变区域约束与符号输出要求，构造 coupled counting 与 coordinate-action 任务，专门测 perception-to-action gap。设计上强调控制变量：视觉场景相同，只改任务上下文，因此更容易把错误归因到动作映射而非感知失败。
summary.experiments: 在 9 个近期 MLLM 上测试，论文称从计数任务到区域条件动作任务，性能最高下降 44.5 个百分点，而人类可达 98.8%。结果说明不少模型在“看懂”与“按上下文行动”之间存在明显断层。未见与预训练配方、数据或架构的直接联动分析。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether multimodal models can reliably convert the same visual evidence into different correct actions when task context changes.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is a benchmark. Instead of only testing perception, it isolates the perception-to-action interface under controlled context shifts, which is relevant for multimodal agents and action-grounded MLLMs.
summary_en.technical_approach: ROSE fixes the visual scene while varying region constraints and symbolic output requirements, creating paired counting and coordinate-action tasks. This controlled design makes it easier to attribute failures to action mapping rather than raw perception.
summary_en.experiments: Across nine recent MLLMs, the paper reports drops of up to 44.5 percentage points from counting-oriented tasks to region-conditioned action, while humans reach 98.8%. The result suggests a substantial gap between seeing and acting, though the paper does not directly connect this to pretraining recipes or architecture choices.

recommendation.zh: 这是个干净的评测切口：把视觉理解和动作映射拆开测；预训练研究员只需看任务构造和误差分解，不必细读全篇。
recommendation.en: A clean benchmark slice: it separates visual understanding from action mapping; for pretraining folks, the task design and failure decomposition are the only parts worth reading.

paper.title: SpatialSV: Internalizing Interpretable 3D Spatial Awareness in MLLMs via Task-Oriented Visual Supervision
paper.abstract: Unlocking the spatial intelligence of multimodal large language model (MLLMs) is crucial for understanding and interacting with the 3D world. Prevailing approaches typically inject spatial priors via external tools, which impose significant inference overhead, or rely on latent feature distillation, which remains uninterpretable and lacks fine-grained geometric constraints. To address these issues, we propose SpatialSV, a framework designed to internalize robust 3D spatial awareness within MLLMs

summary.core_problem: 让 MLLM 在不依赖外部 3D 工具的情况下，内化可解释的 3D 空间理解能力。
summary.importance: 贡献是 VLM/MLLM 空间能力训练方法：把隐式视觉特征对齐改成显式 2D-to-3D 任务监督，使模型产生深度图、相机位姿和点云等可检查中间表征。它对 native multimodal pretraining 有一定参考，但更像能力注入与监督设计。
summary.technical_approach: SpatialSV 使用 task-oriented visual supervision，要求模型主动把 2D 视觉特征提升为显式 3D 表示，而不是只做被动特征蒸馏。显式 3D 重建结果同时作为诊断窗口，用于观察模型空间表征是否与几何约束一致。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、训练集规模、基线和数值提升；预期实验包括 3D 空间问答、深度/位姿/点云相关任务，以及与外部工具注入和 latent feature distillation 方法的比较。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to internalize interpretable 3D spatial awareness in MLLMs without relying on external 3D tools at inference time.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a training design for VLM/MLLM spatial competence: replacing opaque feature imitation with explicit 2D-to-3D supervision over depth, camera pose, and point clouds. It is relevant to native multimodal pretraining, but mainly as a capability-injection recipe.
summary_en.technical_approach: SpatialSV uses task-oriented visual supervision that forces the model to lift 2D visual features into explicit 3D representations. The resulting reconstructions serve both as training targets and as an interpretable diagnostic proxy for the model's internal spatial representation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide parameter count, data scale, baselines, or numerical gains. The likely evaluation covers 3D spatial reasoning, depth/pose/point-cloud tasks, and comparisons with external-tool-based methods and latent feature distillation.

recommendation.zh: 可扫方法图和监督头设计；显式几何监督对 VLM 预训练有参考，但还没到改变训练范式的程度。
recommendation.en: Skim the method diagram and supervision heads; explicit geometry targets are useful for VLM pretraining, but this does not change the training paradigm.

paper.title: See First, Answer Later: Visual Evidence Pre-Alignment via Sufficiency-Driven RL
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) integrate strong text reasoning with visual inputs, yet their responses can be inconsistent with the underlying images, indicating ineffective utilization of visual evidence during inference. The prevailing training paradigm relies on large-scale caption-based pretraining for general alignment, followed by supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning to enable instruction following and complex reasoning. However, such pretraining provides only weak v

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 MLLM 在回答视觉问题时“看了图但没真正用好图”的问题。更具体地说，现有训练流程通常先做图文预训练，再做指令微调和 RL，但预训练阶段主要依赖短 caption，监督信号偏粗，模型容易学到场景级对齐，却学不到对细粒度属性、关系、局部区域和题目相关证据的稳定提取能力。结果是在推理时，模型更像是在做 P(a|q) 的语言先验补全，而不是可靠地做 P(a|v,q)。作者想解决的不是单个 benchmark 上的答题技巧，而是把“先找足够的视觉证据，再作答”变成一个独立训练目标，并把它放在 pretrain 与 post-train 之间，作为专门补强视觉 grounding 的中间阶段。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的意义主要有两点。第一，它提出了一个清楚的训练接口：把视觉感知能力的补强从任务级回答监督里拆出来，单独优化一个 question-conditioned evidence policy。这种做法对多模态预训练很有启发，因为它不是继续堆更密的 caption，也不是直接在答案上做更强监督，而是引入一个中间变量，把“看见什么”与“如何回答”分开。第二，它给出了一种较低标注成本的路径：利用现成 QA 数据，通过 frozen blind reader 判断证据是否足以恢复答案，从而把 answer supervision 转成 evidence supervision。这个思路对预训练—后训练接口、latent reasoning、以及多模态 RL 信号设计都有参考价值。量级上，它更像是一个训练范式上的中等强度贡献，而不是基础架构改写；价值在于训练目标设计和阶段划分比较干净。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 VEPA，Visual Evidence Pre-Alignment。作者把原来的直接回答分解成两步：先由 MLLM 根据图像和问题生成文本形式的 visual evidence，再由一个只看问题和证据、完全不看图的 blind reader 去恢复答案。形式上，相当于把 P(a|v,q) 分解为 P(e|v,q) 和 P(a|e,q)。这里 e 被当作信息瓶颈，训练目标要求它同时满足两个条件：一是 sufficiency，即给定问题后，证据里要有足够信息让 reader 推出正确答案；二是 visual dependence，即证据必须真的依赖图像，而不是把答案直接泄露出来，或者退化成模板化空话。

训练上作者采用 GRPO 来优化 evidence generation policy。每个样本会生成一组候选 evidence，由 group-relative 的方式做相对奖励学习。奖励设计是全文最关键的部分，不只是“reader 答对就给分”。作者显式加入了几类约束来避免训练走偏：其一，防止 answer leakage，避免模型直接把答案或近似答案塞进 evidence，导致 reader 成为形式上的验证器；其二，惩罚重复、冗余、退化的 evidence，避免 RL 常见的 verbosity 或 pattern collapse；其三，强调 sufficiency 而不是最终 answer generation，把视觉 grounding 与回答策略解耦。这样做的原因很明确：如果直接对最终答案做 RL，模型仍可能靠语言先验、题目模式或 shortcut 获得奖励，无法保证视觉证据真的被编码。

从训练流程看，VEPA 被放在 caption pretraining 之后、SFT/RL 之前，属于一个中间对齐阶段。它不要求额外的人类 dense caption 标注，而是复用现有 VQA/QA 数据。与“直接用更长 caption 继续预训练”相比，VEPA 的差异在于监督是 question-conditioned 的。也就是说，模型不是被要求穷举描述整张图，而是学习围绕当前问题抽取足够且必要的视觉证据。这比静态 dense caption 更接近推理时的真实信息需求，也更节省表示带宽。
summary.experiments:
从引言和方法部分能确认的实验结论是：VEPA 在多类视觉要求较高的评测上都优于标准训练 recipe，覆盖 knowledge-intensive VQA、compositional VQA、fine-grained perception 和 holistic multimodal evaluation，并且收益不仅出现在单一 backbone。作者还强调，增益来自视觉感知增强，而不是额外任务监督，因为训练只引入了 evidence-level RL 目标，没有增加新的人工标注类型。

全文片段里没有给出完整表格数字、参数量和数据规模，因此不能编造具体提升幅度。但从作者描述的 ablation 重点可以提炼出几条关键信息：第一，blind reader 作为冻结评估器是必要的，它让奖励聚焦在“证据是否足够”，而不是让同一个模型自洽打分；第二，answer leakage 抑制项是必要的，否则 evidence 会退化成隐式答案通道；第三，性能提升在 OOD 数据上仍能保留，说明学到的不是 benchmark-specific 的答题模板，而是更稳定的视觉 grounding。若阅读全文，最值得核对的是主表里不同 benchmark 的提升分布、reward 各项消融、以及 evidence 质量的定性案例，因为这些决定了方法到底是在提升感知，还是只是在改变输出风格。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇更适合泛读方法设计，而不是逐行抠公式。建议先看 Introduction 和 Preliminary，抓住作者为什么要把视觉证据单独建模，以及 sufficiency / visual dependence 这两个约束分别在防什么问题。然后重点看方法部分里 reward 设计和 GRPO 训练细节，尤其是如何定义 answer leakage、如何处理重复和退化 evidence、group sampling 怎么做。实验部分优先看三类内容：主结果表、reward/reader/阶段位置的消融、以及 evidence 可视化案例。阅读时间大约 25 到 40 分钟。如果你关心多模态预训练接口，值得额外想两个问题：一是 evidence 作为文本瓶颈会不会限制视觉信息上限；二是这种中间阶段能否推广到视频、语音或 unified multimodal pretraining。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a persistent failure mode in MLLMs: they answer visual questions with weak grounding, even when the image is available. The authors argue that the standard recipe—caption-based pretraining followed by instruction tuning and RL—builds only coarse alignment. Short captions emphasize salient objects and global scene summaries, but they do not train the model to reliably extract fine-grained, question-relevant evidence such as attributes, relations, and small regions. As a result, inference often drifts toward language-prior-driven answering rather than genuine image-conditioned reasoning. The paper tries to fix this by introducing an explicit intermediate objective: before learning how to answer better, train the model to produce sufficient visual evidence for the question.
summary_en.importance: For pretraining-oriented readers, the main contribution is not a new VQA trick but a cleaner training decomposition. The work inserts a dedicated stage between multimodal pretraining and post-training, and optimizes a question-conditioned evidence policy instead of relying on answer supervision to indirectly improve perception. That is a useful design pattern for multimodal foundation models: separate 'what visual information should be extracted' from 'how to produce the final answer.' A second contribution is the supervision mechanism. The method reuses existing QA data and converts answer labels into evidence-level rewards through a frozen blind reader, avoiding the need for dense human annotations. The impact is moderate but real: this is a training-objective and stage-design contribution, with implications for multimodal grounding, latent-variable formulations, and RL signal design at the pretrain/post-train boundary.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method, VEPA (Visual Evidence Pre-Alignment), factorizes answering into two steps. First, the MLLM generates textual visual evidence conditioned on the image and the question. Second, a frozen blind reader—an LLM that does not see the image—receives only the question and the generated evidence, and tries to recover the ground-truth answer. In probabilistic terms, the paper rewrites direct answering as a decomposition through a latent bottleneck e: an evidence policy P(e|v,q) followed by a reasoning policy P(a|e,q). The bottleneck is intentional. It forces the model to externalize the visual content that is actually needed for answering.

The optimization target is built around two properties. Sufficiency means the evidence should contain enough information for the blind reader to infer the answer. Visual dependence means the evidence must genuinely come from the image rather than from question priors or direct answer leakage. To train the evidence policy, the paper uses GRPO. For each sample, the model generates a group of candidate evidence sequences, and learning is driven by relative rewards within the group.

The reward design is the critical part. The paper does not simply reward the reader for getting the answer right. It adds constraints to prevent degenerate solutions: penalties against answer leakage, so the evidence cannot collapse into a disguised answer channel; penalties against repetitive or low-information evidence, so RL does not reward verbosity or templated outputs; and a decoupling between grounding and final answer generation, so the optimization pressure stays on evidence quality rather than downstream response style. This is the main difference from direct answer-level RL, where the model can still exploit shortcuts from language priors. Compared with replacing captions by dense descriptions, VEPA is also different in supervision structure: the evidence is question-conditioned, not a static attempt to describe the whole image. That makes it closer to actual inference-time information needs and more bandwidth-efficient than generic dense captioning.
summary_en.experiments:
From the available full-text content, the paper reports consistent gains over the standard training recipe across several visually demanding settings, including knowledge-intensive VQA, compositional VQA, fine-grained perception, and broader multimodal evaluation. The improvements are said to hold across different backbones, which matters because the claim is about training strategy rather than a backbone-specific trick.

The excerpt does not include the full result tables, model sizes, or dataset scales, so precise numbers should not be invented. Still, the experimental story is clear. First, the frozen blind reader is important because it turns answer supervision into a sufficiency test for evidence, instead of letting the same model self-validate. Second, anti-leakage reward terms are necessary; otherwise the evidence channel can degenerate into direct answer transmission. Third, the gains transfer to out-of-distribution settings, which supports the claim that VEPA improves grounding rather than merely fitting benchmark-specific answer patterns. When reading the full paper, the most important checks are: how gains distribute across perception-heavy versus reasoning-heavy benchmarks, how strong the ablations are for each reward component, and whether the qualitative evidence examples truly show better visual extraction rather than just longer outputs.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is a skim paper, so the goal is to understand the training idea rather than every implementation detail. Start with the Introduction and Preliminary sections. They explain why caption pretraining is insufficient and why the paper introduces a latent evidence variable. Then focus on the method section, especially the reward construction: how sufficiency is measured, how answer leakage is detected, and how repetitive evidence is discouraged. In experiments, prioritize the main benchmark table, the ablations on reward components and blind-reader design, and the qualitative evidence examples. Expected reading time is around 25–40 minutes. If you work on multimodal pretraining, two follow-up questions are worth keeping in mind: whether a textual evidence bottleneck limits the ceiling of visual information, and whether the same intermediate stage could be generalized to video, audio, or unified multimodal pretraining.

recommendation.zh: 只看 reward 定义和 ablation；若控制干净，它支持“先证据对齐再推理”的 VLM 后训练 recipe。
recommendation.en: Read the reward definition and ablations; if the controls are clean, it supports a useful VLM recipe of evidence alignment before reasoning.

paper.title: MLLMs Get It Right, Then Get It Wrong: Tracing and Correcting Late-Layer Textual Bias
paper.abstract: When vision contradicts text, multimodal large language models (MLLMs) consistently favor text, even when images provide clear evidence otherwise. This bias poses risks for applications requiring visual grounding, yet its cause remains unclear. In this paper, we uncover a surprising finding: models often get it right initially, forming correct vision-based predictions in their intermediate layers, before changing their minds and favoring text in the final output. We call this "late-layer textual

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究的是 MLLM 在图文冲突场景下为什么会“明明看到了图像证据，最后却还是跟着文本走”。已有工作大多停留在现象描述：文本会压过视觉。但真正关键的问题是机制位置在哪里——是视觉信息一开始就没编码进去，还是中间融合失败，还是后层把已经形成的视觉判断覆盖掉。作者沿层追踪后给出的结论很明确：很多失败样本里，模型在中间层其实已经偏向正确的视觉答案，错误发生在更后面的层，表现为 late-layer textual override。也就是说，问题不完全是“不会看”，而是“看到了但没保住”。
summary.importance: 这项工作的价值主要在机制分析和训练后解码接口两方面。对多模态基座研究来说，它把“文本偏置”从一个行为学现象推进到可定位的内部动力学：偏置并非总在早期形成，而可能是后层决策重写。这个判断会直接影响改进路径。如果问题出在编码，应该改视觉表征和对齐训练；如果问题出在后层覆盖，则可以从层间信息保真、解码策略、损失设计和后训练数据配比入手。第二，作者提出的修正方法是 training-free 的，说明模型内部已经包含可恢复的视觉证据，推理时只要识别有害覆盖并回收中间层信号，就能改善冲突任务表现。这对理解“模型知道但没说出来”的现象很有启发，也和 LLM 中间层 logit lens、early exit、representation steering 一类思路形成呼应。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分两部分。第一部分是诊断。作者把每一层隐藏状态投影到输出词表，观察答案分布如何随深度变化。为量化视觉与文本哪一方占优，他们定义了 Modal Dominance Ratio，核心是比较图像支持答案 w_vis 和文本支持答案 w_text 在当前层输出分布中的相对偏好。这样可以得到一条 layer-wise modal preference 曲线。结果显示，在不少 conflict-incorrect 样本中，MDR 在中间层仍偏向视觉，到了后层才翻转为偏向文本。作者进一步发现，单纯发生“后层转向”并不等于错误，因为成功样本也会发生转向；真正有判别力的是转向方向：失败样本大多朝文本方向移动，成功样本大多朝视觉方向移动。第二部分是修正。作者提出 CALRD，核心思想是找到输出分布变化最剧烈的 transition layer，把它当作尚未被覆盖的锚点层。然后用两个信号决定是否以及多大程度把该层 logits 混回最终输出：anchor confidence 衡量锚点层预测有多确定，prediction retention 衡量该预测是否保留到最终层。如果锚点层很自信，但最终层没有保住这个预测，就判定为可能发生了有害覆盖，于是对最终 logits 做自适应融合；如果后层变化看起来是有益 refinement，则尽量不干预。与直接 ensemble 多层输出不同，CALRD 的关键在于它只在检测到“高置信锚点 + 低保留”的覆盖模式时介入，因此目标是纠正后层错误重写，而不是普遍削弱深层推理。
summary.experiments: 论文构建了 Conflict-VQA 作为诊断基准，共 5,969 个样本，带有显式的 (w_vis, w_text) 标注，并为同一图像问题配对一致上下文和冲突上下文。数据来自 VrR-VG 图像和 TDIUC 问题，覆盖 object presence、color、attribute、counting、spatial reasoning、activity recognition 六类。机制分析里最关键的数字有两个：在失败样本中，85% 的预测转向朝文本方向；在成功样本中，89% 的转向朝视觉方向。这说明“转向方向”比“是否转向”更有诊断价值。方法评测覆盖五个 MLLM，从 InstructBLIP 到 Qwen3-VL，说明现象并非某一架构特有。CALRD 在冲突任务上带来最高 9.4% 的提升，同时对常规非冲突性能影响较小。阅读正文时建议重点核对三类实验：一，MDR 曲线在不同模型上的一致性；二，anchor confidence 和 prediction retention 两个信号各自的消融，以及不用自适应门控时是否会伤害正常样本；三，Conflict-VQA 之外是否在已有冲突 benchmark 上复现同样趋势。如果论文给了按题型拆分结果，颜色、属性、计数这类更依赖局部视觉证据的类别通常最能说明问题。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇适合泛读偏精读。先看方法分析部分，弄清 MDR 的定义和 transition layer 的定位方式，这是整篇的支点。然后看 Figure 1 一类的层间轨迹图，直观看模型如何先偏向视觉再被文本拉回。接着读 CALRD 的公式和伪代码，重点不是融合本身，而是它如何区分“有害覆盖”和“有益后层修正”。实验部分优先看 Conflict-VQA 构造、主结果表、以及两个诊断信号的消融。预计 30-45 分钟可以读完主线。如果你关心多模态预训练或后训练配比，这篇值得再往深处想两个问题：文本偏置究竟来自预训练语料中的语言先验，还是来自 instruction tuning 阶段对文本遵循的过强化；以及这种 late-layer override 能否通过训练目标而不是解码修补来系统缓解。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a mechanistic question behind a well-known MLLM failure mode: when image evidence conflicts with text, why do models often follow the text? Prior work mostly documented the behavior. The key unresolved issue is where the failure happens. Is visual information never encoded well, lost during fusion, or correctly formed and then overwritten later? The paper’s main finding is that many failures belong to the third category. In a substantial fraction of conflict cases, intermediate layers already favor the correct vision-grounded answer, but later layers reverse that preference and produce the text-supported answer. The authors call this late-layer textual override.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is strongest as a mechanistic analysis with a practical decoding consequence. For multimodal foundation models, it moves textual bias from a surface-level behavioral observation to an internal processing diagnosis: the problem is often not that the model cannot see, but that later computation does not preserve what it has seen. That distinction matters because it changes the intervention space. If the issue were weak visual encoding, one would focus on representation learning or cross-modal alignment. If the issue is late overwrite, then layerwise retention, decoding, objective design, and post-training data balance become more relevant. The second important point is that the proposed fix is training-free. This suggests that useful visual evidence is already present inside the model and can be recovered at inference time, which connects naturally to broader ideas such as logit lens analysis, early-exit behavior, and representation steering.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method has two parts: diagnosis and correction. For diagnosis, the authors project hidden states from each layer into output probabilities and track how answer preference evolves with depth. They define Modal Dominance Ratio (MDR) to quantify whether a layer prefers the image-supported answer w_vis or the text-supported answer w_text. This yields a layerwise trajectory of modal preference. In many conflict-incorrect examples, MDR is positive in intermediate layers, indicating visual preference, and turns negative only in later layers, indicating a shift toward text. The authors further show that the mere existence of a late shift is not enough to predict failure, because successful examples also shift. What matters is the direction of the shift: failures usually move toward text, while successes usually move toward vision. For correction, they propose Conflict-Aware Layer Reference Decoding (CALRD). The method identifies the transition layer where the output distribution changes most sharply and treats it as an anchor layer that still contains the pre-override prediction. It then computes two signals: anchor confidence, which measures how certain the anchor-layer prediction is, and prediction retention, which measures whether that prediction survives to the final layer. When the anchor is confident but poorly retained, CALRD interprets this as harmful override and blends anchor-layer logits back into the final distribution with adaptive strength. When late-layer processing appears beneficial, it leaves the output mostly unchanged. This is more selective than naive multi-layer ensembling because it aims to correct only harmful overwriting rather than weakening deep computation in general.
summary_en.experiments: The paper introduces Conflict-VQA, a diagnostic benchmark with 5,969 samples and explicit annotations for both the image-supported answer and the text-supported answer. Each image-question pair is paired with both consistent and conflicting contexts. Images come from VrR-VG and questions from TDIUC, covering six categories: object presence, color, attribute, counting, spatial reasoning, and activity recognition. Two headline mechanistic numbers are central: among failures, 85% of prediction shifts move toward text, while among successes, 89% move toward vision. This shows that shift direction is more informative than shift occurrence. The evaluation spans five MLLMs, from InstructBLIP to Qwen3-VL, suggesting that the phenomenon is not architecture-specific. CALRD yields up to 9.4% improvement on conflict tasks while largely preserving standard performance on non-conflict settings. When reading the full paper, the most important experimental checks are: whether MDR trajectories are consistent across model families, whether anchor confidence and prediction retention each contribute in ablations, whether non-adaptive blending hurts clean examples, and whether the same pattern holds beyond Conflict-VQA on existing conflict benchmarks.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is worth a careful skim, close to a light deep read. Start with the analysis section and make sure the definition of MDR is clear, because it is the backbone of the paper. Then inspect the layerwise trajectory figures that show the model initially favoring the visual answer before drifting toward text. After that, read the CALRD equations and pseudocode. The important point is not the blending operation itself, but how the method distinguishes harmful override from beneficial late-layer refinement. In the experiments, prioritize the Conflict-VQA construction, the main results table, and the ablations on the two diagnostic signals. Around 30-45 minutes should be enough to capture the main contribution. If your interest is in multimodal pretraining or post-training, two follow-up questions are worth thinking about: whether the bias is rooted mainly in language-heavy pretraining priors or in instruction tuning that over-rewards textual compliance, and whether this late-layer override can be reduced during training rather than only patched at decoding time.

recommendation.zh: 揭示了 MLLM 内部视觉特征在深层被文本特征覆盖的机制，对多模态对齐和 decoding 策略有启发，值得看其 layer-wise 分析。
recommendation.en: Reveals the mechanism of 'late-layer textual override' in MLLMs, offering insights for multimodal alignment and decoding strategies; the layer-wise analysis is worth reading.

paper.title: Stepwise Token Selection for Efficient Multimodal Large Language Models
paper.abstract: In multimodal large language models (MLLMs), inference cost is largely dominated by the visual token prefix rather than the language backbone, making token reduction a key factor for improving efficiency. Existing approaches typically assign independent importance scores to visual tokens and retain a fixed number of top-ranked tokens, implicitly assuming token independence and a uniform compression ratio across inputs. In this work, we reformulate visual token pruning as a sequential decision-ma

summary.core_problem: 降低 MLLM 推理中视觉 token 前缀带来的计算开销，同时避免固定 top-k 剪枝忽略 token 依赖和样本差异。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理效率方法改进。它不直接改变预训练范式，但对原生多模态模型的 token budget、视觉前缀压缩和端到端可训练剪枝有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 把视觉 token 剪枝重写为序列决策问题：用 pointer-style selection 逐步选择 token，每一步条件化于已选 token；再加入 learned termination action 动态决定保留数量。为接入标准语言建模目标，使用基于 variance-preserving noise interpolation 的可微松弛，使选择模块可端到端训练。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、具体 MLLM backbone、训练数据或提升幅度。实验应主要比较独立打分 top-k、固定压缩率剪枝和动态停止的 cost-quality trade-off。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to reduce the inference cost of MLLMs dominated by long visual-token prefixes, without relying on fixed top-k pruning that ignores token dependency and input-level variation.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency method. It does not directly change pretraining, but it is relevant to token budgeting, visual-prefix compression, and trainable pruning for native multimodal models.
summary_en.technical_approach: It reformulates visual-token pruning as sequential decision making: a pointer-style selector chooses tokens step by step, each decision conditioned on previously selected tokens, and a learned termination action decides the retained set size. A differentiable relaxation based on variance-preserving noise interpolation allows training under standard language-modeling objectives.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model sizes, MLLM backbones, training data, or exact gains. The expected comparisons are against independent top-k scoring and fixed-ratio pruning under cost-quality trade-offs.

recommendation.zh: 思路比固定 top-k 干净一些；只看方法和 cost-quality 图即可，结论是否能迁移到预训练阶段还没证据。
recommendation.en: The setup is cleaner than fixed top-k pruning; read the method and cost-quality plots only, since pretraining-time transfer is not established.

paper.title: LOCUS: Local Visual Cue Search for Enhancing Fine-Grained Perception in Multimodal Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) remain unreliable on fine-grained visual perception, even when high-resolution inputs preserve the necessary local details. We identify this limitation as visual context rot: decisive evidence may exist in the full image, yet fail to be reliably selected and used amid redundant visual context. We propose LOCUS (LOcal visual CUe Search), a training framework that teaches MLLMs to internalize local evidence search through a verifiable proxy task. During tra

summary.core_problem: 解决 MLLM 在细粒度视觉感知中，即使输入保留局部细节，也无法稳定选择并使用关键局部证据的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 VLM/MLLM 训练方法创新，提出“visual context rot”这个诊断，并把细粒度感知瓶颈从分辨率不足转向局部证据搜索失败；对 native multimodal pretraining 和视觉 token 使用效率有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: LOCUS 在训练时提供一个 local crop 作为 visual cue，并要求模型在完整图像中恢复该局部证据的位置；训练信号是基于 IoU 的 reward。这个 cue 只在训练时使用，推理时仍保持标准 image-question 接口，目标是让模型内化局部证据搜索策略。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在细粒度感知、幻觉、通用理解和推理 benchmark 上验证，提升 localization-sensitive visual understanding，同时保持广泛能力；还做了 attention analysis，显示模型更会关注局部线索。摘要未给出模型规模、训练数据量、baseline 名称和具体提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a failure mode where MLLMs cannot reliably select and use decisive local visual evidence for fine-grained perception, even when the image contains the required details.
summary_en.importance: This is a VLM/MLLM training-method contribution. Its useful framing is “visual context rot”: the bottleneck is not only input resolution, but failure to search and bind local evidence. That is relevant to native multimodal pretraining and visual token utilization.
summary_en.technical_approach: LOCUS provides a local crop as a visual cue during training and optimizes the model to recover its spatial support in the full image using an IoU-based reward. The cue is removed at inference time, preserving the standard image-question interface while encouraging the model to internalize local evidence search.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports evaluations across fine-grained perception, hallucination, general understanding, and reasoning benchmarks. LOCUS improves localization-sensitive visual understanding while preserving broader capabilities, with attention analyses suggesting stronger focus on local evidence. Model size, data scale, baselines, and numerical gains are not given in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法和 attention 分析；若效果成立，它把细粒度 VLM 的瓶颈从分辨率改写成证据检索。
recommendation.en: Read the method and attention analysis; if the results hold, it reframes fine-grained VLM failure as evidence search, not resolution.

paper.title: Mind the Gap: Diagnosing Constraint Discovery Failures in Text-in-Image Editing
paper.abstract: A key challenge in multimodal reasoning is determining which visual dependencies become relevant under a specific task, rather than merely recognizing visible content. We study this through edit-induced constraint discovery in text-in-image editing, a controlled diagnostic setting where a local text change can activate secondary consistency constraints: given a valid editing instruction and an image, can a model identify the secondary regions that must also change? Across 461 diagnostic cases, f

summary.core_problem: 诊断多模态大模型在文本引导图像编辑任务中，无法主动发现编辑带来的隐含一致性约束这一失败模式的量化影响。
summary.importance: 通过受控诊断实验拆分了文本图像编辑中约束发现与约束执行两个阶段的能力gap，属于多模态推理失败模式的小样本量化分析，结论偏增量。
summary.technical_approach: 构建包含461个诊断样本、覆盖19类约束子类型的测试集，在无引导提示、显式提供约束、不同类型部分引导（区域名称、类型标签、案例特定因果解释）设置下测试4个MLLM的约束发现召回率，通过Oracle场分解量化不同引导方式的效果。
summary.experiments: 在4个主流MLLM上测试：无引导prompt下案例级宏召回率仅46%，显式提供全部约束时召回率达94%；提供案例特定因果解释作为引导时召回率为0.782，显著优于区域名称引导（0.610）和类型标签引导（0.646）。

summary_en.core_problem: Quantify the impact of MLLMs' failure to autonomously discover implicit consistency constraints induced by edits in text-guided image editing tasks.
summary_en.importance: Disentangles the capability gap between constraint discovery and constraint execution in text-image editing via controlled diagnostic experiments; a small-scale quantitative analysis of multimodal reasoning failures with incremental conclusions.
summary_en.technical_approach: Constructs a diagnostic test set of 461 cases covering 19 constraint subtypes, evaluates 4 MLLMs' constraint discovery recall under unguided prompting, explicit constraint provision, and different partial guidance types (region names, type labels, case-specific causal explanations), and uses oracle field decomposition to quantify guidance effectiveness.
