summary_en.experiments: Across 4 MLLMs, unguided prompting achieves only 46% case-level macro recall, compared to 94% when constraints are explicitly provided; case-specific causal explanation guidance yields 0.782 recall, outperforming region name guidance (0.610) and type label guidance (0.646).

recommendation.zh: 量化了MLLM在图像编辑中难以主动发现隐式一致性约束的已知现象，实验规模小无新机制，看摘要即可
recommendation.en: Quantifies the well-known implicit constraint discovery gap of MLLMs in image editing with small-scale experiments and no novel mechanisms; reading the abstract suffices.

paper.title: Cascaded Sparse Autoencoders Learn Multi-Level Visual Concepts in Multimodal LLMs
paper.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated strong performance on vision-language tasks, yet their internal visual representations remain difficult to interpret. Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) provide a scalable way to decompose dense model activations into sparse, interpretable features. However, existing SAE architectures primarily recover flat feature dictionaries and are less suited for explicit multi-level concept organization. In this paper, we introduce cascaded sparse autoenco

summary.core_problem: 研究如何用稀疏自编码器解释多模态 LLM 内部的视觉表征，并显式恢复多层级视觉概念结构。
summary.importance: 这是 MLLM 机制解释工作，贡献在于把 SAE 从扁平特征字典推进到层级概念组织。它不直接改进预训练 recipe，但有助于理解视觉 token / cross-modal 表征在大模型内部如何形成抽象。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Cascaded Sparse Autoencoders。第一层 SAE 从 MLLM 激活中学习低层视觉特征方向；第二层 SAE 不直接接第一层稀疏 activation code，而是训练在第一层 SAE 的 decoder weights 上，把已学到的低层 feature directions 当作输入，从而学习“概念的概念”。作者强调这不同于 nested SAE、Matryoshka 式层级或朴素 stacked SAE，可避免共享前缀耦合和中间瓶颈。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体 MLLM、参数规模、视觉任务、数据集和量化结果。实验应主要围绕层级概念可解释性、特征可视化、与 flat SAE / nested / stacked SAE 的对比展开，但具体效果需要读正文确认。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how sparse autoencoders can make visual representations inside multimodal LLMs interpretable while recovering an explicit hierarchy of visual concepts.
summary_en.importance: This is an interpretability contribution for MLLMs. It extends SAEs from flat feature dictionaries toward hierarchical concept organization, which is relevant for understanding how visual tokens and cross-modal abstractions are represented in large models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed Cascaded Sparse Autoencoder first learns low-level visual feature directions from MLLM activations. A second-level SAE is then trained directly on the decoder weights of the first-level SAE, treating learned feature directions as inputs for higher-level abstraction. This differs from nested, Matryoshka-style, or naively stacked SAEs and is intended to avoid shared-prefix coupling and activation bottlenecks.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify the MLLM backbone, parameter scale, datasets, or quantitative gains. The evaluation likely focuses on hierarchical concept interpretability and comparisons with flat, nested, and stacked SAE variants, but the exact evidence needs the full paper.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图和层级特征案例即可；若结论站得住，它会影响 MLLM 表征诊断时 SAE 该接哪里。
recommendation.en: Skim the method diagram and hierarchy visualizations; if the evidence is clean, it changes where SAEs should be attached for MLLM representation diagnostics.

paper.title: RepFusion: Leveraging Multimodal Priors for Denoising in Representation Space
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are widely used in text-to-image (T2I) systems, but they are typically limited to text encoding, while denoising is handled by newly trained generative backbones. The emergence of representation autoencoders (RAEs) shifts the generation target toward semantically structured visual representations, creating a latent space that is more compatible with pretrained LLM priors. Inspired by multimodal LLMs (MLLMs), where an MLP projector is sufficient to align clean visual

summary.core_problem: 解决文本到图像生成中，如何把预训练多模态/语言模型的表征先验真正用于去噪主干，而不只停留在文本编码侧的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献属于多模态生成方法创新：它尝试把 MLLM 从条件编码器扩展为噪声表征编码器，检验预训练语义表征是否能替代部分新训练 denoiser 容量。对统一建模和跨模态预训练有间接启发，但不是 LLM 预训练核心论文。
summary.technical_approach: 论文建立在 representation autoencoder 设定上，把生成目标从像素 latent 转到更语义化的视觉表征空间；受 MLLM 中 projector 对齐 clean visual representation 的启发，作者将 MLLM 直接复用为 noisy representation encoder，再把其输出作为 diffusion transformer 的条件信号。核心主张是：预训练 MLLM 已含有足够强的多模态先验，可在 denoising 阶段继续发挥作用，而不必完全依赖新初始化的去噪网络学习。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在相近推理预算下，RepFusion 优于把相当容量分配给新初始化 denoiser 的基线；但未给出模型参数、训练数据规模、具体 FID/GenEval 等指标幅度。可读性主要取决于正文是否做了干净的 capacity matching 和 inference-budget matching。
summary.authors_note: 作者含 Saining Xie，通常与 NYU/FAIR 体系的视觉与生成建模工作相关。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how to use pretrained multimodal/LLM priors for the denoising stage of text-to-image generation, rather than limiting them to text encoding.
summary_en.importance: This is a multimodal generation method paper. Its main value is testing whether pretrained semantic priors from MLLMs can substitute for part of a newly trained denoiser. It is only indirectly relevant to LLM pretraining, but it does touch unified representation learning.
summary_en.technical_approach: Built on representation autoencoders, the method shifts the generation target toward semantically structured visual representations. Inspired by the fact that MLLMs can align clean visual representations with a lightweight projector, the paper repurposes the MLLM itself as a noisy representation encoder and feeds its outputs as conditioning into a diffusion transformer. The core claim is that pretrained MLLMs carry denoising-relevant priors, not just text-conditioning priors.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims gains over baselines that allocate similar capacity to newly initialized denoisers under comparable inference budgets, but gives no model sizes, data scale, or exact metric improvements. The paper is worth checking only if the capacity and budget matching are clean.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Saining Xie, typically associated with strong vision and generative modeling work from the NYU/FAIR ecosystem.

recommendation.zh: 对做统一预训练的人有一点味道：看它是否真把“预训练表征可做去噪器”做成了 clean ablation；若 capacity match 不严，这个结论只能当弱信号。
recommendation.en: Mildly interesting for unified pretraining: check whether the paper cleanly shows pretrained representations can act as denoisers; if the capacity matching is loose, treat the claim as weak evidence.

paper.title: Ouroboros-Spatial: Closing the Data-Model Loop for Spatial Reasoning
paper.abstract: Spatial reasoning remains a persistent challenge for multimodal large language models (MLLMs). Existing approaches largely rely on large-scale, statically curated datasets, where all training samples are treated uniformly regardless of the model's evolving capabilities. This static paradigm is inherently data-inefficient: training capacity is often spent on samples that are either trivial or overly difficult for the model at its current stage. To address this limitation, we propose Ouroboros-Spa

summary.core_problem: 解决多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在空间推理任务中，静态训练数据导致的数据效率低下问题。
summary.importance: 提出了一种自演化的训练框架，通过模型自我生成和筛选数据，动态调整训练难度，提升了空间推理能力。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Ouroboros-Spatial 框架，模型扮演 proposer 和 solver 两个角色。Proposer 利用 3D 场景元数据和视频帧生成空间 QA 对及可执行代码获取 ground truth；Solver 在接受的样本上微调，其预测置信度作为难度信号反馈给 Proposer，指导下一轮生成更具挑战性的数据。
summary.experiments: 在空间推理任务上验证了该自演化框架的有效性。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自北京大学和上海人工智能实验室。

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses the data inefficiency in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) for spatial reasoning caused by static training datasets.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a self-evolving training framework that dynamically adjusts training difficulty through model self-generation and filtering, improving spatial reasoning capabilities.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces the Ouroboros-Spatial framework, where the model acts as both a proposer and a solver. The proposer generates spatial QA pairs and executable code for ground truth from 3D scene metadata and video frames. The solver is fine-tuned on accepted samples, and its prediction confidence serves as a difficulty signal fed back to the proposer to guide the generation of more challenging data in the next iteration.
summary_en.experiments: Validated the effectiveness of the self-evolving framework on spatial reasoning tasks.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from Peking University and Shanghai AI Laboratory.

recommendation.zh: 将 self-play/self-evolution 范式引入 VLM 空间推理数据的合成与筛选，作为 post-train 数据合成的参考，不读正文。
recommendation.en: Introduces the self-play/self-evolution paradigm to VLM spatial reasoning data synthesis and filtering; useful as a reference for post-train data synthesis, skip the main text.

paper.title: Beyond APIs: Probing the Limits of MLLMs in Physical Tool Use
paper.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) excel at utilizing digital APIs and increasingly serve as the "brain" of embodied AI, instructing robots to interact with the physical world. In such embodied settings, a central capability is the use of physical tools, which underpins MLLMs' ability to assist humans in real-world tasks. Despite the importance, MLLMs' proficiency in physical tool use remains largely unexplored. To address this gap, we introduce PhysTool-Bench, the first physical tool-use

summary.core_problem: 评测多模态大模型在真实物理工具使用中的理解、识别和规划能力，而不是只看数字 API 调用能力。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 VLM/MLLM benchmark。它把 tool use 从函数调用扩展到具身场景里的物体识别、工具选择和步骤规划，对多模态预训练数据覆盖和视觉-语言-动作对齐有间接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 PhysTool-Bench，包含真实场景、物理工具图像和使用指令。评测维度包括识别场景中所有物理工具，以及根据任务指令规划工具选择和使用顺序。数据覆盖制造、电工、农业、医疗等多个工具域。
summary.experiments: Benchmark 包含 2,510 个 queries 和 2,678 个真实物理工具。摘要未提供具体被测 MLLM 列表、分数表或主要失败模式，因此只能确认评测资产规模，不能判断模型差距的细节。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Singapore Management University 和 The Hong Kong Polytechnic University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether MLLMs can understand, identify, and plan the use of physical tools in real-world scenes, beyond calling digital APIs.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is a multimodal benchmark. It shifts tool-use evaluation toward embodied settings involving visual recognition, tool selection, and procedural planning, which may inform multimodal pretraining coverage and vision-language-action alignment.
summary_en.technical_approach: PhysTool-Bench contains real-world physical-tool scenarios and task instructions. Models are evaluated on recognizing all tools present in a scene and planning tool selection and usage sequences. The dataset spans manufacturing, electrical work, agriculture, healthcare, and other domains.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark includes 2,510 queries and 2,678 real-world tools. The abstract does not provide the evaluated model list, detailed scores, or failure analysis, so only the evaluation scope can be assessed from the provided information.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Singapore Management University and The Hong Kong Polytechnic University.

recommendation.zh: 作为 MLLM 数据覆盖盲区的探针可扫一眼；若没有 failure taxonomy，别投入正文时间。
recommendation.en: Worth a quick look as a probe for MLLM coverage gaps; without a strong failure taxonomy, it is not a full-paper read.

paper.title: Late-Layer Fusion is Enough: Dual-Path Vision Token Routing for Multimodal Large Language Models under Visual Saturation
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) commonly inherit the deep, symmetric Transformer backbone designed for unimodal text modeling, and apply the same computation uniformly to image and language tokens. This design overlooks a key modality asymmetry: image and text tokens differ substantially in information density, redundancy, and required reasoning depth. Through a layer-wise analysis of LLaVA-1.5, we observe that vision tokens tend to saturate in the middle layers. Specifically, text-to-i

summary.core_problem: 解决 MLLM 沿用纯文本对称深层 Transformer 时，对视觉 token 过度深算、而文本 token 仍需深层语义处理的模态不对称问题。
summary.importance: 这是一个多模态架构效率与表示演化分析结合的工作。价值不在于再做一个 routing 模块，而在于先给出层级证据：视觉 token 在中层已接近饱和，继续走完整深度可能只是冗余计算，甚至带来表征漂移。这个观察对 native multimodal pretrain 和 unified backbone 设计都有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 作者先对 LLaVA-1.5 做 layer-wise analysis，观察 text-to-image attention 从第 0 层的 0.68 快速降到第 4 层的 0.07，并在第 18 层后稳定在约 0.04，说明视觉 token 的跨模态贡献在中层后显著衰减。基于此提出 Dual-Path Vision Token Routing (DPVR)：让视觉 token 在较浅层完成主要融合后走更短或不同的路径，而文本 token 保持深层处理，从而形成 late-layer fusion is enough 的模态异步深度分配。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出了关键分析数字，但未给出完整 benchmark、模型规模和提升幅度。已知实验基于 LLaVA-1.5 的层级分析，并围绕视觉饱和与 late-layer fusion 的有效性展开。若正文包含在常见 MLLM benchmark 上的精度—算力曲线，这篇更适合作为“多模态 backbone 是否该对称”这一问题的证据，而不是单纯追某个任务分数。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the modality asymmetry in MLLMs: visual tokens may be over-processed by deep symmetric Transformer stacks originally designed for text, while text tokens still benefit from deeper semantic computation.
summary_en.importance: This is a multimodal architecture paper that combines representation analysis with efficiency-oriented design. The main value is not just another routing module, but the layer-wise evidence that vision tokens saturate mid-stack, making full-depth processing redundant and potentially harmful. That matters for native multimodal pretraining and unified backbone design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors first perform a layer-wise analysis on LLaVA-1.5 and show that text-to-image attention drops from 0.68 at layer 0 to 0.07 by layer 4, then stabilizes near 0.04 after layer 18, suggesting that visual tokens contribute much less after the middle layers. Motivated by this, they propose Dual-Path Vision Token Routing (DPVR), where vision tokens take a shorter or separate path after early fusion, while text tokens continue through deeper processing. The design embodies the claim that late-layer fusion is sufficient under visual saturation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract provides the key analysis numbers but not the full benchmark suite, model scales, or exact gains. The setup is built on LLaVA-1.5 and evaluates the visual-saturation hypothesis together with the proposed routing design. If the paper includes clean accuracy-vs-compute curves, it is best read as evidence on whether multimodal backbones should remain symmetric, rather than as a benchmark-chasing paper.

recommendation.zh: 先看它的层分析再决定要不要信方法：如果视觉 token 真在中层后基本失活，那很多 MLLM 还在用的对称深堆叠就是错配，值得拿自家模型做一次 attention/representation probe。
recommendation.en: Read the layer analysis before the method: if vision tokens really saturate mid-stack, then the symmetric deep backbone many MLLMs still use is structurally mismatched and worth probing on your own models.

paper.title: Visual Para-Thinker++: A Single-Policy Multi-Agent Framework for Visual Reasoning
paper.abstract: Visual reasoning requires integrating evidence distributed across regions, attributes, and relations, making single-chain reasoning prone to early perceptual commitment and hallucination. We propose Visual Para-Thinker++, a single-policy multi-agent framework in which one shared MLLM policy is instantiated as role-conditioned Main, Worker, and Summary Agents. The Main Agent decomposes the task with fixed allocation patterns; Worker Agents reason in parallel under context isolation; and the Summa

summary.core_problem: 解决视觉推理中单链 MLLM 容易过早锁定感知证据、遗漏区域关系并产生幻觉的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 VLM 推理框架和后训练优化方法。它把一个共享 MLLM policy 实例化为 Main、Worker、Summary 多角色 agent，并配套 role-specific reward/advantage，试图在不训练多个独立模型的情况下获得多 agent 并行推理的好处。对预训练研究员的价值主要在于观察“多轨推理 + 分段 credit assignment”是否比单链 CoT 更稳定。
summary.technical_approach: Visual Para-Thinker++ 使用单一共享策略，通过 role conditioning 形成 Main Agent、Worker Agents 和 Summary Agent。Main 负责按固定模式分解任务；Worker 在上下文隔离下并行推理；Summary 读取完整 Worker reasoning traces 后整合，而不是只对最终标签投票。训练侧提出 Multi-Agent Capability Injection 和 Role-Decoupled Multi-Agent Optimization，对不同角色的 token 段分配对应 reward 和 advantage，以降低协作角色之间的梯度冲突。推理侧复用 shared visual prefix 和 KV cache，降低多 agent rollout 成本。
summary.experiments: 摘要列出 V*, CountBench、RefCOCO family 等视觉推理/定位基准，但给出的片段未包含完整结果、模型规模、训练数据量、baseline 列表或提升幅度。需要读正文确认 gains 是否来自多 agent 结构、RL credit assignment，还是额外训练数据和 rollout 预算。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses visual reasoning failures where a single MLLM reasoning chain commits too early to partial perception, misses distributed evidence, and hallucinates.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a VLM reasoning framework plus post-training optimization. A single shared MLLM policy is instantiated as Main, Worker, and Summary agents, with role-specific rewards and advantages. For pretraining researchers, the useful signal is whether multi-trajectory reasoning with segmented credit assignment behaves more robustly than single-chain CoT.
summary_en.technical_approach: Visual Para-Thinker++ uses one shared policy with role conditioning. The Main Agent decomposes the task under fixed allocation patterns; Worker Agents reason in parallel with isolated contexts; the Summary Agent reconciles full Worker reasoning traces instead of voting over final labels. Training uses Multi-Agent Capability Injection and Role-Decoupled Multi-Agent Optimization, assigning rewards and advantages to role-specific token spans to reduce gradient conflict. Inference reuses the shared visual prefix and KV cache to reduce multi-agent rollout overhead.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract mentions V*, CountBench, the RefCOCO family, and other visual reasoning benchmarks, but the provided excerpt does not include model scale, data scale, baselines, or exact improvements. The full paper should be checked to separate gains from the multi-agent structure, role-wise RL credit assignment, extra data, and rollout budget.

recommendation.zh: 读训练目标和消融即可；若 role-wise advantage 真能降梯度冲突，值得借到文本推理 RL 里复现。
recommendation.en: Read the objective and ablations; if role-wise advantages really reduce gradient conflict, it is worth reproducing in text-only reasoning RL.

paper.title: Robust-U1: Can MLLMs Self-Recover Corrupted Visual Content for Robust Understanding?
paper.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable success in visual understanding, yet their performance degrades significantly under real-world visual corruptions. While existing robustness enhancement approaches exist, they are limited: black-box feature alignment lacks interpretability, and white-box text-based reasoning cannot restore lost pixel-level details. This work investigates a fundamental research question: Can MLLMs recover corrupted visual content by themselves?

summary.core_problem: 多模态大模型在真实视觉 corruption 下性能显著下降，现有鲁棒性方法无法恢复丢失的像素级细节
summary.importance: 首次提出让MLLM具备显式视觉自恢复能力的鲁棒理解框架
summary.technical_approach: 三阶段方法：监督微调实现初始重建，带像素级SSIM和语义级CLIP相似性双奖励的强化学习对齐高质量恢复，联合 corrupted 输入与恢复图像做多模态推理
summary.experiments: 在多种视觉 corruption 场景下验证了框架的鲁棒性提升效果
summary.authors_note: Qifeng Chen来自香港科技大学，研究方向为计算机视觉与多模态模型

summary_en.core_problem: Multimodal large language models suffer significant performance degradation under real-world visual corruptions, and existing robustness methods cannot restore lost pixel-level details.
summary_en.importance: First framework that equips MLLMs with explicit visual self-recovery capability for robust understanding.
summary_en.technical_approach: Three-stage method: supervised fine-tuning for initial reconstruction, reinforcement learning with dual rewards (pixel-level SSIM and semantic-level CLIP similarity) for high-quality alignment, and multimodal reasoning combining both corrupted input and recovered image.
summary_en.experiments: Verifies robustness improvement under various visual corruption scenarios.
summary_en.authors_note: Qifeng Chen is from Hong Kong University of Science and Technology, focusing on computer vision and multimodal models.

recommendation.zh: 多模态鲁棒性的工程化改进，核心是视觉重建增强理解，对通用LLM基座预训练无直接启发，了解结论即可
recommendation.en: Engineering improvement for multimodal robustness, core is visual reconstruction for enhanced understanding, no direct insight for general LLM pretraining, only need to know the conclusion.

institutions: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

paper.title: When No Answer Is Correct: Diagnosing Absent Answer Detection for MLLMs in Video Understanding
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made substantial advancements in video understanding, yet the reliability of their responses remains underexplored. This work presents a diagnostic study of absent answer detection for MLLMs in video understanding, where the correct answer is deliberately excluded from the candidate set and a reliable model is expected to recognize that no valid option exists. We evaluate the absent answer detection behavior under three settings: multiple-choice ques

summary.core_problem: MLLM在视频理解中对缺失正确答案的识别能力尚未被系统诊断。
summary.importance: 首次系统诊断MLLM在视频理解中的缺失答案检测行为，含三种评测设置。
summary.technical_approach: 三种设置：多选加NOTA选项、开放式生成加检测指令、无引导标准评测；探索CoT作为缓解策略。
summary.experiments: MLLM压倒性选择看似合理的干扰项而非检测缺失答案；时间推理任务失败更明显；稠密帧采样恶化问题。

summary_en.core_problem: MLLM ability to detect when no correct answer exists in video understanding is undiagnosed.
summary_en.importance: First systematic diagnostic of absent answer detection for MLLMs in video understanding across three evaluation settings.
summary_en.technical_approach: Three settings: multiple-choice with NOTA, open-ended generation with detection instruction, standard evaluation without guidance; explore CoT as mitigation.
summary_en.experiments: MLLMs overwhelmingly select plausible distractors; failure worse in temporal reasoning; denser frame sampling worsens problem.

recommendation.zh: 对MLLM视频理解可靠性的诊断性研究，发现稠密帧采样反而恶化缺失答案检测，作为领域内备查，不读正文。
recommendation.en: Diagnostic study of MLLM reliability in video QA; denser frame sampling worsens absent-answer detection. Literature reference only, no need to read full text.

paper.title: Video-Rate Streaming Stylization on a Vision-Aware MLLM-Conditioned Edit Diffusion: Asymmetric Batched Inference on a Distilled UNet + MLLM Text Encoder
paper.abstract: Aggressive distillation of the diffusion U-Net inverts the per-frame bottleneck of real-time text-to-image pipelines: once the denoiser is a 4-step or 1-step distilled student, the text encoder becomes the critical path. This inversion is most acute in vision-aware edit diffusion, where the encoder is a multimodal large language model (MLLM). We study the case of a 0.39B distilled edit U-Net paired with a 2.13B MLLM text encoder (Qwen3-VL) and present a streaming pipeline targeted at this regime

summary.core_problem: 蒸馏后diffusion U-Net推理时，MLLM文本编码器成为新瓶颈，尤其是vision-aware edit diffusion场景下尤其严重
summary.importance: 工程突破：单消费级GPU上实现视频速率(27.4fps@512x512视频风格化
summary.technical_approach: 非对称CUDA流水线批处理文本编码器摊销+静态提示缓存，ControlNet-LLLite重写为单融合图，周期性条件刷新
summary.experiments: 0.39B蒸馏U-Net + 2.13B Qwen3-VL文本编码器，RTX 3090 Ti上27.4fps/480帧

summary_en.core_problem: After aggressive U-Net distillation, the MLLM text encoder becomes the inference bottleneck in vision-aware edit diffusion
summary_en.importance: Engineering breakthrough: video-rate streaming stylization on consumer GPU
summary_en.technical_approach: Asymmetric CUDA pipelining with batched text-encoder amortization + static prompt caching, compile-friendly ControlNet-LLLite fusion, periodic conditioning refresh
summary_en.experiments: 0.39B distilled U-Net + 2.13B Qwen3-VL encoder; 27.4 fps on RTX 3090 Ti at 512x512

recommendation.zh: diffusion+MLLM流水线工程优化，非对称批处理和条件摊销思路对多模态推理服务有一定启发，但过于场景特定
recommendation.en: Diffusion+MLLM pipeline engineering; asymmetric batching and amortization ideas may启发 multimodal serving but highly scenario-specific

paper.title: MLLM-Microscope: Unlocking Hidden Structure Within Multimodal Large Language Models
paper.abstract: This work presents MLLM-Microscope, a novel system designed for analyzing the hidden representations within Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). Our system evaluates the linearity, intrinsic dimension, and anisotropy of multimodal token embeddings across transformer layers. Utilizing the ScienceQA dataset, we evaluate two state-of-the-art MLLMs, LLaVA-NeXT and OmniFusion. We find that both the main and residual streams for tokens of both modalities exhibit highly linear behaviors across tra

summary.core_problem: 分析多模态大语言模型内部表示的几何结构，尤其是图像 token 与文本 token 在层间的线性、内在维度和各向异性差异。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制分析工具与小规模实证观察。它试图把 MLLM 的表示研究从输出行为评测推进到隐藏状态几何，但实验规模较小，结论更适合作为后续 probing 的线索。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 MLLM-Microscope 系统，对 transformer 层内主流与残差流中的多模态 token embedding 做线性度、intrinsic dimension 和 anisotropy 测量；重点比较不同模态融合方式下表示几何的变化。
summary.experiments: 使用 ScienceQA 数据集，评估 LLaVA-NeXT 和 OmniFusion 两个 MLLM。结果显示两者主流和残差流中的图像、文本 token 都呈现较强线性；LLaVA-NeXT 图像 token 线性度略下降，OmniFusion 更稳定；OmniFusion 图像 token 内在维度更高、各向异性持续较低。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Satbayev University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies the geometry of hidden representations in multimodal LLMs, focusing on how image and text tokens differ in linearity, intrinsic dimension, and anisotropy across layers.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is a mechanistic analysis tool plus a small empirical study. It moves MLLM analysis from output behavior toward internal representation geometry, but the evidence is limited to a narrow model and dataset setup.
summary_en.technical_approach: MLLM-Microscope measures linearity, intrinsic dimension, and anisotropy for multimodal token embeddings in both main and residual streams across transformer layers, comparing how different modality-fusion designs affect representation geometry.
summary_en.experiments: The study uses ScienceQA and evaluates LLaVA-NeXT and OmniFusion. Both models show highly linear behavior for image and text tokens; LLaVA-NeXT image tokens show a slight decline in linearity, while OmniFusion remains stable, has higher image-token intrinsic dimension, and keeps anisotropy low across layers.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Satbayev University.

recommendation.zh: 只看指标定义和两模型对比即可；样本太窄，但 fusion 方式影响表示几何这个信号值得记下。
recommendation.en: Read only the metric definitions and two-model comparison; the setup is narrow, but the fusion-geometry signal is worth noting.

paper.title: X-Stream: Exploring MLLMs as Multiplexers for Multi-Stream Understanding
paper.abstract: While video streaming understanding has made significant strides, real-world applications, such as live sports broadcasting, autonomous driving, and multi-screen collaboration, inherently demand continuous, multi-stream interactions. However, existing benchmarks are confined to single-stream paradigms, leaving a critical gap in evaluating online, cross-stream reasoning. To bridge this, we introduce X-Stream, the first benchmark dedicated to multi-stream streaming understanding. Comprising 4,220

summary.core_problem: X-Stream 解决的是多路视频流在线理解缺少评测基准的问题。现有视频理解数据多是单路、离线或多视频拼接，不能检验模型在直播、多机位、多设备场景中持续整合多路视觉、音频和时间线索的能力。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对原生多模态模型的能力边界有参考价值。它把多流输入视为受 token 带宽限制的 multiplexing 问题，能帮助判断现有 MLLM 在多路视频 token 编排、上下文预算分配、流间对齐和在线推理上的短板。对做视频-语言统一预训练、长上下文多模态建模、视觉 token 压缩的人，主要价值在评测设计和失败模式分析。
summary.technical_approach: 论文构建了 X-Stream benchmark，覆盖 multi-window、multi-view、multi-device 三类场景，并设计 11 个子任务，任务从基础感知到逻辑推理，再到决策类问题。数据构建的关键是避免 single-stream shortcut：如果问题只靠一路视频就能回答，就不能真实评估多流融合。作者因此引入双重验证流程，要求多路输入同时满足必要性和充分性。方法分析部分把 MLLM 看成带宽有限的多路复用器，比较三种流合并策略：Spatial Division Multiplexing 把多路画面空间拼接，利于跨流引用但压缩单路细节；Temporal Division Multiplexing 在时间维交错输入，保留单路分辨率但增加跨流同步难度；Semantic Division Multiplexing 先抽取关键信息再合并，更适合多流数量增加且 token 预算紧张的设置，但依赖前端摘要质量。
summary.experiments: 数据规模为 857 小时原始多流数据，来源超过 20 类数据源，覆盖驾驶、体育、机器人、日常活动、聊天、监控、直播和界面等场景。预处理后选取 160 小时、2 到 5 路并发视频用于标注，最终形成 932 个视频、451 个 takes、4,220 个 QA。论文报告主流模型整体得分约在 50% 附近，高级跨流能力，尤其是因果推理、异常检测和行为规划，仍明显不足。消融重点不是单一模型提升，而是不同 multiplexing 策略在 token bandwidth 和 stream count 变化下的取舍：两路场景中空间拼接更容易支持跨流指代；三路及以上且预算受限时，语义级压缩更能保留关键信息。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 25 到 35 分钟。重点看数据构建章节中对 single-stream shortcut 的定义和双重验证流程，这是评测质量的关键。其次看任务 taxonomy 和 benchmark 统计，判断它是否覆盖目标模型关心的在线多模态能力。最后看 multiplexing 策略实验，尤其是 token 预算、流数量和策略选择之间的关系。模型排名本身不必精读，失败案例和策略消融更有信息量。

summary_en.core_problem: X-Stream targets a missing evaluation setting: online understanding over multiple simultaneous video streams. Existing video benchmarks mostly focus on single-stream or offline multi-video inputs, so they do not test whether a model can continuously integrate evidence across live camera views, devices, windows, audio cues, and timestamps.
summary_en.importance: The paper is mainly an evaluation contribution rather than a pretraining method. Its relevance to foundation-model research comes from the framing of multimodal models as token-bandwidth-limited multiplexers. That framing is useful for studying video token allocation, multi-stream context packing, cross-stream alignment, and online inference behavior in native multimodal models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The benchmark contains multi-window, multi-view, and multi-device scenarios, with 11 subtasks organized from low-level perception to reasoning and decision making. A central design choice is to remove single-stream shortcuts: questions should require multiple streams rather than being answerable from one view. The authors use a dual-verification pipeline to enforce the necessity and sufficiency of multi-stream evidence. They also compare three input multiplexing strategies. Spatial division packs multiple streams into one visual layout, which helps cross-stream reference but reduces per-stream detail. Temporal division interleaves streams over time, preserving single-stream resolution while making synchronization harder. Semantic division compresses each stream into selected information before fusion, which becomes more useful when there are three or more streams under a tight token budget.
summary_en.experiments: The raw collection contains 857 hours of multi-stream data from more than 20 sources, including driving, sports, robotics, daily routines, chat, surveillance, live streaming, and interface scenarios. After filtering and pairing, 160 hours with 2 to 5 concurrent streams are annotated. The final benchmark has 4,220 QA pairs over 932 videos and 451 takes. Reported model performance is modest, with many strong models around the 50% score range. Advanced cross-stream skills such as causal reasoning, anomaly detection, and planning remain weak. The most useful experimental signal is the trade-off among multiplexing strategies as token budget and stream count change.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Read the data construction protocol first, especially the definition of single-stream shortcut and the dual-verification process. Then inspect the task taxonomy and dataset statistics to understand coverage. The multiplexing ablations are more useful than the raw leaderboard, because they expose how current MLLMs fail when context bandwidth is shared across streams.

recommendation.zh: 多流视频评测是干净的新压力源；读数据构造和错误分析即可，别把它当训练范式论文。
recommendation.en: Multi-stream video is a clean new stressor; read the dataset construction and failure analysis, not as a training-paradigm paper.

institutions: MMLab, Chinese University of Hong Kong
tonomous driving, and multi-screen collaboration, inherently demand

paper.title: iVGR: Internalizing Visually Grounded Reasoning for MLLMs with Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: While visually grounded Chain-of-Thought (CoT) has emerged as a promising paradigm to enhance fine-grained perception in multimodal large language models (MLLMs), its efficacy during the inference phase remains underexplored. In this work, we empirically find that mandating explicit object boxes in visually grounded CoT during inference often degrades performance compared to standard textual CoT, which reasons without explicit visual grounding. We hypothesize that the visual localization capabil

summary.core_problem: iVGR 研究的是多模态大模型中的视觉落地推理是否应该在推理期显式输出框或调用裁剪工具。论文的核心发现是：显式 grounding 能训练出定位能力，但推理期强制输出框往往会干扰答案生成；更好的方式可能是把定位能力内化到文本 CoT 中。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对 post-train 和 multimodal pretrain/post-train 接口有启发。它指出视觉 grounding 不一定要以显式坐标形式出现在最终推理轨迹里。坐标、裁剪、框监督可以作为训练信号，用来塑造模型的注意和局部感知能力；但推理期目标仍应围绕答案质量和稳定性。这个结论对构造 MLLM 的 RL 训练信号很有用：辅助能力可以通过奖励和一致性约束迁移到主轨迹，而不是让模型在部署时同时承担辅助任务和主任务。
summary.technical_approach: iVGR 采用双流强化学习训练。对同一个图文问题，策略模型生成两类 rollout：grounded stream 输出带 bounding box 的视觉落地 CoT，textual stream 输出普通文本 CoT。训练中先从 grounded stream 中筛选高质量轨迹，再用 consistency reward 约束 textual stream，使文本 CoT 与高质量 grounded 推理保持一致。这样模型在训练期利用显式定位信号学习“看哪里”，但在测试期可以不输出坐标，减少格式负担和错误框带来的噪声。论文还保留了与 crop tool 的兼容性：在细粒度 VQA 中，模型仍可在需要时调用裁剪流程，但默认推理不被强制绑定到显式框输出。
summary.experiments: 论文先做了一个诊断实验：对 DeepEyes 和 TreeVGR 这类已训练过视觉落地 CoT 的模型，只改变推理 prompt，不重新训练，比较 grounded CoT 与普通 textual CoT。结果显示，grounded CoT 虽然优于基础 Qwen2.5-VL-7B，但 textual CoT 在多数 VQA benchmark 上更好。进一步的 HR8K IoU 分组分析显示：对 crop-based 方法，只有定位质量较高时 grounded CoT 才占优；定位差时，错误裁剪会引入视觉噪声。对 box-based 方法，显式框输出在各个 IoU 区间都不如 textual CoT，说明坐标生成本身可能抢占了推理预算。随后，iVGR 在 Qwen2.5-VL 和 Qwen3-VL 上训练，并在多个 VQA benchmark 上取得一致提升。可见内容没有给出完整分数表，具体涨幅应查看实验表和消融。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25–35 分钟。优先看 Introduction 中关于 grounded CoT 与 textual CoT 的对照实验，以及 Figure 2 的 IoU-accuracy 分析，这是论文最有信息量的动机部分。方法部分重点看 dual-stream rollout、grounded trajectory 选择标准、consistency reward 的定义。实验部分建议看三组消融：没有 consistency reward、只用 grounded stream、只用 textual stream。若关注 MLLM RL 训练，还应看 reward 是否依赖答案正确性、定位质量、格式约束，以及这些奖励之间是否存在冲突。

summary_en.core_problem: iVGR asks whether multimodal models should explicitly output boxes or use crop tools during inference for visually grounded reasoning. The main observation is that explicit grounding can be useful as a training signal, but forcing the model to emit boxes at inference often interferes with answer prediction. The paper argues that localization ability should be internalized into textual chain-of-thought.
summary_en.importance: The paper is useful for understanding the interface between multimodal post-training and inference behavior. It separates auxiliary supervision from the final reasoning format. Box prediction, cropping, and grounding can teach the model where to look, but the deployed reasoning trace does not need to expose these intermediate coordinates. This is a practical lesson for RL training of MLLMs: auxiliary capabilities can be transferred into the main textual trajectory through rewards and consistency constraints, instead of making the model solve the auxiliary task and the answer task at the same time during inference.
summary_en.technical_approach: iVGR uses a dual-stream reinforcement learning setup. For each image-question pair, the policy model produces two types of rollouts: a grounded stream with explicit bounding boxes in the reasoning trace, and a textual stream with ordinary natural-language reasoning. High-quality grounded trajectories are selected and used as references for a consistency reward. This reward encourages the textual stream to align with grounded reasoning without requiring explicit coordinates at test time. The model therefore learns localization behavior during training, but avoids coordinate-format burden and noisy localization errors during inference. The method also remains compatible with crop-tool workflows for fine-grained VQA when tool use is beneficial.
summary_en.experiments: The paper first presents a diagnostic study on existing grounded-reasoning models such as DeepEyes and TreeVGR. Without retraining, the authors change only the inference prompt and compare grounded CoT with textual CoT. Grounded CoT improves over the base Qwen2.5-VL-7B model, but textual CoT performs better on most VQA benchmarks. An IoU-based analysis on HR8K further explains the pattern. For crop-based reasoning, grounded CoT helps only when localization is accurate; poor crops introduce visual noise. For box-based reasoning, explicit box generation underperforms textual CoT across IoU groups, suggesting that coordinate prediction itself can distract from answer prediction. iVGR is then trained on Qwen2.5-VL and Qwen3-VL and reports consistent gains across multiple VQA benchmarks. The visible content does not include the full numeric tables, so exact improvements should be checked in the experimental section.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Start with the diagnostic comparison between grounded CoT and textual CoT in the introduction, then inspect the IoU-accuracy analysis around Figure 2. These parts carry the main insight. In the method section, focus on dual-stream rollout generation, the selection of high-quality grounded trajectories, and the definition of the consistency reward. In the experiments, look for ablations removing the consistency reward, using only grounded trajectories, or using only textual trajectories. For readers interested in MLLM RL, the key point is how answer rewards, localization rewards, and format constraints interact.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得看的是那个负结果：显式 grounding 可能干扰 answer objective；先看主表和 ablation，若 setup 干净，会直接影响你设计 MLLM RL 信号。
recommendation.en: The useful part is the negative result: explicit grounding may interfere with answer prediction; check the main table and ablations first, because if the setup is clean it changes how you design RL signals for MLLMs.

paper.title: Explaining is Harder Than Predicting Alone: Evaluating Concept-based Explanations of MLLMs as ICL Visual Classifiers
paper.abstract: In-context learning (ICL) enables multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to classify images from a few labelled examples. Yet, how these models use the provided context remains opaque. While Chain-of-Thought prompting is widely used, recent work argues that it may not reflect true internal computation.   In this paper, we systematically evaluate the concept-based explainability of frozen MLLMs under few-shot ICL using five conditions of increasing formal rigour, ranging from baseline classific

summary.core_problem: 评估冻结 MLLM 在 few-shot ICL 图像分类时，能否生成与其分类行为一致且形式化的概念解释。
summary.importance: 贡献是 MLLM ICL 和解释可靠性的分析。它对 CoT/解释是否等同于真实计算过程这一问题给出一个多模态场景下的反例信号，但任务是视觉分类解释，离基座预训练方法较远。
summary.technical_approach: 论文设计五种逐渐增强形式约束的条件，从普通分类到生成 Description Logics 公理；在冻结 MLLM 上进行 few-shot ICL 图像分类，并用独立 LLM-as-a-judge pipeline 评估概念解释质量和预测表现。
summary.experiments: 评估 4 个 MLLM。摘要报告随着解释形式要求增强，预测准确率从 93.8% 单调下降到 90.1%；这说明要求模型给出更严格的概念化解释并不必然提升分类表现。摘要未提供具体模型名称和数据集细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether frozen MLLMs used as few-shot ICL image classifiers can produce concept-based explanations that are faithful and formally structured.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an analysis of MLLM in-context learning and explanation reliability. It provides a multimodal counter-signal to the assumption that explicit reasoning or explanations necessarily improve performance, but the task is visual classification explanation rather than foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors define five conditions with increasing formal rigor, ranging from baseline classification to Description Logics axiom generation. Frozen MLLMs perform few-shot ICL visual classification, and an independent LLM-as-a-judge pipeline evaluates the concept-based explanations and predictions.
summary_en.experiments: The study evaluates four MLLMs. The abstract reports that stricter explanation requirements monotonically reduce predictive accuracy from 93.8% to 90.1%, suggesting that formal concept explanations do not universally help classification. The abstract does not specify the exact models or datasets.

recommendation.zh: 只看准确率随解释约束下降的实验；它提醒别把显式解释当成干净监督信号。
recommendation.en: Skim only the accuracy drop under stricter explanation constraints; it is a caution against treating explicit explanations as clean supervision.

paper.title: Can MLLMs Reason Beyond Language? VisReason: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Vision-Centric Reasoning
paper.abstract: Recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) achieve strong performance on visual reasoning benchmarks, yet it remains unclear to what extent such performance reflects reasoning directly grounded in visual evidence. We introduce VisReason, a benchmark for vision-centric reasoning in everyday scenarios where perception and inference are tightly coupled. VisReason contains 1,505 questions across 10 categories spanning perceptual, structural, and conceptual reasoning. Our evaluation shows that V

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要回答的不是“MLLM 在视觉题上能不能得分”，而是一个更窄也更关键的问题：当前多模态模型到底是在直接利用视觉证据做推理，还是先把图像压成语言描述，再沿着语言链条完成推理。作者指出，MMMU、MMMU-Pro、MathVista 这类常用 benchmark 中，把图像替换成模型自己生成的 caption 后，性能下降不到 6.35%，说明不少题目其实允许模型绕开视觉细节，主要靠语言中介完成求解。VisReason 的目标就是构造一套对这种“语言替代”不友好的评测，让题目必须依赖视觉结构、空间关系、局部差异、图形规则等直接视觉证据，才能较稳定地答对。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的意义主要在评测诊断，而不在新训练方法。它提供了一个更干净的信号，帮助区分“视觉输入被真正用到了多少”与“模型只是把图像翻译成文本后继续做语言推理”这两件事。对做 native multimodal pretrain、视觉 tokenizer、跨模态对齐 loss、视觉 reasoning 数据构造的人，这类 benchmark 有实际价值，因为它能暴露训练目标是否真的提升了视觉 grounding，而不是只提升了语言外壳下的答题能力。它的贡献量级属于中等偏上：不是范式改变，但在当前 MLLM 评测里补上了一个长期缺口。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上核心是 benchmark 设计与验证。作者先定义 10 个视觉推理大类、36 个细粒度子类，覆盖 perceptual、structural、conceptual 三层能力。题目来源于在线视觉推理资源和公务员考试题库，随后由人工改写成统一 VQA 格式，答案类型分成选择、填空、开放问答和 2D 框选四类。每个样本至少经过多名标注者独立判断与复核，保证题面、答案和格式一致性。真正有意思的部分不只是数据收集，而是作者用“图像替换为 caption”的对照实验去验证 benchmark 的 vision-centric 属性：如果一个题目在 caption-only 条件下仍能做对，那它就不够依赖视觉证据；VisReason 在这个测试下出现了 48.12% 的显著性能下降，说明它比现有 benchmark 更能隔离视觉推理本身。论文还系统考察了 inference-time scaling 和显式 CoT 的作用，结论是：当视觉证据提取本身不够稳时，增加推理 token 或要求模型写更长推理链，收益都有限。这一点对多模态训练很重要，因为它暗示瓶颈不一定在 reasoning head，而可能更早出现在视觉表征、跨模态接口或训练分布上。
summary.experiments: 关键结果有四组。第一，诊断性最强的是 caption 替换实验：在 MMMU、MMMU-Pro、MathVista 上，图像换成 caption 后性能下降小于 6.35%；在 VisReason 上下降 48.12%，说明该 benchmark 明显更依赖原始视觉输入。第二，人类与模型差距很大，且不同模型之间被明显拉开，说明它既不是过难到全体接近随机，也不是过易到无法区分能力。第三，test-time reasoning budget 增加能带来持续但缓慢且趋于饱和的提升；论文没有把它包装成“多想就能解决”，而是明确指出额外计算无法替代视觉 grounding。第四，对非-thinking 模型，显式 CoT 的平均收益很小，例如 GPT-4o 只有约 +1.1%，而且在 perception-heavy 类别上并不稳定。另一个稳定现象是模型规模越大，VisReason 表现越好，但即便最大模型也明显落后于人类，说明单纯 scaling 还不够。作为 skim 论文，最值得记住的不是某个绝对分数，而是这几个实验共同支持的判断：现有 MLLM 的很多“推理”成绩，仍然有较强的语言替代成分。
summary.reading_guide: 建议先看 Introduction 里对现有 benchmark 的 caption 替换对照，这部分最能快速建立问题意识。然后看 benchmark 构成图和类别定义，理解作者到底把哪些能力算作 vision-centric reasoning。实验部分优先看三类结果：一是 humans vs models，二是 caption substitution，三是 inference-time scaling 与 CoT 的收益曲线。若时间有限，30 分钟左右足够抓住主线。若要深挖，重点想两个问题：第一，VisReason 是否真的排除了语言先验，只是“更难 caption”还是“必须看图”；第二，这类 benchmark 对预训练 recipe 的可优化性有多强，也就是它能否反向指导数据和目标函数设计，而不只是做诊断。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a sharper question than standard multimodal evaluation: when MLLMs succeed on visual reasoning tasks, are they actually reasoning from visual evidence, or are they mostly converting images into language and then solving the problem in text space? The authors show that on benchmarks such as MMMU, MMMU-Pro, and MathVista, replacing the image with a model-generated caption causes less than a 6.35% drop, which suggests that much of the reasoning can survive language mediation. VisReason is built to make that shortcut fail: the tasks require direct use of visual structure, spatial layout, local differences, and implicit visual rules.
summary_en.importance: Its value is diagnostic rather than algorithmic. For pretraining and native multimodal modeling, this benchmark gives a cleaner signal about visual grounding: it helps separate genuine use of visual evidence from language-heavy problem solving wrapped in multimodal form. That matters for work on visual tokenization, multimodal alignment losses, data construction, and unified pretraining, because many existing benchmarks may overstate progress if caption-like abstractions are already sufficient. The contribution is meaningful but bounded: it does not introduce a new training paradigm, but it fills an important gap in how current MLLMs are evaluated.
summary_en.technical_approach: The main contribution is benchmark design plus validation. The dataset contains 1,505 questions across 10 categories and 36 subcategories, spanning perceptual, structural, and conceptual reasoning. Samples are collected from online visual reasoning sources and civil-service exam repositories, then rewritten into a standardized VQA format with four answer types: multiple choice, fill-in-the-blank, open-ended, and 2D bounding-box selection. Each item is reviewed by multiple annotators for correctness and consistency. The most important methodological choice is the caption-substitution control: the authors explicitly test whether a benchmark remains solvable when the image is replaced by a generated caption. VisReason shows a much larger degradation than prior benchmarks, which supports the claim that it is more vision-centric. The paper also studies inference-time scaling and explicit chain-of-thought prompting, and finds that both help only modestly when visual evidence extraction itself is weak. That is a useful message for multimodal pretraining: the bottleneck may lie earlier, in visual representations or cross-modal interfaces, rather than in longer textual reasoning traces.
summary_en.experiments: There are four takeaways. First, the strongest diagnostic result is the caption-replacement test: performance drops by less than 6.35% on MMMU, MMMU-Pro, and MathVista, but by 48.12% on VisReason, indicating much heavier reliance on the original image. Second, the benchmark exposes a large human-model gap while still separating models across a broad range, so it is neither trivial nor uniformly saturated. Third, increasing inference-time thinking budget yields steady but slow and saturating gains; extra compute does not compensate for weak visual grounding. Fourth, explicit CoT prompting gives only marginal benefit for non-thinking models, with GPT-4o improving by about +1.1% on average and not consistently on perception-heavy subsets. The paper also reports a clear model-size trend: larger models do better, but even the strongest ones remain well below human performance. The main result to retain is not a single leaderboard number, but the broader conclusion that a substantial fraction of current MLLM 'reasoning' still appears language-mediated.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the introduction and the caption-substitution comparison, since that frames the whole paper. Then read the benchmark taxonomy to understand what the authors count as vision-centric reasoning. In the experiments, focus on three parts: human vs. model performance, caption substitution, and the curves for inference-time scaling and CoT prompting. A 30-minute skim is enough to capture the main argument. For deeper reading, examine whether the benchmark truly isolates visual reasoning rather than simply making captioning harder, and whether the benchmark can guide pretraining decisions instead of serving only as a diagnostic asset.

recommendation.zh: 一个专注于'以视觉为中心'的推理 Benchmark，指出现有 MLLM 的 test-time reasoning 策略在强视觉依赖任务上收益有限，对 VLM 评测和 o1-like 多模态推理研究有参考价值。
recommendation.en: A benchmark focusing on 'vision-centric' reasoning, pointing out that test-time reasoning strategies of current MLLMs yield limited benefits on strongly vision-dependent tasks; valuable for VLM evaluation and o1-like multimodal reasoning research.

paper.title: Dual-Pathway Geometry-Aware MLLM for Spatial Intelligence
paper.abstract: Spatial understanding of the physical world from 2D visual inputs hinges on two complementary forms of geometric knowledge: holistic 3D structural perception and fine-grained metric scale estimation. Existing multimodal large language models (MLLMs) typically address only one facet, ingesting either depth maps or point clouds as additional model inputs, which incurs substantial computational overhead and inherits the generalization limitations of upstream prediction models. We propose GAMSI, a d

summary.core_problem: 如何仅从 2D RGB 图像输入中，让 MLLM 同时获得整体 3D 结构感知和细粒度度量尺度估计这两种几何知识？
summary.importance: 提出了一种在统一自回归主干网络中内化两种几何先验的方法，避免了引入深度图或点云带来的计算开销和泛化限制。
summary.technical_approach: 提出了 GAMSI，一个双路径几何感知 MLLM。引入了度量-结构解耦查询 (MSDQ)，使用两组可学习查询分别从共享视觉上下文中提取密集的度量信号和稀疏的结构线索，并通过任务解耦的注意力掩码防止两条路径相互干扰。
summary.experiments: 在空间理解任务上进行了评估，仅使用 RGB 输入。
summary.authors_note: 中国科学技术大学 (USTC) 等机构工作。

summary_en.core_problem: How to enable MLLMs to acquire both holistic 3D structural perception and fine-grained metric scale estimation solely from 2D RGB image inputs?
summary_en.importance: Proposes a method to internalize two geometric priors within a unified autoregressive backbone, avoiding the computational overhead and generalization limits of introducing depth maps or point clouds.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes GAMSI, a dual-pathway Geometry-Aware MLLM. Introduces Metric-Structure Decoupled Queries (MSDQ) using two groups of learnable queries to extract dense metric signals and sparse structural cues from shared visual context, with a task-decoupled attention mask preventing interference.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on spatial understanding tasks using only RGB inputs.
summary_en.authors_note: Work by USTC and other institutions.

recommendation.zh: 通过解耦 query 在 MLLM 中同时注入 3D 结构和度量先验，属于 VLM 架构微调的常规操作，作为 literature 备查即可。
recommendation.en: Injecting 3D structural and metric priors into MLLMs via decoupled queries; a standard VLM architecture fine-tuning practice, keep as literature reference.

paper.title: Baton: Explicit Semantic Blueprints for Joint Video-Audio Generation
paper.abstract: Current open-source diffusion models struggle to generate stable and synchronized audio-visual content, particularly in scenarios demanding complex semantic reasoning. The root cause is that existing methods rely on coarse text embeddings from off-the-shelf encoders to guide audio-video denoising, which discards fine-grained semantics and, critically, lacks a shared long-horizon plan, leading to uncoordinated denoising trajectories and fragile cross-modal alignment. We propose Baton, the first f

summary.core_problem: 现有开源扩散模型联合生成音视频时跨模态同步性差、语义细节丢失，根源是仅用粗文本嵌入引导去噪，缺乏长程共享规划
summary.importance: 方法创新，首次将显式语义规划引入音视频联合生成框架
summary.technical_approach: 提出Baton框架，先用多模态LM构成的VA-Planner生成对齐的模态感知规划token，作为共享蓝图协调音视频的去噪轨迹
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型参数量、baseline及量化提升幅度，仅说明有效解决了跨模态对齐和语义细节丢失问题
summary.authors_note: 字节跳动多模态团队，Qi Tian、Liefeng Bo为团队核心研究员

summary_en.core_problem: Existing open-source diffusion models suffer from poor cross-modal synchronization and missing fine-grained semantics during joint audio-video generation, caused by over-reliance on coarse text embeddings and lack of shared long-horizon planning
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation, the first framework introducing explicit semantic planning into joint audio-video generation
summary_en.technical_approach: Propose Baton framework, first use a multimodal LLM-based VA-Planner to generate aligned modality-aware planned tokens as a shared blueprint to coordinate both audio and video denoising trajectories
summary_en.experiments: No specific model size, baseline, or quantitative improvement is provided in the abstract, only stating that cross-modal alignment and fine-grained semantic issues are effectively resolved
summary_en.authors_note: ByteDance multimodal team, with Qi Tian and Liefeng Bo as core senior researchers

recommendation.zh: 多模态LM仅作为生成规划的上游组件，无预训练范式或优化的新见解，仅了解框架即可
recommendation.en: MLLM is only used as an upstream component for generation planning, no new insights on pretraining paradigm or optimization, only framework overview is needed

paper.title: Bernini: Latent Semantic Planning for Video Diffusion
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) and diffusion models have each reached remarkable maturity: MLLMs excel at reasoning over heterogeneous multimodal inputs with strong semantic grounding, while diffusion models synthesize images and videos with photorealistic fidelity. We argue that these two families can be unified through a simple division of labor: MLLMs perform semantic planning, while diffusion models render pixels from high-level semantic guidance and low-level visual features. Buil

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文试图解决视频生成和编辑中的接口问题：如何让 MLLM 负责语义理解和规划，让 diffusion/flow 模型负责像素生成，同时避免把两者粗糙拼接成一个难训练的端到端系统。
summary.importance: 这篇更接近统一多模态预训练和新型生成建模接口设计。核心价值在于它选择 MLLM 内部的 ViT embedding space 作为语义桥梁，而不是让 MLLM 直接生成离散图像 token、文本 prompt，或让 diffusion 模型只依赖外部文本编码器。这个选择有两个含义：第一，视觉语义计划落在 MLLM 已经熟悉的连续表征空间里，减少适配成本；第二，生成器接收的是目标画面的高层视觉表示，而不只是语言描述，因此更适合复杂编辑、参考图/参考视频约束和主体保持。
summary.technical_approach: Bernini 由两部分组成。Planner 是一个 MLLM，它接收统一序列化的多模态输入，包括文本、源图像/视频的 ViT tokens，以及目标输出的占位 tokens。它不直接输出像素，而是在 MLLM 的 ViT embedding space 中预测目标视觉语义表示。训练时采用 masked generative modeling：随机 mask 目标 ViT tokens，在 MLLM hidden states 上接轻量 ViT embedding decoder，恢复被 mask 的目标 embedding；推理时从全 mask 状态开始逐步填充目标语义 tokens。Renderer 是 DiT，使用 flow matching 在 VAE latent tokens 上生成图像或视频，通过 cross-attention 接收 planner 给出的语义 embedding，并结合文本特征；做编辑任务时额外注入源输入的 VAE latent，以保留低层细节和时序一致性。为了统一多源视觉输入，论文提出 Segment-Aware 3D RoPE，在时空 RoPE 中加入 segment index 相关的相位调制，避免多个图像/视频源在位置编码上混淆。另一个设计是 latent-space CoT：让 planner 在连续视觉语义空间中进行中间推理，再输出最终 target embedding。训练策略上，两部分可以大体独立训练，再轻量联合调整，这有利于保留 MLLM 的理解能力，也降低整体训练难度。
summary.experiments: 论文覆盖 text-to-video、subject-to-video、图像/视频编辑等任务，并构造了多任务训练数据：视频和图像 pair 预训练数据、基于传播和运动感知的视频编辑数据、参考图和参考视频引导生成数据。评测包括 OpenVE-Bench、OpenS2V-Eval，以及论文提出的 Bernini-Bench。给出的结论是 Bernini 在多个视频生成、编辑和主体保持评测上优于对比系统，尤其在需要理解复杂指令、多参考输入和保持主体一致性的设置中收益更明显。当前提供的正文片段没有给出完整参数规模、训练 token/clip 数量和逐项指标，阅读时需要回到实验表格核对具体幅度。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 25–35 分钟。优先看 Fig. 3 和方法部分，确认 planner 到 renderer 的接口到底传什么：是 ViT semantic embeddings，而不是文本 prompt 或 VAE latent。然后看 masked ViT embedding prediction 的训练/推理流程、SA-3D RoPE 的定义、编辑任务中源 VAE latent 的注入方式。实验部分重点看多任务数据构造和 ablation：没有 semantic planner 会怎样，只用文本条件会怎样，去掉 source VAE features 或 SA-3D RoPE 会怎样。对基座研究更有用的是“连续语义计划 + diffusion 渲染”的分工设计，而不是具体视频 demo。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the interface problem between multimodal understanding and video synthesis: how to let an MLLM perform semantic planning while a diffusion-style generator renders pixels, without forcing both roles into a brittle end-to-end design.
summary_en.importance: This is relevant to unified multimodal pretraining and generation-interface design. The central choice is to use the MLLM’s own ViT embedding space as the semantic bridge to the generator. This is more informative than passing only a text prompt, and more natural for the MLLM than directly producing pixels or low-level VAE latents. It also creates a clean separation: the MLLM predicts what should appear in a compact visual-semantic space, while the DiT handles photorealistic rendering and detail preservation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Bernini has two main modules. The planner is an MLLM that consumes a unified multimodal sequence containing text, source visual tokens, and target placeholders. It predicts the target visual representation in continuous ViT-embedding space. Training follows a masked generative modeling setup: target ViT tokens are randomly masked, and a lightweight ViT-embedding decoder on top of the MLLM reconstructs the missing target embeddings from contextual hidden states. At inference, the planner progressively fills in the full target representation starting from masked tokens. The renderer is a DiT trained with flow matching over VAE latent tokens. It conditions on the planner’s semantic embeddings through cross-attention, also uses text features, and for editing tasks receives source VAE features to preserve low-level appearance and temporal consistency. The paper also introduces Segment-Aware 3D RoPE, which adds segment-index-dependent phase modulation to spatiotemporal rotary embeddings so that multiple visual sources can coexist in one sequence. A latent-space CoT mechanism lets the planner perform intermediate reasoning before producing the final target embedding.
summary_en.experiments: The system is evaluated on text-to-video generation, subject-to-video generation, and image/video editing. The training corpus combines video and image-pair pretraining data, propagation-based and motion-aware video editing data, and reference-image/reference-video guided generation data. Evaluation includes OpenVE-Bench, OpenS2V-Eval, and a new Bernini-Bench. The reported results show consistent gains over compared systems, with stronger effects in settings that require complex instruction following, multiple visual references, editing consistency, and subject preservation. The provided text does not include the full model scale, data scale, or all numeric metric values, so the exact margins should be checked in the experimental tables.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Start with Fig. 3 and the method description to understand the planner-renderer contract: the planner outputs ViT semantic embeddings, not text prompts or VAE latents. Then read the masked ViT-embedding prediction procedure, Segment-Aware 3D RoPE, and the source-VAE conditioning path for editing. In the experiments, focus on the multi-task data construction and ablations: removing the semantic planner, replacing it with text-only conditioning, removing source VAE features, or dropping SA-3D RoPE. The useful idea for foundation-model researchers is the continuous semantic planning interface between MLLM reasoning and diffusion rendering.

recommendation.zh: MLLM+扩散的分工架构值得了解一下，语义接口的设计思路对多模态统一预训练有参考价值。重点看规划器和渲染器的接口设计。
recommendation.en: The MLLM-diffusion division-of-labor architecture is worth understanding; the semantic interface design offers insights for unified multimodal pretraining. Focus on the planner-renderer interface design.

paper.title: MLLMs Know When Before Speaking: Revealing and Recovering Temporal Grounding via Attention Cues
paper.abstract: Video temporal grounding (VTG), which localizes the start and end times of a queried event in an untrimmed video, is a key test of whether multimodal large language models (MLLMs) understand not only what happens but also when it happens. Although modern MLLMs describe video content fluently, their timestamp predictions remain unreliable, while existing remedies either require costly post-training on temporal annotations or rely on coarse training-free heuristics. In this work, we probe the cros

summary.core_problem: 解释为什么MLLM在视频时间定位任务上常常“看懂了但说不对”，并尝试在不额外时序标注训练的情况下恢复这种时间 grounding 能力。
summary.importance: 价值主要在机制分析：它把视频MLLM的失败拆成prefill阶段已形成时间定位信号、但在自回归生成阶段被冲掉的perception-generation gap。这类分析对理解多模态解码失真有启发，但离基座预训练仍有一层距离。
summary.technical_approach: 作者通过分析跨模态注意力，识别出在prefill阶段会把query-to-video注意力集中到真实时间区间的一小组Temporal Grounding Heads（TG-Heads）。随后指出在AR解码时，答案token会把注意力从该区间拉走，转向视觉显著但与时间无关的区域。方法上围绕这些attention cues做恢复，而不是依赖额外标注后训练。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模和具体基线，但核心实验是对比prefill与decoding阶段的注意力行为，并验证利用TG-Heads线索可以改善视频时间定位。更像诊断+轻量修复，而非通用训练范式改进。
summary.authors_note: 港科大与西安交大合作，偏多模态机制分析。

summary_en.core_problem: It investigates why MLLMs often appear to know the correct temporal interval in videos but fail to output reliable timestamps, and how to recover that ability without costly temporal supervision.
summary_en.importance: The main value is mechanistic: it frames the failure as a perception-generation gap, where temporal grounding exists during prefill but is lost during autoregressive decoding. This is useful for understanding multimodal decoding distortions, though still one step removed from core pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: By probing cross-modal attention, the paper identifies a sparse set of Temporal Grounding Heads (TG-Heads) that focus query-to-video attention on the target interval during prefill. It then shows that answer-token decoding shifts attention away from that interval toward visually salient but temporally irrelevant regions, and uses these attention cues for recovery.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes or exact baselines. The key experiments compare attention behavior between prefill and decoding, and show that exploiting TG-Head signals improves temporal grounding without extra temporal annotation training.
summary_en.authors_note: A collaboration between HKUST and Xi’an Jiaotong University, positioned as multimodal mechanism analysis.

recommendation.zh: 结论有点像“模型知道但解码说坏了”的视频版证据；若你关心多模态生成失真，只看TG-Heads分析和prefill/decoding对比即可。
recommendation.en: This is basically a video-side instance of 'the model knows it before decoding corrupts it'; if you care about multimodal generation drift, just read the TG-Head analysis and the prefill-vs-decoding comparison.

institutions: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

paper.title: Modality-Decoupled Online Recursive Editing
paper.abstract: Online model editing for multimodal large language models (MLLMs) requires assimilating a stream of corrections under tight compute and memory budgets. Yet editors developed for text-only LLMs often degrade on MLLMs: visually dominant activations skew the statistics that shape updates, causing cross-modal conflict, while sequential writes become entangled in a shared edit space and amplify long-horizon interference, causing inter-edit interference. To address these, we propose M-ORE, a modality-

summary.core_problem: 解决 MLLM 在线模型编辑中连续写入 correction 时出现跨模态冲突和长期编辑干扰的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态模型编辑方法。它指出文本 LLM 编辑器直接迁移到 MLLM 时，视觉激活会主导更新统计，且多次顺序编辑会在共享编辑空间中相互缠绕。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 M-ORE，一种 modality-decoupled online recursive editor。方法从统一的 proximal-projection formulation 推导闭式更新，用 Sherman-Morrison recursion 实现常数级单次编辑开销；同时为文本栈和视觉 projector 维护模块级 locality statistics，并在固定正交低秩编辑子空间内持续更新，以降低跨模态冲突和长程干扰。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体 MLLM 参数量、数据集、baseline 名称或提升幅度。实验应主要评估在线编辑序列长度、跨模态 locality、编辑成功率、保留率和 per-edit 计算/内存开销。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles online model editing for MLLMs under streaming corrections, where cross-modal conflicts and long-horizon edit interference degrade performance.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a multimodal model-editing method. It identifies a failure mode of directly applying text-only LLM editors to MLLMs: visually dominant activations distort update statistics, and sequential edits become entangled in a shared edit space.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes M-ORE, a modality-decoupled online recursive editor. The method is derived from a proximal-projection formulation, admits a closed-form Sherman-Morrison recursive update, keeps module-wise locality statistics for the text stack and visual projector, and writes updates in a fixed orthogonal low-rank edit subspace.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, datasets, baseline names, or numerical improvements. The likely empirical focus is edit success, locality, retention, long edit streams, and constant per-edit compute and memory overhead.

recommendation.zh: 只看近端投影推导和跨模态统计分离；对预训练无直接动作，但能暴露 MLLM 表征耦合的坑。
recommendation.en: Read only the proximal-projection derivation and modality-separated statistics; no direct pretraining action, but it exposes a real MLLM representation-coupling failure.

paper.title: Bernini: Latent Semantic Planning for Video Diffusion
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) and diffusion models have each reached remarkable maturity: MLLMs excel at reasoning over heterogeneous multimodal inputs with strong semantic grounding, while diffusion models synthesize images and videos with photorealistic fidelity. We argue that these two families can be unified through a simple division of labor: MLLMs perform semantic planning, while diffusion models render pixels from high-level semantic guidance and low-level visual features. Buil

summary.core_problem: 解决视频生成与编辑里“语义规划”和“像素渲染”耦合过紧的问题，希望把 MLLM 的高层语义能力与 diffusion 的视觉生成能力更干净地拼接起来。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是多模态生成框架设计：提出用语义表示作为接口，把 MLLM 负责的语义规划与 DiT 负责的像素渲染解耦。对做统一多模态预训练的人有一点接口设计启发，但它更偏视频生成系统，而不是 LLM 基座预训练本身。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上，先用基于 MLLM 的 planner 直接在 ViT embedding 空间预测目标语义表示，再由 DiT-based renderer 在该语义计划条件下生成视频像素；编辑场景下再加入源视频的 VAE 特征以保留细节。核心设计是把“语义”作为 planner 和 renderer 的中间接口，因此两部分可以分开训练，只做轻量协同训练，尽量复用各自已有预训练能力。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出明确模型规模、训练数据规模和具体基线名称，只说明覆盖视频生成与编辑任务，并强调在保留预训练能力的同时实现统一框架。由于缺少定量细节，目前更适合把它当作架构接口思路，而不是可直接迁移到 LLM 预训练 recipe 的证据。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the tight coupling between semantic planning and pixel rendering in video generation/editing, aiming to combine MLLM-level semantic grounding with diffusion-based visual synthesis through a cleaner interface.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is mainly a multimodal generation framework: using semantic representations as the interface between an MLLM planner and a DiT renderer. This offers some interface-design signal for unified multimodal pretraining, but it is still much more a video generation system paper than a foundation-LLM pretraining paper.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method uses an MLLM-based planner to predict target semantic representations directly in ViT embedding space, then a DiT-based renderer generates pixels conditioned on that plan. For editing, source VAE features are added to preserve details. The key idea is to treat semantics as the contract between planner and renderer, enabling separate training with only light co-training.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide concrete model sizes, training corpus scale, or named baselines. It claims unified support for video generation and editing while preserving pretrained capabilities. Given the lack of quantitative detail, this is better read as an interface proposal than as strong evidence for transferable LLM-pretraining methodology.

recommendation.zh: 更像视频生成系统整合，不是 pretrain 论文；只需看它如何把“语义接口”从像素生成里剥离，若你在想 AR+diffusion 联合建模，这个接口定义可作弱参考。
recommendation.en: This is mostly a video generation integration paper, not a pretraining one; only read it for the semantic-interface split if you're thinking about AR+diffusion unification.

paper.title: DMN: A Compositional Framework for Jailbreaking Multimodal LLMs with Multi-Image Inputs
paper.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are vulnerable to jailbreak attacks, which can elicit harmful responses from MLLMs. Many MLLMs support multi-image inputs, inadvertently introducing new vulnerabilities due to less efforts on multi-image safety alignment. Previous MLLM jailbreak methods only uses a single image, which restricts the attack space: they cannot distribute harmful requests across multiple images, carry abundant information, or exploit additional visual reasoning tasks to distr

summary.core_problem: 这项工作关注多图输入 MLLM 的安全评测缺口：现有多模态 jailbreak 多按单图设计，但真实模型已经支持一次输入多张图。攻击意图被拆到多张图后，模型的安全机制需要跨图整合语义和意图，失败概率会上升。
summary.importance: 这不是预训练方法论文，但对 multimodal post-training 和安全数据构造有启发。它提示多图能力不是简单的 context length 扩展，而是引入了新的组合风险：视觉 token 序列之间的联合语义、文本渲染内容、辅助任务和最终用户意图需要被同时建模。对做 VLM pretrain / instruction tuning 的人，值得关注的是数据配比和安全监督是否覆盖 multi-image composition，而不是只覆盖单图 OCR、单图 VQA 或单轮拒答样本。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 DMN，一个单轮黑盒多图 jailbreak 框架，由三个模块组合而成。Distributed Instruction 将敏感请求拆成多张带文字的图片，使单张图看起来只包含局部信息，要求目标模型在多图间重组。Multimodal Evidence 通过构造更像真实案例的文本和视觉证据，让输入提供更多细节，并降低直接生成敏感图像时被 T2I 系统拒绝的概率。Number Chain Task 在图像序列中加入数字链任务，让模型先按指定顺序提取数字或处理辅助视觉任务，从而分散安全判断。方法的核心不是单个 trick，而是利用多图输入把“意图识别”“证据整合”“任务跟随”拆到不同视觉片段中，测试模型是否能在完成任务的同时保持全局安全约束。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 3 个数据集和 10 个 MLLM。作者报告 DMN 在多个闭源模型上达到很高的 attack success rate，例如在 GPT-4o、Gemini-2.5-Pro、Claude Sonnet 4 上超过 90%，并且在若干 jailbreak defense 下仍有效。消融实验给出三个主要观察：提升并非简单来自图片数量增加，而来自模块组合；将有害意图分散到多张图比放在单张图中更容易绕过安全判断；更复杂的辅助视觉任务会提高干扰强度。Multimodal Evidence 还会提升回答的细节程度。需要注意的是，这类结果依赖 judge、harmfulness 标注和具体模型版本，适合作为安全评测信号，不宜直接外推为稳定的模型能力结论。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20–30 分钟。重点看方法图、三个模块的定义、主结果表和消融表。对预训练研究者，最有用的是消融部分：它说明多图风险来自跨图组合和任务干扰，而不是单纯更长输入。具体攻击样例不必细读；更值得记录的是它对安全数据设计的要求，即训练和评测中需要加入多图联合意图识别、跨图 OCR 聚合、辅助任务下的拒答一致性。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a safety gap in multi-image MLLMs. Most multimodal jailbreak methods and safety evaluations are designed around a single image, while deployed models increasingly accept multiple images in one query. When harmful intent is distributed across images, the model must integrate partial visual evidence and infer the global request. Current safety mechanisms can fail under this composition.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper, but it is relevant to multimodal alignment and safety data design. The main signal is that multi-image input is not just a larger visual context window. It creates composition risks across visual tokens, rendered text, auxiliary tasks, and user intent. For VLM pretraining or instruction tuning, the useful question is whether the training mix and safety supervision cover multi-image composition, not only single-image OCR, single-image VQA, or isolated refusal examples.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed framework, DMN, is a single-turn black-box multi-image jailbreak setup with three components. Distributed Instruction splits the request across multiple typographic images, so each image carries only local information and the target model must reconstruct the full intent across the image sequence. Multimodal Evidence adds textual and visual evidence framed as realistic case material, increasing contextual detail and reducing direct rejection during image generation. Number Chain Task adds an auxiliary visual reasoning task over the image sequence, encouraging the model to follow task instructions while its safety mechanism must still track the global intent. The key idea is to decompose intent recognition, evidence integration, and task following across separate visual fragments, then test whether safety alignment remains consistent under that composition.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover three datasets and ten MLLMs. The authors report high attack success rates for DMN, including over 90% on GPT-4o, Gemini-2.5-Pro, and Claude Sonnet 4, and persistence under several jailbreak defenses. The ablations make three points: the gain is not explained by image count alone; distributing harmful intent over multiple images is more effective than placing it in a single image; and more complex auxiliary tasks increase distraction. The multimodal evidence component also increases the level of detail in harmful responses. These results depend on the judge, harmfulness labeling protocol, and exact model versions, so they are best read as a safety evaluation signal rather than a stable capability measurement.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim is enough. Focus on the method figure, the definitions of the three modules, the main attack success table, and the ablations. For pretraining researchers, the most useful part is the ablation analysis: it points to cross-image composition and task interference as the source of risk, not merely longer input. The concrete attack examples are less important than the data-design implication: safety training and evaluation need multi-image intent recognition, cross-image OCR aggregation, and refusal consistency under auxiliary visual tasks.

recommendation.zh: 看攻击构造和判定协议即可；多图输入是安全对齐盲区，若评测干净，应回查多图 SFT/RL 数据的拒答覆盖。
recommendation.en: Read the attack construction and judging protocol; if the setup is clean, multi-image SFT/RL data likely needs better refusal coverage.

paper.title: Learning to See What You Need: Gaze Attention for Multimodal Large Language Models
paper.abstract: When humans describe a visual scene, they do not process the entire image uniformly; instead, they selectively fixate on regions relevant to their intended description. In contrast, current multimodal large language models (MLLMs) attend to all visual tokens at each generation step, leading to diluted focus and unnecessary computational overhead. In this work, we introduce Gaze Attention, a novel mechanism that enables MLLMs to selectively attend to task-relevant visual regions during generation

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文要解决的问题是：MLLM 在生成每个 token 时都密集关注全部视觉 token，既浪费计算，也容易让注意力被无关区域稀释。
summary.importance: 这更接近多模态推理效率和架构改造，而不是基座预训练方法。对预训练研究的启发在于，视觉 token 不一定要以文本 token 的同质序列方式被处理。图像和视频有空间、时间结构，模型可以在保留完整 KV cache 的前提下，按生成步骤动态选择局部区域。这个思路可能影响 native multimodal 预训练中的视觉 token 组织方式、长视频建模、视觉上下文压缩，以及训练时的稀疏视觉注意力设计。
summary.technical_approach: Gaze Attention 把视觉 token 的 KV cache 按原始空间或时空网格分组成 gaze regions。每个区域用该区域 key 向量的均值池化作为轻量 descriptor。生成第 j 个 token 时，文本 query 与所有区域 descriptor 计算相似度，选择 TopK 区域，然后只对这些区域内部的视觉 key-value 做注意力。和一次性 KV eviction 不同，它不丢弃视觉 cache，而是在每个 decoding step 重新路由；某个区域当前没被选中，后续仍可被访问。为避免早期训练中 query 与 descriptor 对齐弱导致路由不稳定，作者采用 progressive TopK schedule，从接近密集注意力逐步降到更小的 K。另一个关键设计是 learnable context tokens，用来保留全局视觉摘要，避免只看局部区域时丢失场景级信息。
summary.experiments: 论文在图像和视频理解任务上评估。提供内容显示，Gaze Attention 在最多减少 90% 视觉 KV 访问量的情况下，在 13 个图像 benchmark 和 6 个视频 benchmark 上达到或超过 dense-attention baseline。可视化分析显示，生成过程中注意力区域更集中，也更容易解释。提供内容没有给出模型规模、训练数据量、各 benchmark 的具体分数表和消融数字，因此不能进一步确认收益主要来自区域路由、context tokens，还是训练 schedule。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 30 分钟。重点看 Method 中的 gaze region 划分、descriptor 构造、TopK routing 和 learnable context tokens。若只关心效率，可看 attention cost 如何从全视觉 token 数下降到被选区域比例。若关心多模态架构，可重点比较它和视觉 token 压缩、KV eviction 的差异：前者提前减少信息，后者一次性删除信息，而 Gaze Attention 保留完整 cache 并逐步动态选择。实验部分优先看消融表和 attention visualization，确认 context tokens 与 progressive TopK 是否必要。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses dense visual attention in MLLMs: at every decoding step, the language model attends to all visual tokens, even when only a small region is relevant.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly a multimodal inference-efficiency and architecture paper, not a base pretraining paper. Its relevance to pretraining comes from the treatment of visual tokens as structured spatial-temporal memory rather than a flat text-like sequence. The idea may inform native multimodal pretraining, long-video modeling, visual-token organization, and sparse visual attention designs that preserve information while reducing per-step computation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Gaze Attention groups cached visual keys into spatial or spatio-temporal regions. Each region is represented by a lightweight descriptor obtained by mean-pooling the keys in that region. At each decoding step, the current text query scores these descriptors, selects the TopK regions, and attends only to the visual key-value pairs inside the selected regions. Unlike KV eviction methods, it keeps the full visual KV cache and re-selects regions for every query, so a region skipped at one step can still be used later. To make routing trainable, the method uses a progressive TopK schedule, starting closer to dense attention and gradually reducing K. It also adds learnable context tokens, which remain visible to every text query and carry a compact global summary of the image or video.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated on both image and video understanding. According to the provided text, it attends to up to 90% fewer visual KV entries while matching or outperforming dense-attention baselines across 13 image benchmarks and 6 video benchmarks. Visualization results show more concentrated and interpretable attention maps during generation. The provided content does not include detailed benchmark tables, model sizes, training data, or ablation numbers, so the exact contribution of routing, context tokens, and the progressive schedule cannot be quantified here.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 30 minutes. Focus on the method section: region construction, descriptor pooling, TopK visual routing, and learnable context tokens. For efficiency, check how the attention cost scales with the attended region fraction rather than the full visual-token count. For architecture insight, compare it with visual-token compression and KV eviction: compression reduces information before decoding, eviction removes cache entries using a fixed estimate, while Gaze Attention keeps the cache and changes focus per decoding step. In the experiments, prioritize ablations and attention visualizations if available.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法和消融即可；如果区域选择不靠额外重编码实现，值得拿来对照内部 MLLM 视觉 KV 裁剪策略。
recommendation.en: Read the method and ablations; if region selection avoids extra re-encoding, it is a useful baseline for internal MLLM visual-KV pruning.

paper.title: DiM\textsuperscript{3}: Bridging Multilingual and Multimodal Models via Direction- and Magnitude-Aware Merging
paper.abstract: Towards more general and human-like intelligence, large language models should seamlessly integrate both multilingual and multimodal capabilities; however, extending an existing multimodal model to many languages typically requires expensive multilingual multimodal data construction and repeated end-to-end retraining. We study a training-free alternative: injecting multilingual capability into an existing multimodal model by composing residual updates in the shared language model backbone. The k

summary.core_problem: 把现有多模态模型扩展到多语言通常需要昂贵的多语多模态数据与端到端再训练，成本高且迭代慢。
summary.importance: 提供一种 training-free 的“参数更新合并”思路，把多语能力注入到现有 MLLM；对模型合并/能力迁移有工程启发，但更像技巧型合并而非预训练范式创新。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 DiM3：在共享 LM backbone 上，将“多语更新”和“多模态更新”视为异质残差更新，按参数维度做 direction- 与 magnitude-aware 的选择性合成；保持 vision encoder 与 multimodal projector 不变。
summary.experiments: 覆盖 57 种语言，在 text-only 与 vision-language 多语基准上评测，基于 LLaVA 系列模型做扩展对比（具体提升与对照方法需看正文表格）。

summary_en.core_problem: Extending an existing multimodal model to many languages typically requires costly multilingual multimodal data and end-to-end retraining.
summary_en.importance: A training-free model-merging approach to inject multilinguality into an existing MLLM; useful as a practical capability-transfer trick, less so as a new pretraining paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach: DiM3 selectively composes multilingual and multimodal residual updates in the shared LM backbone with direction- and magnitude-aware per-dimension merging, while keeping the vision encoder and multimodal projector fixed.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on text-only and vision-language multilingual benchmarks across 57 languages, built on LLaVA-family models (see main tables for exact gains and baselines).

recommendation.zh: 像是更精细的“delta 合并”工程招式：只需看合并规则和失败案例，别指望它替代多语多模态预训练。
recommendation.en: A more careful delta-merging trick—skim the merge rule and failure cases; don’t treat it as a substitute for real multilingual multimodal pretraining.

paper.title: Hard to Read, Easy to Jailbreak: How Visual Degradation Bypasses MLLM Safety Alignment
paper.abstract: Recent advancements in visual context compression enable MLLMs to process ultra-long contexts efficiently by rendering text into images. However, we identify a critical vulnerability inherent to this paradigm: lowering image resolution inadvertently catalyzes jailbreaking. Our experiments reveal that the safety defenses of SOTA models deteriorate sharply as resolution degrades, surprisingly persisting even when text remains legible. We attribute this to ``Cognitive Overload'', hypothesizing that

summary.core_problem: 研究把长文本渲染成图像供 MLLM 读取时，图像降质会如何绕过多模态安全对齐。
summary.importance: 贡献是一个 MLLM 安全分析与缓解策略：指出视觉压缩/视觉长上下文路径存在安全退化，而不是只看 OCR 可读性或任务准确率。
summary.technical_approach: 作者系统改变输入图像分辨率，并加入噪声、几何畸变等视觉扰动，观察安全拒答能力变化；他们用“认知负载”解释模型在解码低质量视觉文本时更少执行安全审查，并提出 Structured Cognitive Offloading，把视觉转写和安全判断拆成串行流程。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖多个当前 MLLM，在分辨率降低、噪声和几何变形下测试 jailbreak 成功率。摘要称即使文本仍然可读，安全防御也会明显下降；结构化转写再审查的流程能缓解风险。摘要未给出具体模型列表、参数量和数值提升。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Westlake University AGI Lab 与 University of California, Merced；从给定信息看，未识别出与 LLM 基座预训练强相关的知名作者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how degraded rendered-text images can bypass safety alignment in multimodal LLMs that read long textual contexts through vision.
summary_en.importance: It contributes a safety analysis for vision-based context compression: readability and OCR accuracy are not sufficient proxies for safety robustness.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors vary image resolution and add visual perturbations such as noise and geometric distortion, then measure safety failures.
