They explain the effect as cognitive overload: visual deciphering consumes model capacity that would otherwise support safety auditing. The proposed mitigation, Structured Cognitive Offloading, serializes visual transcription and safety assessment.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover several contemporary MLLMs under resolution degradation, noise, and geometric distortions. The abstract reports sharp safety degradation even when the text remains legible, and mitigation from the serialized offloading pipeline. Exact model names, parameter sizes, and numerical gains are not available in the provided abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from AGI Lab at Westlake University and University of California, Merced; no widely recognized LLM pretraining researcher is identifiable from the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 对预训练不是主线，但会修正“视觉压缩只要可读就安全”的默认假设；看现象和 mitigation 即可。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it weakens the assumption that readable visual compression is safety-neutral; read the phenomenon and mitigation only.

paper.title: Towards Annotation-Free Validation of MLLMs: A Vision-Language Logical Consistency Metric
paper.abstract: Dominant accuracy evaluation might reward unwarranted guessing of Large Language Models, and it might not be applicable to novel tasks for model validation without ground-truth (gt) annotation. Based on basic logic principle, we propose a novel framework to evaluate the vision-language logical consistency of MLLMs on both sufficient and necessary cause-effect relations. We define Vision-Language Logical Consistency Metric (VL-LCM) on traditional MC-VQA tests, and recent NaturalBench tests withou

summary.core_problem: 现有多模态大模型（MLLM）准确率评估依赖人工标注，易奖励模型无依据猜答案，无法适配无标注新任务的验证需求。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出无需标注的MLLM逻辑一致性评估框架，填补无标注场景下MLLM验证能力的空白。
summary.technical_approach: 基于因果关系的充分性、必要性逻辑原则，定义视觉语言逻辑一致性指标VL-LCM，可同时适配传统MC-VQA测试与无标注NaturalBench测试。
summary.experiments: 在MMMU、NaturalBench基准上评测4个系列共11个开源MLLM，发现现有模型准确率提升的同时逻辑一致性严重滞后，验证了VL-LCM与标注指标的高相关性。
summary.authors_note: 新加坡A*STAR信息通信研究院（I2R）团队

summary_en.core_problem: Existing MLLM accuracy evaluation relies on human annotations, tends to reward unwarranted guessing, and cannot support model validation on novel tasks without ground truth.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation, proposes an annotation-free MLLM logical consistency evaluation framework, fills the gap of MLLM validation in unlabeled scenarios.
summary_en.technical_approach: Based on logical principles of sufficiency and necessity in causal relations, defines Vision-Language Logical Consistency Metric (VL-LCM) compatible with both traditional MC-VQA and unlabeled NaturalBench tests.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluates 11 open-source MLLMs from 4 families on MMMU and NaturalBench, finds logical consistency lags far behind accuracy improvement, and validates high correlation between VL-LCM and annotation-based metrics.
summary_en.authors_note: Team from Institute for Infocomm Research (I2R), A*STAR, Singapore

recommendation.zh: 多模态评估的增量方法，仅作为无标注验证场景的备选方案备查，不需要读正文。
recommendation.en: Incremental multimodal evaluation method, only for reference in annotation-free validation scenarios, no need to read full text.

institutions: Agency for Science, Technology and Research (A*STAR)

paper.title: Awaking Spatial Intelligence in Unified Multimodal Understanding and Generation
paper.abstract: We present JoyAI-Image, a unified multimodal foundation model for visual understanding, text-to-image generation, and instruction-guided image editing. JoyAI-Image couples a spatially enhanced Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) with a Multimodal Diffusion Transformer (MMDiT), allowing perception and generation to interact through a shared multimodal interface. Around this architecture, we build a scalable training recipe that combines unified instruction tuning, long-text rendering supervisi

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的是统一多模态模型里一个常见但很难处理的断层：理解、生成、编辑虽然被放进同一系统，但三者往往只是模块并置，真正的信息耦合很弱；同时，现有统一模型对空间关系、几何一致性、视角变化和精细布局的建模不足，导致理解不够“可操作”，生成和编辑也缺少稳定的空间控制。作者试图把“空间智能”作为统一训练主线，而不是在生成端额外加一个控制模块。
summary.importance: 从基座预训练视角，这篇文章的价值主要在统一建模配方，而不是单点算法创新。它把 MLLM 与 MMDiT 通过共享接口耦合起来，并围绕空间数据、长文本渲染、空间编辑、多视角推理设计训练流程，目标是让理解信号真正反哺生成与编辑。对做 native multimodal pretrain 的人，这类工作有两个启发：一是统一模型不能只靠“同一个 backbone + 多个头”，还需要任务间可传递的中间表示；二是空间能力不是纯 benchmark 指标，而是决定统一模型是否能向 world model、VLA 这类方向延展的基础能力。论文的重要性中等偏上，但从给出的全文片段看，更像一套大规模系统工程与数据配方总结，而不是提出全新的预训练范式。
summary.technical_approach:
整体架构由三部分组成：空间增强的 MLLM、VAE、以及负责图像生成与编辑的 MMDiT。MLLM 被定义为“认知中枢”，既做图像理解和空间推理，也负责解析用户指令、参考图像和编辑意图，并把这些信息转成下游生成模块可消费的条件表示。VAE 负责像素空间与潜变量空间之间的桥接，MMDiT 则在潜空间里完成高保真生成与编辑。

方法上的关键不只是把理解模型和 diffusion 模型串起来，而是让二者通过共享的多模态接口形成双向协作。作者强调 understanding-driven generation：生成和编辑不是直接吃原始文本提示，而是吃经过 MLLM 解析后的、带有语义和空间 grounding 的条件信号。反过来，几何相关的生成与编辑任务，如空间操作、视角扩展、布局变换，也被当成对理解模块的补充监督，让模型在训练中接触“如果场景结构改变，视觉证据会怎样变化”这类信号。

训练上采用多阶段 curriculum。全文片段里能确认的几类数据包括：通用视觉理解数据、细粒度空间推理数据、高保真文生图数据、长文本排版与渲染监督、通用编辑数据、空间编辑数据，以及与 novel-view 或 view-assisted reasoning 相关的数据。这个配方的逻辑是先保证广泛视觉能力，再逐步注入空间约束更强、控制要求更高的任务，避免统一训练时生成目标和理解目标相互干扰。

如果和已有统一模型相比，这篇工作的差异点主要在两处。第一，它把空间 intelligence 作为贯穿式训练目标，而不是在编辑或 grounding 子任务上局部增强。第二，它强调 bidirectional loop：不是单向地用理解指导生成，而是让生成式变换反过来提供空间推理监督。这个思路与一些 AR+diffusion 联合建模工作相近，但这里仍是模块化接口耦合，不是 token-level 的完全统一序列建模。
summary.experiments:
从提供的全文片段可以确认，实验覆盖理解、生成、长文本渲染、编辑，以及空间相关能力，作者声称在 spatial understanding、long-text rendering、multi-view generation 和 controllable editing 上表现较强。但片段中没有给出具体 benchmark 名称、模型规模、训练数据规模、参数量或明确的数值提升，因此无法像精读论文那样复述关键数字。

即便如此，实验设计意图是清楚的：作者不是只测传统图文理解或文生图质量，而是把空间能力拆成多个可观察维度，包括细粒度空间理解、几何精确编辑、长文本排版、以及借助视角变化进行推理。这种评测组织方式本身有参考意义，因为它在检验统一模型是否真的形成了共享空间表征，而不是分别在几个任务上做局部适配。

如果后续阅读全文，最需要确认的是三类结果。第一，统一训练是否真的优于把 MLLM 和 diffusion 模块分开训练再拼接。第二，空间数据和空间编辑监督分别贡献了多少。第三，长文本渲染、多视角生成和空间推理之间是否存在可量化的迁移收益。如果论文在这些点上给出扎实消融，它的说服力会明显提高；如果只是大而全 benchmark 罗列，研究含金量会打折。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议是先看 Introduction 和 Figure 4，把系统拓扑理清：MLLM 在哪里结束，MMDiT 从哪里开始，二者共享的接口到底传什么。然后重点看训练数据与多阶段训练章节，确认空间 intelligence 是通过哪些任务和监督注入的。最后看实验中与 spatial understanding、editing、multi-view、long-text rendering 相关的主表和消融。预计 30 分钟左右可以判断这篇工作更偏“系统配方”还是“方法创新”。

阅读时建议抓四个问题。第一，统一接口是浅层 prompt 级耦合，还是包含更结构化的中间表示。第二，空间增强到底来自数据规模，还是来自架构与训练目标设计。第三，生成任务是否真的给理解带来反馈，而不只是共享 backbone 带来的参数复用。第四，长文本渲染和空间编辑是否共享同一类布局表征，这关系到模型是否学到了更一般的二维结构建模能力。

如果时间有限，可以优先看模型图、训练 recipe 总表、以及空间相关消融。若这些部分没有把“为什么这样统一，而不是简单串联现成 MLLM 和 diffusion 模型”讲清楚，这篇文章的核心价值就比较有限。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a common weakness in unified multimodal systems: understanding, generation, and editing are often placed in one framework but remain only loosely coupled, and spatial reasoning is still weak. Existing unified models can caption, generate, and edit, yet they often struggle with object layout, geometric consistency, viewpoint changes, and precise spatial control. The paper tries to make spatial intelligence a central training axis rather than a late add-on for editing or grounding.
summary_en.importance: For foundation-model research, the value here is mainly in unified multimodal pretraining and training recipe design, not in a single sharp algorithmic novelty. The work is relevant because it treats spatial capability as a shared representation problem across perception and generation. That matters for native multimodal pretraining, especially if one cares about extending image-language models toward world models or VLA-style systems. Based on the available full-text excerpt, the contribution looks like a large-scale system recipe with careful data/task design rather than a new modeling paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The architecture combines three components: a spatially enhanced MLLM, a VAE, and an MMDiT for image generation and editing. The MLLM acts as the cognitive front-end. It performs image understanding and spatial reasoning, parses user instructions and reference signals, and converts them into conditioning information for downstream generation. The VAE bridges pixel space and latent space, while the MMDiT operates in latent space for high-fidelity synthesis and instruction-guided editing.

The key idea is not merely to place an understanding model next to a diffusion model, but to couple them through a shared multimodal interface. Generation and editing are understanding-driven: instead of conditioning only on raw text prompts, the diffusion module receives semantically richer and spatially grounded signals produced by the MLLM. The reverse direction is also emphasized. Geometric edits, spatial manipulations, and view-expansion tasks are used as supervision that can feed back into spatial understanding, exposing the model to how scene evidence changes under structured transformations.

Training is organized as a multi-stage curriculum. From the excerpt, the data mixture includes general visual understanding, fine-grained spatial reasoning, high-fidelity text-to-image generation, long-text rendering supervision, general editing data, spatial editing data, and view-assisted or novel-view reasoning signals. The logic is straightforward: first establish broad multimodal competence, then inject tasks with stronger spatial constraints and tighter controllability requirements.

Relative to prior unified models, the main difference appears to be twofold. First, spatial intelligence is treated as a system-wide objective rather than a local enhancement for one subtask. Second, the paper explicitly argues for a bidirectional loop: understanding guides generation, and generative transformations provide additional supervision for understanding. That is conceptually close to some AR+diffusion joint-modeling trends, though this work still seems modular rather than fully token-unified.
summary_en.experiments:
From the provided full-text excerpt, the evaluation spans understanding, generation, long-text rendering, editing, and spatially oriented capabilities. The authors claim strong performance in spatial understanding, long-text rendering, multi-view generation, and controllable editing. However, the excerpt does not include concrete benchmark names, parameter counts, training data scale, or numerical gains, so a detailed quantitative reconstruction is not possible from the available text alone.

Even so, the evaluation design is informative. The paper does not restrict itself to generic VQA or text-to-image quality, but tries to probe whether the unified model develops a shared spatial representation through several observable dimensions: fine-grained spatial understanding, geometrically precise editing, typography-heavy generation, and reasoning assisted by viewpoint changes. That framing is useful in itself because it tests whether unification is real or merely a packaging of separate capabilities.

If reading the full paper, the most important things to verify are: whether joint training actually beats separately trained understanding and generation modules; how much of the gain comes from spatial data versus spatial editing supervision; and whether there is measurable transfer among long-text rendering, multi-view generation, and spatial reasoning. Strong ablations on those points would make the paper much more convincing.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a skim, start with the introduction and the main architecture figure, especially Figure 4, to understand where the MLLM ends, where the MMDiT begins, and what exactly is passed through the shared interface. Then go to the training-data and curriculum sections to see how spatial intelligence is injected. Finally, inspect the main tables and ablations for spatial understanding, editing, multi-view generation, and long-text rendering. Around 30 minutes should be enough to decide whether this is mainly a system recipe or a method paper.

While reading, keep four questions in mind. First, is the coupling shallow, at the prompt/interface level, or does it involve a more structured intermediate representation? Second, do the spatial gains come mostly from data scale, or from architectural and objective design? Third, does generation genuinely feed back into understanding, or is this just parameter sharing? Fourth, do long-text rendering and spatial editing rely on a common layout representation? That would indicate a more general 2D structural modeling capability.

If time is limited, prioritize the model diagram, the training-recipe summary, and the spatial ablations. If those sections do not clearly explain why this unified design is better than simply chaining an existing MLLM with a diffusion model, the paper’s core contribution is likely limited.

recommendation.zh: 只看架构图和 ablation；若空间数据带来的收益干净，这类理解-扩散耦合值得进入统一预训练备选。
recommendation.en: Skim the architecture and ablations; if the spatial-data gains are clean, this perception-diffusion coupling is worth considering for unified pretraining.

However, existing benchmarks lack diversity and compositional complexity, and standard lexical-overlap metrics (e.g., BLEU, METEOR) fail to capture semantic consistency or penalize hallucinations, which together prevent a comprehensive and robust

summary.core_problem: 现有图像差异描述（IDC）基准多样性与组合复杂度不足，传统词汇重叠评估指标无法捕捉语义一致性、无法惩罚幻觉，难以全面评测多模态大模型的细粒度变化感知与推理能力
summary.importance: Benchmark贡献，构建了首个覆盖10类差异的高复杂度IDC基准，提出了基于人类验证差异列表的LLM-as-Judge评估协议，解决了现有评估的鲁棒性问题
summary.technical_approach: 原创构建涵盖10种不同差异类别的DiffCap-Bench基准，设计基于人类标注Difference Lists的LLM-as-Judge评估流程，可同时衡量模型的变化捕捉准确性与描述语义一致性
summary.experiments: 对多个SOTA级MLLM进行系统性评测，验证了基准的难度与评估协议的有效性，指出现有模型在IDC任务上的显著能力短板
summary.authors_note: 作者来自华南理工大学、北京大学、天津大学等机构，无已知知名大模型研究者

summary_en.core_problem: Existing Image Difference Captioning (IDC) benchmarks lack diversity and compositional complexity, while traditional lexical overlap metrics fail to capture semantic consistency or penalize hallucinations, hindering robust evaluation of MLLMs' fine-grained change perception and reasoning capabilities
summary_en.importance: Benchmark contribution: constructs the first high-complexity IDC benchmark covering 10 difference categories, proposes an LLM-as-Judge evaluation protocol based on human-validated Difference Lists, resolving robustness issues of existing evaluation methods
summary_en.technical_approach: Originally builds DiffCap-Bench covering 10 distinct difference categories, designs an LLM-as-Judge evaluation pipeline based on human-annotated Difference Lists, which can simultaneously measure model's change detection accuracy and description semantic consistency
summary_en.experiments: Conducted systematic evaluation on multiple SOTA MLLMs, verified the benchmark's difficulty and the evaluation protocol's effectiveness, and identified significant capability gaps of existing models on IDC tasks
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from South China University of Technology, Peking University, Tianjin University, no well-known large model researchers identified

recommendation.zh: 多模态细粒度推理评测基准，仅作为领域文献备查，无需阅读正文
recommendation.en: Multimodal fine-grained reasoning benchmark, for literature reference only, no need to read the full text

paper.title: Enhancing Visual Question Answering with Multimodal LLMs via Chain-of-Question Guided Retrieval-Augmented Generation
paper.abstract: With advances in multimodal research and deep learning, Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have emerged as a powerful paradigm for a wide range of multimodal tasks. As a core problem in vision-language research, Visual Question Answering (VQA) has increasingly employed MLLMs to improve performance, particularly in open-domain settings where external knowledge is essential. In this work, we aim to further enhance retrieval-based VQA by more effectively integrating MLLMs with structured reas

summary.core_problem: 解决开放域 VQA 中 MLLM 需要外部知识，但普通检索往往不能围绕图像问题形成足够准确、连贯证据的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 VLM 推理阶段的 RAG 框架改进，重点在提示式问题分解和检索引导；它不是多模态预训练方法，但能反映 VLM 推理链与外部知识结合时的常见设计。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 CoVQD，将 Chain-of-Thought 推理与 Visual Question Decomposition 结合，把视觉问题拆成更有逻辑结构的子问题，再用这些子问题引导检索；在此基础上构建 CgRAG，让 MLLM 使用更相关的外部知识完成 VQA。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明该方法提升 retrieval-based VQA 表现，但未给出具体数据集、使用的 MLLM、检索库规模、baseline 组合和数值提升；因此只能判断为推理框架层面的增量工作。
summary.authors_note: 作者信息显示部分作者来自 Macau University of Science and Technology，另有 Hubei Key Laboratory of Transportation Internet 相关单位。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets open-domain VQA where multimodal LLMs need external knowledge, but naive retrieval often fails to obtain evidence that is both relevant and coherent for the visual question.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an inference-time RAG framework for VLMs, centered on structured prompting and retrieval guidance. It is not a multimodal pretraining method, but it reflects a common design pattern for combining VLM reasoning with external knowledge.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method introduces CoVQD, which fuses chain-of-thought reasoning with visual question decomposition. The decomposed sub-questions are then used to guide retrieval, forming the CgRAG framework for knowledge-augmented MLLM inference.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports improved retrieval-based VQA performance, but does not specify datasets, MLLM backbones, retrieval corpus scale, baselines, or numerical gains. The evidence is therefore best read as an incremental inference-framework result.
summary_en.authors_note: The author information indicates affiliations including Macau University of Science and Technology and Hubei Key Laboratory of Transportation Internet.

recommendation.zh: 只需看方法图和检索构造；这是 VQA-RAG 提示工程增量，对 pretrain 的帮助主要是观察失败模式。
recommendation.en: Skim only the method diagram and retrieval construction; this is an incremental VQA-RAG prompting setup, useful mainly for spotting inference-time failure modes.

paper.title: Uni-OPD: Unifying On-Policy Distillation with a Dual-Perspective Recipe
paper.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) has recently emerged as an effective post-training paradigm for consolidating the capabilities of specialized expert models into a single student model. Despite its empirical success, the conditions under which OPD yields reliable improvement remain poorly understood. In this work, we identify two fundamental bottlenecks that limit effective OPD: insufficient exploration of informative states and unreliable teacher supervision for student rollouts. Building on this i

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是 on-policy distillation 的可靠性问题：学生模型在自己的采样轨迹上接受教师 token-level 监督，但学生探索到的状态未必有训练价值，教师在这些学生轨迹上的逐 token 反馈也未必可信。两者都会让 OPD 在长链推理、多任务和多模态蒸馏中不稳定。
summary.importance: 这是一篇 post-train 方向的高相关论文。它没有改变基座预训练目标，但对 pretrain ↔ posttrain 接口有实际信息量。原因是 OPD 同时吸收了 SFT 的 dense supervision 和 RL 的 on-policy sampling：学生不会只模仿离线专家答案，而是在自己会到达的状态上学习；教师又能提供比终局 reward 更细的 token 级训练信号。论文的主要贡献是把 OPD 的失败来源拆成两个可操作问题：状态探索不足和教师监督不可靠，并给出一套在 LLM 与 MLLM 上统一使用的 recipe。对做持续预训练、能力合并、专家模型蒸馏和多模态统一模型的人来说，它提供的是训练信号质量控制方法，而不只是一个蒸馏 loss。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 Uni-OPD，核心是 dual-perspective optimization：从学生侧改善探索，从教师侧校准监督。基础 OPD 设定是：给定问题 q，学生策略 πθ 采样轨迹 τ；训练时在这些 on-policy prefix 上最小化学生和教师 πT 的 reverse KL。这个目标可以被解释为在学生实际访问的状态上施加 token-level reward，因此比离线 SFT 更少受 exposure bias 影响，也比只用终局奖励的 RL 更容易做细粒度 credit assignment。学生侧使用两种数据平衡。第一是 offline difficulty-aware balancing，先按样本难度组织训练分布，避免训练批次被过易样本主导，也避免大量不可学样本带来噪声。第二是 online correctness-aware balancing，根据学生当前采样轨迹的正确性动态调节训练样本，让模型持续看到“有信息量”的状态，尤其是接近决策边界的正确与错误轨迹。教师侧提出 outcome-guided margin calibration。它不盲目信任教师在学生轨迹上的 token 概率，而是用 outcome reward 作为全局锚点检查轨迹级排序：正确轨迹的聚合教师分数应高于错误轨迹。若教师的逐 token 信号在轨迹级别与结果奖励不一致，就通过 margin 约束进行校准，使 token-level supervision 与最终正确性保持更一致。这个设计针对的是 OPD 的常见问题：教师在 OOD 学生前缀上退化、给流畅但错误的推理较高概率、多个教师之间信号冲突，或在多模态输入上产生不稳定的 token 偏好。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 5 个领域和 16 个 benchmark，包含 LLM 与 MLLM 设置。论文报告了多种蒸馏场景：single-teacher distillation、multi-teacher distillation、strong-to-weak distillation，以及 text-only 与 multimodal task 混合的 cross-modal distillation。关键实验结论是，单独使用 vanilla OPD 会受到学生采样分布和教师信号质量的限制；加入 offline difficulty-aware balancing 和 online correctness-aware balancing 后，学生访问到的训练状态更有信息量；再加入 outcome-guided margin calibration 后，教师 token 监督与结果正确性的顺序一致性提高，训练效果更稳定。消融的核心价值在于证明三件事：探索平衡和监督校准解决的是不同瓶颈；只做数据平衡不能修复错误教师信号；只做教师校准也不能弥补学生状态覆盖不足。正文片段未给出可核验的逐 benchmark 数值，因此不应编造具体提升幅度。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读。先看 Introduction 中对 OPD 两个瓶颈的定义，因为这是整篇论文的判断框架。然后看 Methodology 的 OPD 梯度推导，尤其是 reverse KL 如何诱导 token-level reward；这部分决定了它和 SFT、GRPO 类 RL 的差异。随后重点读 Fig. 2 和 3.3、3.4：3.3 看两种 balancing 如何构造训练分布，3.4 看 outcome reward 如何校准教师 token 信号。实验部分优先看三类内容：order-consistency 的分析图、三组件消融、LLM/MLLM 和 multi-teacher 设置下的稳定性对比。值得深挖的是 margin calibration 的可替代实现，例如能否用 verifier、process reward model 或 execution feedback 替代简单 outcome reward，以及这种校准是否会过度压制教师的软分布信息。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies when on-policy distillation is reliable. OPD trains a student on its own sampled trajectories with token-level teacher supervision, but two things can fail: the student may not explore informative states, and the teacher may give unreliable token-level guidance on student-generated prefixes.
summary_en.importance: This is a high-signal post-training paper for foundation-model researchers. It does not propose a new pretraining objective, but it is relevant to the interface between pretraining and post-training. OPD combines two useful properties: on-policy sampling from RL and dense token-level supervision from distillation. The paper’s contribution is to turn OPD reliability into two controllable training-signal problems: state coverage and teacher-signal calibration. That matters for expert merging, continual capability injection, multimodal unification, and strong-to-weak transfer.
summary_en.technical_approach: Uni-OPD uses a dual-perspective recipe. From the student side, it improves exploration with two balancing strategies. Offline difficulty-aware balancing shapes the training distribution by sample difficulty, so training is not dominated by trivial examples or by examples that are too hard to learn from. Online correctness-aware balancing then uses the student’s current rollout correctness to keep training focused on informative states, especially near the boundary between correct and incorrect behavior. From the teacher side, the paper introduces outcome-guided margin calibration. Vanilla OPD trusts the teacher’s token probabilities on student rollouts, but those rollouts can be out of distribution for the teacher. The proposed calibration uses outcome reward as a global anchor: after aggregating token-level teacher scores over a trajectory, correct trajectories should rank above incorrect ones by a margin. If this order consistency is violated, the teacher signal is adjusted. This is meant to handle teacher degradation on unusual student prefixes, fluent but wrong reasoning chains, conflicts between multiple teachers, and unstable multimodal supervision.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers 5 domains and 16 benchmarks across LLM and MLLM settings. The paper tests single-teacher distillation, multi-teacher distillation, strong-to-weak distillation, and cross-modal distillation that mixes text-only and multimodal tasks. The main empirical message is that vanilla OPD is limited by both student exploration and teacher reliability. The two balancing strategies improve the informativeness of student-generated states, while outcome-guided margin calibration improves the agreement between token-level teacher supervision and final correctness. The ablations are important because they separate the two bottlenecks: balancing cannot fix a miscalibrated teacher signal, and calibration cannot compensate for poor state coverage. The provided content does not expose verifiable per-benchmark numbers, so specific accuracy gains should not be inferred.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is worth a careful read. Start with the introduction, where the two OPD bottlenecks are defined. Then read the OPD gradient derivation in the methodology section; it clarifies why reverse-KL distillation on student rollouts can be viewed as token-level reward learning. The most important parts are Fig. 2 and Sections 3.3–3.4: Section 3.3 explains how the data distribution is balanced, and Section 3.4 explains how outcome reward calibrates teacher supervision. In the experiments, prioritize the order-consistency analysis, component ablations, and the LLM/MLLM multi-teacher results. A useful follow-up question is whether the margin calibration can be driven by verifiers, process reward models, or execution feedback without destroying the useful soft information in teacher distributions.

recommendation.zh: 读 §3 的两个 bottleneck 和 teacher order-consistency；若指标干净，可直接变成内部蒸馏诊断项。
recommendation.en: Read the two bottlenecks and teacher order-consistency analysis; if the metrics are clean, they become immediate internal OPD diagnostics.

paper.title: Visual Latents Know More Than They Say: Unsilencing Latent Reasoning in MLLMs
paper.abstract: Continuous latent-space reasoning offers a compact alternative to textual chain-of-thought for multimodal models, enabling high-dimensional visual evidence to be integrated without explicit reasoning tokens. However, we identify a previously overlooked optimization pathology in existing latent visual reasoning methods: although visual latents become semantically enriched during training, their contribution to final answer prediction is systematically suppressed. Within the shared parameter space

summary.core_problem: 解释并缓解 MLLM 中连续视觉 latent reasoning token 被训练成语义丰富但对最终答案贡献很小的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态推理机制分析和方法改进。它把视觉 latent reasoning 的失败模式从“latent 是否学到语义”推进到“学到的 latent 是否被解码器使用”，这对 native multimodal 预训练和 latent reasoning 目标设计都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 Silenced Visual Latents 现象：共享参数空间内，自回归答案目标更容易依赖直接视觉输入形成 shortcut，使 latent token 变成类似过渡状态，而不是承载可用推理内容。方法上不更新 backbone，而是在推理时直接优化 latent reasoning；第一阶段用 query-guided contrastive latent-visual alignment 预热视觉 latent，使其更贴近问题相关视觉证据。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体 MLLM backbone、参数量、数据集、任务列表或提升数字。可确认的是方法以冻结 backbone 的推理时 latent 优化为主，需要正文核查其计算开销、是否依赖答案泄漏式目标、以及对 VQA/图文推理任务的稳定性。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why continuous visual latent reasoning tokens in MLLMs can become semantically enriched yet contribute little to final answer prediction.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is both a multimodal reasoning analysis and a method proposal. It shifts the question from whether visual latents contain semantics to whether the decoder actually uses them, which matters for native multimodal pretraining and latent-reasoning objective design.
summary_en.technical_approach: It identifies Silenced Visual Latents: under a shared parameter space, the autoregressive answer objective favors shortcuts through direct visual inputs, pushing latent tokens toward transition-like states instead of useful reasoning states. The proposed remedy keeps the backbone frozen and optimizes latent reasoning at inference time; Stage I warms up visual latents with query-guided contrastive latent-visual alignment.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify the MLLM backbone, parameter count, datasets, task suite, or numerical gains. The key experimental checks should be inference-time compute cost, whether the optimization objective leaks answer information, and robustness across VQA and multimodal reasoning tasks.

recommendation.zh: 只看现象验证和消融；若 latent 被“学会但不用”成立，MLLM 预训练目标要显式约束信息流。
recommendation.en: Read the evidence and ablations; if “learned but unused” latents are real, MLLM pretraining objectives need explicit constraints on information flow.

paper.title: X2SAM: Any Segmentation in Images and Videos
paper.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated strong image-level visual understanding and reasoning, yet their pixel-level perception across both images and videos remains limited. Foundation segmentation models such as the SAM series produce high-quality masks, but they rely on low-level visual prompts and cannot natively interpret complex conversational instructions. Existing segmentation MLLMs narrow this gap, but are usually specialized for either images or videos and rarely sup

summary.core_problem: 让多模态大模型在图像和视频中统一支持由对话指令与视觉提示驱动的像素级分割。
summary.importance: 贡献是多模态像素级感知系统：把LLM的语言交互能力和SAM类分割能力结合，并扩展到视频时间一致性。它与VLM grounding有关，但主要仍是分割下游系统，不是通用多模态预训练范式。
summary.technical_approach: X2SAM将LLM与分割模块耦合，引入Mask Memory存储由提示引导得到的视觉特征，用于视频中时间一致的mask生成。同一接口支持文本提示、视觉提示、开放词表分割、指代表达分割、推理分割、grounded conversation和交互式分割等任务。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型参数量、训练数据规模、baseline名称或具体分数；声称覆盖图像与视频、多类提示和多种分割任务，但从给定信息无法判断泛化是否来自统一训练还是任务集合堆叠。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括中山大学和鹏城实验室；Xiaodan Liang是视觉理解与多模态方向较活跃的研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to give multimodal large language models unified pixel-level segmentation capability over both images and videos using conversational instructions and visual prompts.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a multimodal pixel-level perception system: it connects LLM-based language interaction with SAM-style segmentation and extends the setup to temporally consistent video masks. It is relevant to VLM grounding, but remains primarily a downstream segmentation system rather than a general multimodal pretraining paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach: X2SAM couples an LLM with a segmentation module and introduces a Mask Memory component that stores prompt-guided visual features for temporally consistent video mask generation. The same interface supports textual prompts, visual prompts, open-vocabulary segmentation, referring segmentation, reasoning segmentation, grounded conversation, and interactive segmentation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model size, training data scale, baseline names, or numerical results. It claims broad coverage across image and video segmentation tasks and prompt types, but the provided information is insufficient to judge whether the gains come from unified learning or task aggregation.
summary_en.authors_note: Affiliations include Sun Yat-Sen University and Peng Cheng Laboratory. Xiaodan Liang is an active researcher in visual understanding and multimodal learning.

recommendation.zh: 可作为VLM像素grounding系统备查；只看Mask Memory设计，别把它当预训练范式论文读。
recommendation.en: Useful as a VLM pixel-grounding system reference; read the Mask Memory design only, not as a pretraining-paradigm paper.

paper.title: EmoMM: Benchmarking and Steering MLLM for Multimodal Emotion Recognition under Conflict and Missingness
paper.abstract: Multimodal Emotion Recognition (MER) is critical for interpreting real-world interactions. While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLM) have shown promise in MER, their internal decision-making mechanisms under modality conflict and missingness remain largely underexplored. In this paper, to systematically investigate these behaviors, we introduce EmoMM, a comprehensive benchmark featuring modality-aligned, conflict, and missing subsets. Through extensive evaluation, we uncover a Video Contribu

summary.core_problem: 分析多模态大模型在情绪识别中面对模态冲突和模态缺失时如何做决策，以及能否在不重训的情况下修正偏置。
summary.importance: 贡献是一个偏多模态机制分析的 benchmark 加推理时 steering 方法。虽然任务是情绪识别，领域性较强，但它讨论的 modality conflict、missingness、视频证据被忽略等问题，对 VLM/MLLM 预训练中的模态平衡和 token 冗余有间接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 EmoMM benchmark，包含模态一致、模态冲突和模态缺失子集，用于系统检查 MLLM 的跨模态决策。作者发现 Video Contribution Collapse，即模型在冲突场景中因视频 token 冗余和模态偏好而边缘化视频证据。为此提出 CHASE，在推理时检测模态冲突，并在 head 级别做 attention steering，无需重训 backbone。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在多种设置下评测 MLLM，并显示 CHASE 在冲突和缺失场景中稳定提升表现，尤其缓解决策偏置。未给出具体模型列表、参数规模、样本量、baseline 和提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 South China University of Technology School of Future Technology；未能从给定信息确认知名作者或通用 MLLM 团队背景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how multimodal large language models make decisions for emotion recognition under modality conflict and missingness, and whether inference-time steering can reduce bias without retraining.
summary_en.importance: The contribution combines a multimodal behavior benchmark with an inference-time steering method. Although emotion recognition is domain-specific, the observed issues around modality conflict, missingness, and video evidence suppression are indirectly relevant to modality balancing in MLLM pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce EmoMM, with modality-aligned, conflict, and missing subsets for probing cross-modal decision behavior. They identify Video Contribution Collapse, where MLLMs marginalize video evidence due to token redundancy and modality preference. CHASE then detects modality conflict and applies head-level attention steering at inference time without retraining the backbone.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports evaluation across multiple MLLM settings and consistent improvements from CHASE under conflict and missingness, especially in reducing decision bias. The provided abstract does not include the exact model list, parameter sizes, dataset scale, baselines, or numerical gains.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with the School of Future Technology, South China University of Technology. No widely known MLLM author or team signature can be confirmed from the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 任务偏窄，但 Video Contribution Collapse 可作 MLLM 模态失衡案例；只看现象定义和 CHASE 消融。
recommendation.en: The task is narrow, but Video Contribution Collapse is a useful case of MLLM modality imbalance; read only the phenomenon definition and CHASE ablations.

paper.title: Let ViT Speak: Generative Language-Image Pre-training
paper.abstract: In this paper, we present \textbf{Gen}erative \textbf{L}anguage-\textbf{I}mage \textbf{P}re-training (GenLIP), a minimalist generative pretraining framework for Vision Transformers (ViTs) designed for multimodal large language models (MLLMs). To better align vision encoders with the autoregressive nature of LLMs, GenLIP trains a ViT to predict language tokens directly from visual tokens using a standard language modeling objective, without contrastive batch construction or an additional text dec

summary.core_problem: GenLIP 解决的是 MLLM 视觉编码器预训练目标与下游自回归 LLM 使用方式不一致的问题。CLIP/SigLIP 这类对比学习视觉编码器学到的是图文判别式对齐；CapPa、AIMv2、OpenVision2 等生成式方法虽然使用语言建模损失，但通常需要额外文本 decoder 或 text encoder，视觉 backbone 通过这些模块间接受训。GenLIP 的问题设定更直接：能否让 ViT 本身在图像 token 条件下预测文本 token，从而把视觉编码器训练成更适合被 LLM 消费的表示器。
summary.importance: 这篇工作的价值在于把视觉编码器预训练重新收敛到一个很干净的语言建模问题上。它不是给 MLLM 再加一个复杂桥接模块，而是改变视觉 backbone 的预训练接口：输入图像 patch，输出语言 token 的预测分布。对预训练研究的启发主要有三点。第一，VLP 的目标函数可以更靠近 downstream MLLM 的 next-token 形式，而不是依赖 batch 内负样本的对比学习。第二，生成式视觉预训练不一定需要独立文本 decoder；如果 attention mask 设计得当，单个 Transformer 可以同时承载图像 prefix 表示和文本预测。第三，OCR 等细粒度视觉语言任务的收益说明，语言 token 监督可能比全局图文 embedding 对齐更能逼迫视觉 encoder 保留局部可读信息。
summary.technical_approach: GenLIP 的核心设计是“图像在前、文本在后”的 prefix-LM。每个图文样本先把图像切成非重叠 patch，经卷积 patch embedding 得到视觉 token；文本用 Qwen3 tokenizer 切成 subword token。两类 token 拼接成一个序列后送入同一个 Transformer。模型包含模态相关 embedding、统一 Transformer、LayerNorm 和 LM head。训练时使用标准自回归语言建模损失，主要监督文本 token 的预测。关键不在于新模块，而在于 attention 结构：图像 token 作为 prefix 提供条件，文本 token 按因果方式预测后续语言。这样 ViT 不再通过 contrastive loss 学全局相似度，也不再经由额外 decoder 间接受训，而是在视觉上下文上直接承担语言预测任务。与 CoCa、SigLIP2 这类混合方法相比，GenLIP 去掉了 text encoder 和对比损失；与 CapPa/AIMv2/OpenVision2 相比，它去掉了额外 text decoder，把优化压力压到统一 backbone 上。论文还提到第二阶段 native-aspect-ratio adaptation，用于降低固定分辨率/固定宽高比训练和真实 MLLM 输入之间的差异，这对文档、表格、OCR 类任务尤其重要。
summary.experiments: 论文报告 GenLIP 使用 8B 图文样本进行预训练，并在不同模型规模和数据规模下呈现稳定扩展趋势。它作为 MLLM 视觉 encoder 接入后，在多类 multimodal benchmark 上达到与强 VLP baseline 相当或更好的结果，尤其在 OCR 相关任务上优势更明显。这里的实验重点不是单点 benchmark 排名，而是三个判断：第一，纯生成式 LM 目标可以训练出可用且强的视觉 encoder；第二，在只使用 8B 样本的设定下，可以匹配或超过使用更大语料的强 baseline；第三，native aspect ratio 二阶段适配能进一步提升下游 MLLM 表现。给出的正文片段没有完整列出具体表格数值、模型参数规模和逐项消融结果，因此不应补造未出现的数字。精读时需要核对完整实验表中 GenLIP 与 CLIP/SigLIP/OpenVision2/AIMv2 的训练数据量、ViT 尺寸、输入分辨率、MLLM 接入方式是否严格对齐。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读方法部分的 sequence construction、attention mask 和 loss 定义。这决定了 GenLIP 到底是在训练一个“会说话的 ViT”，还是在训练一个带视觉 prefix 的小型语言模型。其次看预训练数据配比、caption 来源、tokenizer 选择和文本长度截断，因为这些因素会直接影响 OCR、细粒度 grounding 和泛化。实验部分优先看 scaling 曲线、与 contrastive/generative baselines 的同规模对比、native aspect ratio adaptation 的消融，以及接入 MLLM 后 connector 是否保持一致。值得深挖的问题有两个：一是 LM head 训练后的表示是否对不同 LLM tokenizer 具有迁移性；二是该目标是否会让视觉 encoder 过度拟合 caption 风格，从而牺牲开放视觉识别或 spatial reasoning。

summary_en.core_problem: GenLIP targets a mismatch in current MLLM pipelines: vision encoders are often pretrained with contrastive image-text alignment, while the downstream LLM consumes visual features inside an autoregressive next-token prediction system. Existing generative VLP methods reduce this mismatch, but they usually add a text decoder or text encoder, so the visual backbone is optimized through extra modules. GenLIP asks whether a ViT can be trained more directly: condition on image patches and predict language tokens itself.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is a simpler pretraining interface for MLLM vision encoders. Instead of learning a global discriminative embedding through batch negatives, the encoder is trained under a language modeling objective that is closer to the downstream use case. This matters for pretraining because it removes several sources of architectural and objective mismatch: no contrastive batch construction, no separate text decoder, and no hybrid text encoder path. The reported strength on OCR-style tasks is also informative. Token-level language supervision appears to force the visual backbone to preserve fine-grained textual and local visual evidence more strongly than global image-text alignment alone.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method concatenates image patch embeddings and text token embeddings into one sequence. Images are split into non-overlapping patches with a ViT-style convolutional patch embedding. Captions are tokenized with a Qwen3 tokenizer. A single Transformer processes the joint sequence using a prefix-LM attention pattern: image tokens act as the visual prefix, and text tokens are predicted autoregressively under a standard language modeling loss. The model uses modality-specific embeddings, a unified Transformer, LayerNorm, and an LM head. The design differs from CLIP and SigLIP by replacing contrastive alignment with token prediction. It differs from CapPa, AIMv2, and OpenVision2 by removing the auxiliary text decoder and making the ViT-like backbone receive the language modeling training signal directly. The paper also introduces a second-stage native-aspect-ratio adaptation step, which reduces the gap between fixed-ratio pretraining and real multimodal inputs such as documents, screenshots, and OCR-heavy images.
summary_en.experiments: GenLIP is pretrained on 8B image-text samples. The paper reports consistent gains when scaling data and model size, and shows competitive or better downstream MLLM results compared with strong vision-language pretraining baselines, including models trained on larger corpora. The most visible gains are on OCR-related benchmarks, which is consistent with the token-level supervision used during pretraining. The provided manuscript excerpt does not expose the full numerical tables, model sizes, or all ablations, so the safe reading is qualitative on the exact margins. The important checks in the full paper are whether baselines use comparable ViT capacity, image resolution, connector design, downstream LLM, and multimodal instruction tuning data.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the architecture and objective definitions carefully, especially the sequence layout, prefix-LM mask, and which tokens receive loss. Those details determine whether the method is truly direct generative pretraining for the vision backbone. Then inspect the data section: caption source, filtering, token length, image resolution, and data mixture can change the interpretation of OCR and grounding gains. In the experiments, focus on scaling curves, same-size comparisons with contrastive and decoder-based generative baselines, the native-aspect-ratio ablation, and MLLM integration details. Two questions are worth probing: whether the learned representation transfers cleanly across LLM tokenizers, and whether caption prediction biases the encoder toward caption-like semantics at the expense of broader visual recognition.

recommendation.zh: 应读方法和 scaling 表；若数据账干净，它会改变视觉 encoder 是否必须先做对比学习的默认设定。
recommendation.en: Read the method and scaling tables; if the data accounting is clean, it weakens the default assumption that vision encoders need contrastive pretraining first.

paper.title: State Beyond Appearance: Diagnosing and Improving State Consistency in Dial-Based Measurement Reading
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have achieved impressive progress on general multimodal tasks, yet they remain brittle on dial-based measurement reading. In this paper, we study this problem through controlled benchmarks and feature-space probing, and show that current MLLMs not only achieve unsatisfactory accuracy on dial-based readout, but also suffer sharp performance drops under viewpoint and illumination changes even when the underlying dial state remains fixed. Our probing analysi

summary.core_problem: 诊断并改善 MLLM 在表盘读数任务中只看外观、不保持真实物理状态一致性的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是面向 MLLM 细粒度视觉读数的 benchmark、特征空间 probing 和对齐方法；它不是通用多模态预训练工作，但对理解 VLM 在几何状态、连续数值和外观扰动下的失效模式有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文通过受控 benchmark 比较同一表盘状态在视角、光照变化下的表现，并在特征空间分析 same-state 样本是否聚类、neighboring-state 是否保持连续局部结构；随后提出 TriSCA，进行 tri-level state-consistent alignment，以约束表盘状态表示而不是仅拟合外观。
summary.experiments: 摘要未列出模型规模、数据规模和具体提升数值；实验包括当前 MLLM 在表盘读数上的准确率、视角/光照变化下的性能下降、特征空间 probing，以及 TriSCA 对读数准确率和状态一致性的改善。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Beihang University、Fudan University 和 Peking University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper diagnoses and improves state consistency in MLLMs for dial-based measurement reading, where models often track appearance rather than the underlying physical state.
summary_en.importance: It contributes a controlled benchmark, feature-space probing, and an alignment method for fine-grained visual readout. It is not a general multimodal pretraining paper, but it offers useful evidence about VLM failures under geometry, continuous values, and appearance perturbations.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors construct controlled tests where the same dial state appears under different viewpoints and illumination, then probe whether same-state samples cluster and whether neighboring states preserve local continuity. TriSCA is proposed as a tri-level state-consistent alignment framework to regularize state representation instead of fitting superficial appearance.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not give model sizes, dataset scale, or exact numerical gains. The evaluation covers MLLM accuracy on dial reading, degradation under viewpoint and illumination shifts, feature-space probing, and improvements from TriSCA.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Beihang University, Fudan University, and Peking University.

recommendation.zh: 只看 probing 结果即可；它把 VLM 细粒度状态变量学不稳这件事测得比较干净，但任务窄，不足以改训练路线。
recommendation.en: Read the probing results only; the failure mode is cleanly measured, but the dial-reading setup is too narrow to drive a pretraining change.

paper.title: PivotMerge: Bridging Heterogeneous Multimodal Pre-training via Post-Alignment Model Merging
paper.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) rely on multimodal pre-training over diverse data sources, where different datasets often induce complementary cross-modal alignment capabilities. Model merging provides a cost-effective mechanism for integrating multiple expert MLLMs with complementary strengths into a unified model. However, existing model merging research mainly focuses on post-finetuning scenarios, leaving the pre-training stage largely unexplored. We argue that the core of MLLM pre-t

summary.core_problem: 现有多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的模型融合主要集中在微调后（post-finetuning）阶段，忽略了预训练阶段。预训练阶段的核心在于建立跨模态对齐，而不同数据集训练出的投影层（projector）具有互补的对齐能力，如何有效融合这些异构的预训练投影层是一个未解问题。
summary.importance: 首次将模型融合的视角引入 MLLM 预训练的跨模态对齐阶段，提出了 post-alignment merging 任务。这为低成本整合不同数据分布下的基础多模态理解能力提供了一种新范式，有望为后续微调提供更强的基座。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 PivotMerge 框架，针对两个核心挑战进行设计：1) 跨域参数干扰：通过共享空间分解与过滤（Shared-space Decomposition and Filtering），将投影层更新分解为共享正交基和特定系数，并将系数解耦为主对齐核心和特定域残差，过滤掉一致性低的残差方向，保留共享对齐结构。2) 层级对齐贡献差异：引入对齐引导的逐层融合（Alignment-guided Layer-wise Merging），评估不同层在不同模型中的相对对齐贡献，并为主要对齐核心分配相应的逐层融合权重。
summary.experiments: 在“视觉-投影层-语言”架构下进行了初步基准测试。结果表明，PivotMerge 能有效整合不同投影层学习到的跨模态对齐能力，缓解参数冲突，并在后续微调任务中表现出优于单一预训练模型或传统融合方法的性能。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注 Introduction 中对 post-alignment merging 任务的定义，以及 Method 中 Shared-space Decomposition 和 Alignment-guided Layer-wise Merging 的具体数学实现，理解其如何分离共享对齐模式与特定域噪声。预计阅读时间 15 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing model merging for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) primarily focuses on the post-finetuning stage, neglecting the pre-training phase. The core of pre-training is cross-modal alignment, and projectors trained on different datasets possess complementary alignment capabilities. How to effectively merge these heterogeneous pre-trained projectors remains an open question.
summary_en.importance: Introduces the post-alignment merging task, bringing the model merging perspective to the cross-modal alignment stage of MLLM pre-training for the first time. This provides a new paradigm for cost-effectively integrating fundamental multimodal understanding capabilities from different data distributions, potentially offering a stronger foundation for subsequent fine-tuning.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the PivotMerge framework to address two core challenges: 1) Cross-domain Parameter Interference: Employs Shared-space Decomposition and Filtering to decompose projector updates into a shared orthogonal basis and specific coefficients. The coefficients are further decoupled into a primary alignment core and a domain-specific residual. Residual directions with low consistency are filtered out to preserve the shared alignment structure. 2) Layer-wise Alignment Contribution Disparity: Introduces Alignment-guided Layer-wise Merging to estimate the relative alignment contributions of different layers across models and assign corresponding layer-wise merging weights to the primary alignment cores.
summary_en.experiments: Conducted preliminary benchmarks under the 'Vision-Projector-Language' architecture. Results demonstrate that PivotMerge effectively integrates cross-modal alignment capabilities learned by different projectors, mitigates parameter conflicts, and outperforms single pre-trained models or traditional merging methods in subsequent fine-tuning tasks.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the definition of the post-alignment merging task in the Introduction, and the mathematical implementation of Shared-space Decomposition and Alignment-guided Layer-wise Merging in the Method section to understand how it separates shared alignment patterns from domain-specific noise. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫方法和消融：把 merging 放到 MLLM 预训练对齐阶段是干净问题，但别只看平均分，要看合并后负迁移。
recommendation.en: Skim the method and ablations: merging at the MLLM alignment stage is a clean problem, but the real signal is negative transfer after merging, not average scores.

paper.title: Can MLLMs "Read" What is Missing?
paper.abstract: We introduce MMTR-Bench, a benchmark designed to evaluate the intrinsic ability of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to reconstruct masked text directly from visual context. Unlike conventional question-answering tasks, MMTR-Bench eliminates explicit prompts, requiring models to recover masked text from single- or multi-page inputs across real-world domains such as documents and webpages. This design isolates the reconstruction task from instruction-following abilities, enabling a direct

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的问题不是“MLLM 会不会答题”，而是更基础的一层：在没有显式问题提示的情况下，模型能否仅凭视觉上下文、版面结构、跨区域线索和少量常识，把被遮挡的文本恢复出来。现有文档/网页类 benchmark 大多还是 QA 设定，问题本身已经告诉模型该看哪里，因此很难分离出模型的原生视觉定位、布局理解和跨页整合能力。MMTR-Bench 把任务改成 masked text reconstruction，目的就是把 instruction following 的干扰尽量拿掉，单独测“读图时发现缺失并补全”的能力。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义主要在评测侧，而不是提出新的训练方法。它补上了一个过去较少被单独测量的能力维度：MLLM 是否真的学会了在原生视觉输入上做全局信息整合，而不是依赖问答模板和局部 OCR。这个维度和文档预训练、网页理解、多页长上下文建模、视觉 token 与文本 token 的对齐质量都有直接关系。量级上，它更像一个高质量诊断 benchmark，而不是改变训练范式的工作；但如果做文档 VLM、native multimodal pretrain、视觉 masking 或 layout-aware pretrain，这个 benchmark 能提供比传统 DocVQA 更干净的失效信号。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上有三个关键设计。第一，任务定义刻意去 QA 化。输入是一页或多页图像，其中局部文本被 mask，模型直接输出缺失文本，而不是回答一个自然语言问题。这样模型必须自己完成相关区域检索、结构关联和内容恢复。第二，数据构造强调“可恢复但不靠语言先验瞎猜”。作者没有用随机 masking，而是人工挑选遮挡区域，并遵循几条约束：被遮挡内容必须和周围上下文有明确关系；剩余区域要提供足够证据；任务必须迫使模型用视觉/结构/跨区域线索，而不是只靠语言模型先验；样本要经过复核，尽量保证答案唯一。第三，评测采用 level-aware protocol。因为目标长度差异很大，短答案更适合 exact match，长答案则需要语义相似度和事实一致性判断。作者还加入了 LLM-based factuality gate，试图把自动指标和人工判断拉近，避免长文本只靠表面 n-gram 匹配失真。数据覆盖上，benchmark 包含 2771 个测试样本，含单页与多页、22 种语言、学术文档、网页截图、图表/示意图、自然场景文本等多种来源。作者还强调了时间截断，新增采集内容晚于 2025 年 6 月，以降低预训练污染风险；对已有 OCR benchmark 来源，则通过“定向遮挡后的新任务形式”来减少记忆式命中。
summary.experiments: 实验结论很明确：这个任务对现有 MLLM 仍然偏难，尤其是句子级和段落级恢复。闭源强模型整体最好，开源小中型 VLM 落后明显。论文给出的主要观察不是某个模型小幅领先，而是能力分层很清楚：短目标、局部线索、单页样本相对容易；长目标、多页证据整合、需要事实一致性的样本显著更难。多语言和复杂版面也会进一步拉开差距。评测方法方面，作者用 level-aware 指标加 factuality gate，声称能比单一 lexical metric 更接近人工判断，这一点对长答案尤其重要。由于给出的全文片段没有完整结果表，无法可靠复述各模型的具体分数；但从文中叙述看，benchmark 的主要价值在于揭示“无提示恢复”与“有提示问答”不是同一能力，且现有模型在前者上还有明显缺口。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先看任务定义和数据构造原则，重点理解作者为什么坚持去掉显式问题，以及为什么不用随机 mask。这里决定了 benchmark 是否真的在测原生视觉理解，而不是换皮 OCR。然后看 level-aware evaluation 的设计，尤其是不同长度目标为何要分层评测，以及 LLM factuality gate 如何介入。最后看结果分析部分，关注三类切分：单页 vs 多页、短答案 vs 长答案、不同来源场景。预计 20–30 分钟能抓住主要信息。如果做文档预训练或网页 VLM，值得顺手看附录里的样例和人工标注规则，能帮助判断这个 benchmark 的噪声水平与可复现性。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a capability that standard VQA-style evaluation largely hides: can an MLLM recover missing text directly from visual context, without being told what to look for by an explicit question? In document and webpage settings, real inputs do not come with a natural-language query. A model must locate relevant evidence on its own, use layout and cross-region structure, and reconstruct the masked content. MMTR-Bench is designed to isolate this native recovery ability from instruction-following and prompt interpretation.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is mainly on the evaluation side, not a new pretraining method. The benchmark probes a capability that matters for document pretraining, webpage understanding, multi-page context integration, and layout-aware multimodal modeling: whether the model has actually learned to read structured visual-text inputs globally, rather than succeeding through QA formatting or local OCR cues. The impact is diagnostic rather than paradigm-shifting, but it is a useful diagnostic. For researchers working on native multimodal pretraining, document VLMs, visual masking objectives, or long-context multimodal models, this benchmark can expose failure modes that DocVQA-style setups often blur.
summary_en.technical_approach: There are three main design choices. First, the task removes the QA scaffold. The input is one or more images with a local masked region, and the model must directly output the hidden text. This forces the model to perform relevance discovery, structural grounding, and content reconstruction by itself. Second, the dataset construction is intentionally human-curated rather than random masking. The masked region must be recoverable from surrounding evidence; the remaining context must provide enough signal; the sample should require visual, structural, or cross-region reasoning instead of pure language prior; and ambiguous cases are filtered by secondary review. This is important because random masking would often test guessability rather than multimodal understanding. Third, evaluation is level-aware. Since targets range from short strings to full sentences and paragraphs, the benchmark uses different criteria by difficulty/length: exact matching for short targets, semantic similarity and factual consistency for longer ones, plus an LLM-based factuality gate to better align automatic scoring with human judgment. The benchmark contains 2,771 test samples, covers single-page and multi-page inputs, 22 languages, and several source types including academic documents, webpages, charts/diagrams, and scene text. The authors also impose a temporal cutoff for newly collected content to reduce contamination concerns.
summary_en.experiments: The main empirical message is that masked text reconstruction without explicit prompts remains difficult for current MLLMs. Strong closed-source models perform best overall, while smaller open-source vision-language models lag behind by a clear margin. Difficulty rises sharply when the target is longer, when evidence must be integrated across pages, or when factual consistency matters more than surface overlap. The benchmark also appears to separate short local completion from true global multimodal recovery. The full numeric tables are not available in the provided text fragment, so it would be unsafe to restate exact scores. Still, the qualitative pattern is clear: prompt-free reconstruction is materially harder than standard QA, and current models are far from saturated on sentence- and paragraph-level recovery.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a quick read, start with the task definition and the dataset construction rules. The key question is why the authors remove explicit questions and why they reject random masking. Then read the evaluation section carefully, especially the rationale for level-aware scoring and the role of the factuality gate for long targets. Finally, inspect the breakdowns by single-page vs multi-page and short vs long targets. Around 20–30 minutes should be enough to extract the main value. If your work is close to document pretraining or webpage MLLMs, the annotation examples and filtering criteria are worth checking because they determine whether the benchmark is actually measuring contextual recovery rather than OCR completion.

recommendation.zh: 这个 benchmark 设计比常见 VQA 干净，能测出 MLLM 是否真在做页面级联合建模；读任务定义和分层评测协议就够了。
recommendation.en: This benchmark is cleaner than standard VQA for testing native page-level multimodal modeling; read the task design and evaluation protocol, not every result table.

paper.title: UniCVR: From Alignment to Reranking for Unified Zero-Shot Composed Visual Retrieval
paper.abstract: Composed image retrieval, multi-turn composed image retrieval, and composed video retrieval all share a common paradigm: composing the reference visual with modification text to retrieve the desired target. Despite this shared structure, the three tasks have been studied in isolation, with no prior work proposing a unified framework, let alone a zero-shot solution. In this paper, we propose UniCVR, the first unified zero-shot composed visual retrieval framework that jointly addresses all three t

summary.core_problem: 解决 composed image retrieval、multi-turn composed image retrieval 和 composed video retrieval 长期分裂建模的问题，尝试做统一的零样本检索框架。
summary.importance: 贡献类型主要是统一任务设定与系统式方法整合：把 MLLM 的组合式查询理解能力和 VLP 检索能力拼接起来，并构建约 3.5M 多源训练数据。对多模态预训练研究员的价值在于看“生成式模型做理解前端、判别式模型做检索后端”的接口设计，而不是核心范式突破。
summary.technical_approach: UniCVR 采用两阶段方案。第一阶段把 MLLM 训练成 compositional query embedder，用对比学习把参考视觉输入与修改文本映射到统一检索空间，处理图像/视频/多轮三类异构任务。第二阶段用 reranking 进一步结合 VLP 模型的结构化视觉匹配能力，提高最终检索精度。方法本质上是对现有 MLLM 与 VLP 能力的组合与对齐，不是新的基础建模目标。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在三类 composed visual retrieval 任务上实现统一零样本处理，并依赖约 3.5M curated multi-source samples 训练第一阶段嵌入器。基线应包括各任务专用检索模型和零样本 VLM/MLLM 方案。摘要未给出具体提升幅度，因此结论强度还要看正文中的 ablation、跨任务泛化和 reranking 增益是否稳定。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自哈尔滨工业大学（深圳）、香港城市大学、南方科技大学和鹏城实验室，属于中文多模态检索方向较活跃的学术团队，但不是顶级实验室范式论文。

summary_en.core_problem: It aims to unify composed image retrieval, multi-turn composed image retrieval, and composed video retrieval under a single zero-shot framework instead of treating them as isolated tasks.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly task unification and system integration: it combines MLLM-based compositional query understanding with VLP-based retrieval, plus a 3.5M multi-source training set. For a multimodal pretraining researcher, the value is in the interface design between generative front-ends and discriminative retrieval back-ends, not in a new modeling paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach: UniCVR is a two-stage system. Stage I trains an MLLM as a compositional query embedder with contrastive learning, mapping reference visuals and modification text into a shared retrieval space across image, video, and multi-turn settings. Stage II adds reranking using a VLP model for structured visual matching. This is fundamentally a composition and alignment of existing MLLM/VLP capabilities rather than a new foundation-model objective.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims unified zero-shot performance across three composed visual retrieval tasks, with Stage I trained on about 3.5M curated multi-source samples. Baselines likely include task-specific retrieval systems and zero-shot VLM/MLLM methods. Since no concrete gains are given in the abstract, the real signal depends on whether the paper shows stable cross-task transfer, clean ablations, and meaningful reranking gains.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Harbin Institute of Technology (Shenzhen), City University of Hong Kong, Southern University of Science and Technology, and Pengcheng Laboratory. This looks like a solid academic multimodal retrieval effort, not a paradigm-setting lab report.

recommendation.zh: 统一检索任务的工程整合多于方法突破；若你关心 MLLM embedding 化，只看两阶段接口设计和多源 3.5M 数据构造即可。
recommendation.en: This is more systems integration than a modeling leap; if you care about turning MLLMs into retrieval embedders, just read the two-stage interface and the 3.5M data construction.

institutions: Southern University of Science and Technology

paper.title: ATIR: Towards Audio-Text Interleaved Contextual Retrieval
paper.abstract: Audio carries richer information than text, including emotion, speaker traits, and environmental context, while also enabling lower-latency processing compared to speech-to-text pipelines. However, recent multimodal information retrieval research has predominantly focused on images, largely overlooking audio, especially in the setting of interleaved audio-text contextual retrieval. In this work, we introduce the Audio-Text Interleaved contextual Retrieval (ATIR) task, where queries can alternate

summary.core_problem: 定义并评测音频—文本交错上下文检索任务，弥补现有多模态检索对音频模态支持不足的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是 benchmark 与任务设定，而不是新的基座预训练范式。对预训练研究员的价值在于：它提醒音频不应只经 ASR 压扁成文本，交错上下文检索需要保留副语言信息。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 ATIR 任务，允许 query 在音频与文本之间交替出现；通过整合 ASR、QA 和 retrieval 数据集，统一出四类上下文检索任务。方法上评测多种现成 retriever，并基于多模态大模型训练一个 ATIR 模型，同时引入新的检索机制来处理交错上下文。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出底座模型规模、训练数据总量和具体提升数字，只说明构建了一个新的 benchmark，并比较了 off-the-shelf retrievers 与自训练的 MLLM-based ATIR 模型。更像任务定义与初步 baseline 建立。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自中国人民大学高瓴人工智能学院。工作偏多模态检索 benchmark 与任务建模，不是音频 LM 或统一 tokenization 方向。

summary_en.core_problem: It defines and evaluates audio-text interleaved contextual retrieval, addressing the lack of audio support in current multimodal retrieval settings.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is a benchmark and task formulation rather than a new foundation-model pretraining paradigm. For pretraining researchers, the value is the reminder that audio should not always be collapsed into ASR text, since interleaved retrieval benefits from preserving paralinguistic information.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces the ATIR task, where queries can alternate between audio and text. It integrates ASR, QA, and retrieval datasets into four unified contextual retrieval tasks, evaluates several off-the-shelf retrievers, and trains an MLLM-based ATIR model with a new retrieval mechanism for interleaved context.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide base model size, total training data, or concrete gains. It mainly states that a new benchmark is built and that off-the-shelf retrievers are compared against a trained MLLM-based ATIR model. This looks more like task definition plus initial baselines.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the Gaoling School of Artificial Intelligence, Renmin University of China. The work is closer to multimodal retrieval benchmarking than to audio LM or unified tokenization research.

recommendation.zh: 如果你在看语音/音频统一建模，这篇只提供任务侧信号：别把音频全压成 ASR 文本；读 benchmark 设定即可，不必深挖方法。
recommendation.en: If you care about unified speech/audio modeling, the useful signal here is task-side: don’t flatten everything into ASR text; read the benchmark setup and move on.

paper.title: Mind's Eye: A Benchmark of Visual Abstraction, Transformation and Composition for Multimodal LLMs
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have achieved impressive progress on vision language benchmarks, yet their capacity for visual cognitive and visuospatial reasoning remains less understood. We introduce "Mind's Eye", a multiple-choice benchmark of eight visuo-cognitive tasks inspired by classic human intelligence tests and organized under a novel "A-R-T" taxonomy: Abstraction, Relation, and Transformation. The tasks probe core processes of fluid intelligence such as pattern induction, an

summary.core_problem: 现有多模态大模型在常规VQA/图文理解上表现不错，但其“视觉流体智力”能力（抽象归纳、类比映射、以及需要心智模拟的空间变换）缺少被隔离、可诊断、可对照人类的评测。论文要解决的是：如何构建一个尽量排除语言先验/世界知识捷径、能细分错误类型的视觉认知基准，并用它回答模型到底缺什么能力。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献不在于提出新训练法，而在于把“视觉空间推理缺口”拆成可测的认知维度，并用诊断性干扰项和难度分层给出更可操作的失败画像。它会影响两类工作：一是多模态预训练/后训练的数据设计（是否真的覆盖到心智旋转、折纸、组合等操作性能力），二是评估与对齐（避免把语言化CoT当作通用解法）。对做多模态基座的人来说，这个基准更像一把尺子：能区分‘看到了’和‘会操作’。
summary.technical_approach:
核心是基准设计而不是模型结构。
1) ART分类：把视觉认知任务按 Abstraction（从表面变化中归纳潜在规则）、Relation（跨结构做对应/类比映射）、Transformation（对形状做心智旋转/折叠/重组等空间操作）三类组织，目标是覆盖流体智力中更“程序化”的视觉操作。
2) 任务来源与构造：借鉴经典心理测量题型（如 mental rotation、paper folding 等），强调知识无关、低语义负载，减少模型用常识/语言模板猜答案的空间。
3) 诊断性干扰项：每道多选题的错误选项不是随机的，而是针对特定错误机制（例如方向/镜像混淆、局部匹配替代全局变换、关系对齐错误等）设计，用于把“错了”进一步分解成“怎么错的”。
4) 难度控制与分析框架：通过从易到难的实例分层，观察模型曲线形态；作者强调一个关键现象：人类随难度上升而下降，但模型表现对难度不敏感，暗示缺的是基础操作而非算力不足。
5) 干预实验：除直接评测外，还做提示词脚手架、以及对强开源模型做微调/对齐（文中提到fine-tuning与RL-based alignment）来检验“能否靠后训练补上”。此外用注意力/可视化分析检验模型是否至少能对齐到相关区域。
summary.experiments:
1) 覆盖18个MLLM，对照人类被试：人类平均约80%准确率，最好模型仍低于50%，差距主要集中在Transformation与Abstraction。
2) 难度分层：人类从easy到hard有明显退化；模型曲线更“平”，作者据此判断模型缺少可组合的基础视觉操作（例如稳定的心智旋转/折叠程序），而不是仅在高难度上算不过来。
3) 提示词干预：结构化推理/脚手架对Abstraction有帮助，但对Transformation稳定有害（作者的解释是：文本化步骤能帮助规则归纳，但会把需要‘在视觉表征上做操作’的问题拉回语言套路，反而干扰）。
4) 注意力诊断：模型往往能把注意力落在候选答案的相关区域，说明“找得到看哪里”；但仍频繁选错，说明“不会用看到的信息做可靠的空间操作”。
（注：你提供的全文片段未包含各子任务的逐项数值表、微调/RL对齐的具体提升幅度与训练细节；若需要精确到每个任务/模型的数字，需要补充论文后半部分的结果表与附录。）
summary.reading_guide:
建议按“基准设计→诊断结论→干预有效性”顺序读。
1) 先读Introduction里三条研究问题与作者声称的三个诊断信号：Transformation/Abstraction缺口、难度不敏感、prompt对Transformation有害。
2) 精读Benchmark章节：ART三类的定义边界、每类任务具体题型、以及“诊断性干扰项”如何对应错误机制。这部分决定了基准是否真的隔离了语言捷径。
3) 重点看结果分析中两类图表：a) 各任务/难度分层的准确率曲线（验证‘平曲线’现象）；b) 错误类型分布（看模型是否系统性镜像/旋转混淆）。
4) 最后看prompting、fine-tuning、RL alignment的对比：关注作者如何控制变量（同一模型不同提示/不同后训练），以及为什么Abstraction可被脚手架改善而Transformation不行。这里对后训练数据与目标函数设计有直接启发。

summary_en.core_problem: MLLMs score well on mainstream vision-language benchmarks, but their visual “fluid intelligence” (abstract rule induction, analogical mapping, and especially mental spatial transformations) is poorly isolated and diagnosed. The paper’s goal is to build a benchmark that minimizes linguistic/world-knowledge shortcuts, provides targeted distractors, and enables a human comparison to pinpoint what visuospatial operations models actually lack.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is evaluative and diagnostic rather than a new pretraining algorithm. By decomposing visual reasoning into Abstraction/Relation/Transformation and attaching error-targeted distractors plus difficulty stratification, it produces a more actionable failure profile for multimodal foundation models. Practically, it pressures pretraining/post-training data design (do we train procedural spatial operations or just pattern matching?) and cautions against assuming text-style CoT is a universal remedy for vision-centric reasoning.
summary_en.technical_approach:
This is primarily benchmark engineering.
1) ART taxonomy: Abstraction (latent rule induction under surface variation), Relation (structural correspondence / analogy), Transformation (procedural mental operations like rotation, folding, recomposition).
2) Cognitively grounded tasks: inspired by classic psychometric tests (e.g., mental rotation, paper folding) with low semantic content to reduce reliance on priors.
3) Diagnostic distractors: multiple-choice options are crafted to reflect specific failure modes (e.g., mirror vs rotation confusion, local-match heuristics, incorrect relational alignment), enabling mechanistic error attribution.
4) Difficulty control: items are stratified by difficulty; the benchmark is used to compare how accuracy changes with difficulty for humans vs models.
5) Interventions and probes: prompting scaffolds, plus fine-tuning / RL-based alignment on a strong open model (as stated), and attention-based analyses to separate “where to look” from “how to reason”.
summary_en.experiments:
1) Evaluation on 18 MLLMs with a human baseline: humans average ~80% accuracy; the best MLLMs stay below 50%, with the largest gaps on Transformation and Abstraction.
2) Difficulty trends: human performance degrades from easy to hard; model performance is comparatively flat across difficulty, suggesting missing foundational visuocognitive operators rather than only insufficient capacity.
3) Prompting effects: structured CoT-like scaffolding helps Abstraction but consistently hurts Transformation, aligning with the hypothesis that language-first reasoning interferes with procedural spatial simulation.
4) Attention diagnostics: models often attend to relevant regions/options but still fail, indicating that localization is not the bottleneck.
(Note: the provided full-text excerpt does not include per-task numeric tables or the detailed gains from fine-tuning/RL alignment; exact deltas would require the results/appendix sections.)
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read in the order: benchmark design → diagnostic findings → intervention results.
1) Introduction: focus on the three empirical questions and the claimed signatures (largest deficits on T/A, difficulty-invariant failures, prompting hurting Transformation).
2) Benchmark section: scrutinize ART boundaries, task instantiations, and how distractors map to hypothesized error mechanisms—this determines whether shortcuts are truly controlled.
3) Results: prioritize plots/tables that break down accuracy by ART category and by difficulty, plus error-type distributions.
4) Intervention/probing: compare base vs scaffolded prompting and any fine-tuning/RL alignment; look for controlled-variable design and why Abstraction is more promptable than Transformation.

recommendation.zh: 这不是方法论文，但 benchmark 切得准：如果你做多模态预训练，只看任务设计和错误分析就够，能直接暴露现有数据配方没覆盖的能力空洞。
recommendation.en: Not a methods paper, but the benchmark cuts at the right place: if you do multimodal pretraining, read the task design and error analysis to see which capabilities your current data recipe is simply not teaching.

paper.title: ReactBench: A Benchmark for Topological Reasoning in MLLMs on Chemical Reaction Diagrams
paper.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) excel at recognizing individual visual elements and reasoning over simple linear diagrams. However, when faced with complex topological structures involving branching paths, converging flows, and cyclic dependencies, their reasoning capabilities degrade sharply, even on tasks as basic as counting endpoints. Existing benchmarks fail to probe this gap, focusing on semantic comprehension rather than structural reasoning. We introduce ReactBench, a benchmark

summary.core_problem: 评测多模态大模型在复杂拓扑图中的结构推理能力，尤其是分支、汇合和环路等非线性关系上的失败模式。
summary.importance: 这是一个多模态 benchmark，贡献在于把“结构推理”从一般视觉语义理解中单独拎出来，并用化学反应图这一真实但结构化的载体暴露 MLLM 的短板。对统一多模态预训练有间接启发，但不直接作用于文本 LLM 基座。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 ReactBench，基于化学反应图构建 1,618 个专家标注问答，覆盖四个层级任务维度。核心思路不是换一个领域问答，而是利用反应图天然具备的链式、分叉、汇聚、循环拓扑，专门测模型的全局结构一致性与局部识别协同。
summary.experiments: 摘要称评测了 17 个 MLLM，并观察到显著性能差距，甚至在“数端点”这类基础拓扑任务上也会明显退化。摘要未给出具体模型名和绝对分数，但从任务设计看，重点是揭示现有模型在结构性视觉推理上的系统性缺口，而非追求榜单排序。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether multimodal LLMs can perform structural/topological reasoning over complex diagrams with branching, merging, and cyclic dependencies.
summary_en.importance: This is a benchmark contribution that isolates structural reasoning from generic visual-semantic understanding. It is indirectly relevant to multimodal pretraining, but not central to text-only foundation-model research.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce ReactBench, a benchmark built from chemical reaction diagrams with 1,618 expert-annotated QA pairs across four hierarchical task dimensions. The key idea is to use reaction diagrams as naturally structured testbeds for global topology reasoning rather than simple object recognition.
summary_en.experiments: According to the abstract, 17 MLLMs are evaluated and show large performance drops, including on basic tasks such as counting endpoints. The emphasis appears to be exposing systematic failure modes in structural visual reasoning rather than leaderboard optimization.

recommendation.zh: 如果你关心多模态统一里的“结构而非语义”短板，这个 benchmark 值得记住；否则看摘要和错误案例就够，不必细读全篇。
recommendation.en: Worth noting if you care about the structural—not semantic—failure mode of MLLMs; otherwise the abstract plus a few error examples are enough.

paper.title: CLASP: Class-Adaptive Layer Fusion and Dual-Stage Pruning for Multimodal Large Language Models

summary.core_problem: 在多模态大模型（MLLM）中，视觉token序列冗长导致推理开销（注意力二次复杂度、显存/延迟）过高；现有视觉token裁剪方法普遍依赖“固定ViT层特征 + 固定裁剪策略（attention或similarity的静态混合）”，对不同指令/问题类别的抽象层级需求（细粒度计数 vs 语义理解等）不敏感，从而在相同token预算下出现明显的类别脆弱性与性能损失。论文要解决的是：在不改动主干MLLM的前提下，如何让视觉表征提取与token裁剪随指令类别自适应，从而在大幅降token时尽量保留原性能。
summary.importance: 对“高效多模态推理/视觉token经济性”有直接价值：它把以往单一维度的token裁剪（只看相关性或只看冗余）提升为“类别条件化的表征选择 + 两阶段裁剪（相关性与覆盖度分工）”，并强调不同任务需要不同ViT层级信息与不同relevance/coverage权衡。对基座预训练本身的影响偏间接（更像推理侧/结构侧的可插拔模块），但对后续做多模态预训练时的token预算分配、动态计算（conditional compute）与训练-推理一致性（训练时固定token、推理时动态token）提供了可复用的设计范式与分析证据。
summary.technical_approach: CLASP由两部分组成，核心思想是“按指令类别自适应”。(1) Class-adaptive layer fusion：不再固定取ViT某一层（或固定几层）作为视觉表征，而是从多层ViT特征中做条件化融合，融合权重由输入指令（类别/意图）调制，以便对需要局部细节的类别（如Count）更多利用浅层/中层，对需要语义抽象的类别更多利用深层特征。论文在引言的实证分析（Fig.1 top）先证明：在固定token预算下，不同layer-mixture会导致类别精度显著波动，说明“固定层”是系统性瓶颈。(2) Dual-stage pruning：把token裁剪拆成两阶段并分配token预算：第一阶段偏relevance（保留注意力显著的“pivots/证据token”，避免关键证据被删）；第二阶段偏coverage（在剩余token中用冗余感知/相似度机制补全上下文，尽量覆盖必要信息同时继续去冗余）。并且两阶段的预算分配与attention-vs-similarity的权衡同样做类别自适应，而不是用全局固定mixing ratio。论文同样用Fig.1 bottom证明：不同类别最优mixing ratio差异很大（文本类≈0.3，计数类0.7–0.9），因此需要动态策略。整体上CLASP定位为plug-and-play：插在视觉编码器输出到投影/对齐模块之前，减少进入LLM的视觉token数，从而降低后续自注意力与跨模态计算。
summary.experiments: 论文在引言给出了关键量化结论与若干代表性数字：在高分辨率设置下视觉token会从576（336×336）增长到2880（672×672），凸显裁剪必要性；在MM-Vet、LLaVA-v1.5-7B、固定token预算R=192的分析中，Count类别随融合从hybrid转向deep层精度从29.5降到27.9，显示层选择敏感；固定attention/similarity混合比例无法对所有类别最优，文本类最优≈0.3而计数类需要0.7–0.9。整体效果方面，作者声称在“最高88.9% token reduction”下仍能保留“约94.7%原始性能”，并在8个图像基准+3个视频基准上优于SOTA token pruning方法（具体每个基准的绝对分数/对比方法/不同裁剪率曲线需要在正文实验章节与表格中核对）。从预训练/数据效率视角，值得关注其在不同裁剪率下的性能-计算曲线是否呈现更平滑的scaling，以及类别自适应是否在长尾类别上更稳定。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议（约30–45分钟）：1）先看Introduction里两段“敏感性验证”与Fig.1（top/bottom），这是论文动机最硬的证据：层融合与裁剪权衡确实是类别相关的；2）再看Method里class-adaptive layer fusion的实现细节：条件信号来自哪里（指令类别如何获得/预测）、融合是对token级还是通道级、是否引入额外训练；3）看dual-stage pruning如何定义pivots与coverage token、两阶段预算如何分配、相似度度量与attention信号来自哪一层/哪种注意力；4）最后快速扫实验的“accuracy–efficiency trade-off”曲线与消融：固定层 vs 自适应层、单阶段 vs 双阶段、静态mix vs 动态mix。若你关心与基座训练的关系，重点思考：训练时是否需要模拟动态裁剪（否则会有train-test mismatch），以及该机制能否推广到MoE/动态深度等conditional compute框架。

summary_en.core_problem: MLLM inference is dominated by the cost of long visual token sequences (quadratic attention, memory/latency). Prior token reduction methods typically use (i) features from a fixed ViT layer (or a fixed layer set) and (ii) a static pruning rule (attention-based relevance or similarity-based redundancy, or a fixed mixture). This becomes brittle across instruction categories because different intents require different abstraction levels and different relevance-vs-coverage trade-offs. The paper targets a plug-and-play way to make both visual feature extraction and token pruning category-adaptive under a fixed token budget.
summary_en.importance: Primarily impactful for efficient multimodal inference rather than core LLM pretraining, but it contributes a useful design pattern for conditional compute in multimodal stacks: (a) instruction-conditioned selection/fusion of representation depth, and (b) explicit decomposition of pruning into relevance preservation and coverage completion. For foundation-model researchers, the key value is the evidence that “one-size-fits-all” visual representations and pruning ratios are systematically suboptimal, which can inform future multimodal pretraining recipes (token budgeting, dynamic routing, and mitigating train–test mismatch when inference uses dynamic token counts).
summary_en.technical_approach: CLASP has two coupled modules, both conditioned on instruction category. (1) Class-adaptive layer fusion: instead of extracting visual tokens from a single ViT layer, it fuses multi-layer ViT features with category-dependent weights, aiming to retain the right granularity (shallower/mid layers for local-detail tasks like counting; deeper layers for semantic tasks). The paper motivates this with a category-wise sensitivity study (Fig. 1 top). (2) Class-adaptive dual-stage pruning: token reduction is split into two stages with an explicit token-budget allocation. Stage-1 is relevance-preserving, keeping attention-salient pivot/evidence tokens. Stage-2 is coverage-oriented, using redundancy-aware/similarity criteria to keep complementary context while further removing redundant patches. The balance between attention-led and similarity-led pruning is also category-adaptive (motivated by Fig. 1 bottom showing different optimal mixing ratios per category). The method is positioned as plug-and-play before the projector/LLM, reducing the number of visual tokens consumed by the decoder.
summary_en.experiments: Key quantitative signals provided in the visible full text: raising resolution from 336×336 (576 tokens) to 672×672 (2,880 tokens) illustrates the compute blow-up; on MM-Vet with LLaVA-v1.5-7B at token budget R=192, the Count category drops from 29.5 to 27.9 when shifting fusion emphasis from hybrid to deeper layers, evidencing layer-depth sensitivity; optimal attention/similarity mixing differs by category (text-like categories peak around ~0.3, counting around 0.7–0.9). The headline claim is that CLASP retains ~94.7% of original performance with up to 88.9% token reduction, and improves the accuracy–efficiency trade-off across 8 image and 3 video benchmarks versus prior pruning baselines (exact per-benchmark numbers and ablations should be verified in the main experiments section/tables).
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim plan (30–45 min): (1) Read the Introduction’s two diagnostic studies and Fig. 1 carefully—they are the strongest justification for category adaptivity. (2) In Method, focus on how category signals are obtained/represented and how multi-layer fusion is implemented (token-level vs channel-level, extra parameters/training). (3) Study the dual-stage pruning definitions: what constitutes pivots, what similarity metric is used for coverage, and how token budgets are split/adapted. (4) Check the main accuracy–compute curves and ablations: fixed-layer vs adaptive fusion, single-stage vs dual-stage, static vs adaptive mixing. If you care about pretraining implications, explicitly look for discussion/experiments on train–test mismatch when inference uses dynamic pruning.

recommendation.zh: 类别条件化选层+两阶段裁剪的设计挺可复用，能指导你做conditional compute的token预算分配；重点看不同任务偏好的ViT层分析图表。
recommendation.en: Reusable recipe for conditional compute (class-adaptive layer choice + two-stage pruning); focus on the plots showing which ViT layers different tasks actually need.

paper.title: Spotlight and Shadow: Attention-Guided Dual-Anchor Introspective Decoding for MLLM Hallucination Mitigation

summary.core_problem: MLLM生成文本与视觉内容不一致的幻觉问题，如何在不改训练的情况下通过解码阶段动态校准每个token的生成以降低幻觉。
summary.importance: 后训练/推理时对齐方向的重要补充：提出一种基于模型内部注意力与层选择的对比式解码框架，用“token级自省”缓解视觉幻觉，并声称兼顾推理能力提升，适合快速落地到现有MLLM。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Dual-Anchor Introspective Decoding (DaID)：在生成时为每个token选择两个“锚点层”——Spotlight层用于放大视觉事实信号、Shadow层用于抑制文本惯性；利用视觉注意力分布引导层的选择，并以对比式解码方式融合/校准token概率，实现动态、token特定的适配。
summary.experiments: 在多个MLLM与多个基准上评测幻觉缓解与推理表现（摘要未披露具体模型、数据集名称、指标与提升幅度）；强调跨模型有效与总体提升。

summary_en.core_problem: Mitigating hallucinations in multimodal LLMs where generated text conflicts with visual content, using decoding-time methods that do not require additional training.
summary_en.importance: Training-free, inference-time alignment techniques are attractive for rapid deployment and broad compatibility. Token-level calibration that leverages internal model signals can reduce visual hallucinations while potentially improving overall reasoning behavior.
summary_en.technical_approach: Dual-Anchor Introspective Decoding (DaID) selects two anchor layers per generated token: a “Spotlight” layer to amplify visually grounded evidence and a “Shadow” layer to suppress text-prior inertia. Layer selection is guided by visual attention patterns, and a contrastive decoding fusion adjusts token probabilities in a token-specific, dynamic manner.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports evaluations across multiple MLLMs and benchmarks showing reduced hallucinations and improved overall performance with cross-model effectiveness, but omits the specific models, datasets, metrics, and quantitative gains.

recommendation.zh: 不改训练的“注意力引导自省解码”听起来香但易被评测套路影响；当弱信号看，重点核对消融/是否牺牲通用能力与推理开销。
recommendation.en: Training-free attention-guided introspective decoding sounds nice but is easy to game via eval choices; treat as weak evidence—check ablations, capability tradeoffs, and runtime cost.
